Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.

1. Demand Planning & S&OP
Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook.
Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.

2. Production Planning & Control
Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.

3. Material Planning & MRP
Existing responsibilities plus:
Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:
Lead times
Lot sizes
Safety stocks
Reorder levels
MOQ
Supplier lead times
Planning horizons
Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

4. Procurement & Supplier Management
Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.

5. Inventory Management
Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
Drive reduction of:
Excess inventory
Obsolete inventory
Slow-moving inventory
Uncontrolled WIP
Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.

6. Warehouse & Logistics
Existing responsibilities plus:
Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.

Job Description
Cloud Automation Engineer
Location: Mumbai / Noida / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Experience: 6+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Automation Engineer with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation engineering. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, automating, and managing scalable Azure-based virtual lab environments while driving operational efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization.
Your Role
As a Cloud Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining automated Azure infrastructure solutions, reusable deployment frameworks, and environment lifecycle management capabilities. You will work closely with cloud architects, DevOps teams, and engineering stakeholders to deliver highly automated and repeatable cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Automate the creation, configuration, operation, and teardown of Azure-based virtual lab environments.
Develop reusable Terraform and/or Bicep modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Automate deployment of Azure services including Virtual Networks, Subnets, NSGs, Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, Private Connectivity, and Monitoring solutions.
Create and maintain reusable VM images, deployment artifacts, and infrastructure configurations.
Develop automation for building, versioning, packaging, validating, publishing, and deploying environment bundles.
Automate deployment and movement of build, topology, emulator, configuration, and test bundles across virtual machines.
Implement configuration-driven provisioning based on predefined recipes and topology definitions.
Develop scripts for environment startup, shutdown, hibernation, health checks, reset, cleanup, and teardown activities.
Build automation for resource tagging, expiration policies, orphan-resource detection, and cloud cost management.
Troubleshoot infrastructure provisioning and configuration issues to improve reliability and repeatability.
Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code repositories, deployment documentation, runbooks, and operational guides.
Required Skills Experience
7+ years of experience in Cloud Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud infrastructure design.
Expertise in Terraform and/or Azure Bicep for Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Experience automating Azure networking, compute, storage, security, and monitoring services.
Strong scripting experience using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
Knowledge of Azure Virtual Machine image management and environment provisioning.
Mandatory Skills
Microsoft Azure
Terraform
Azure Bicep
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Azure Networking (VNet, Subnet, NSG)
Azure Virtual Machines
Automation Scripting (PowerShell/Python/Bash)
CI/CD Deployment Automation
Cloud Cost Optimization
Monitoring Operations

We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Gurgaon / Chennai / Pune / Noida / Hyderabad
Responsibilities:
Design and implement advanced solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs).
Demonstrate self-driven initiative by taking ownership and creating end-to-end solutions.
Conduct research and stay informed about the latest developments in generative AI and LLMs.
Develop and maintain code libraries, tools, and frameworks to support generative AI development.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high code quality standards.
Engage in the entire software development lifecycle, from design and testing to deployment and maintenance.
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align messaging, contribute to roadmaps, and integrate software into different repositories for core system compatibility.

Demonstrate excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Primary Skills:
Natural Language Processing (NLP): Hands-on experience in use case classification, topic modeling, Q&A and chatbots, search, Document AI, summarization, and content generation.
AND/OR
Computer Vision and Audio: Hands-on experience in image classification, object detection, segmentation, image generation, audio, and video analysis.
Generative AI:
Proficiency with SaaS LLMs, including Lang chain, llama index, vector databases, Prompt engineering (COT, TOT, ReAct, agents). Experience with Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock for text/audio/image/video modalities.
Familiarity with Open-source LLMs, including tools like TensorFlow/Pytorch and huggingface. Techniques such as quantization, LLM finetuning using PEFT, RLHF, data annotation workflow, and GPU utilization.
Cloud: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Cloud certification is preferred.
Application Development: Proficiency in Python, Docker, FastAPI/Django/Flask, and Git.

Description:
The Role
We are looking for a marketing intelligence leader who combines marketing and pipeline expertise with data science and AI to proactively monitor and optimize performance. This role will lead the development of predictive models that identify emerging risks and opportunities, diagnose performance drivers, and translate insights into actions that improve campaign, pipeline, and business outcomes.
 Location- Bangalore/Noida
Role- Individual Contributor
Shift- 2.00pm-11.00pm IST

Key Responsibilities
Marketing & Pipeline Performance Intelligence
Analyze performance across campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, and ROI.
Identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities across campaigns, channels, audiences, segments, and pipeline.
Diagnose what is driving performance and where intervention is needed.
Translate findings into actionable recommendations that improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes.
Data Science & Proactive Monitoring
Lead the design and deployment of predictive, forecasting, pacing, and anomaly-detection models to proactively monitor marketing and pipeline performance.
Build scalable early-warning capabilities that detect meaningful changes and emerging performance risks and opportunities.
Use advanced analytics to understand what changed, why it changed, and what is likely to happen next.
Campaign Optimization & Partnership
Partner closely with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Campaign Strategy, and Digital Experience to translate insights into action.
Recommend opportunities to optimize campaign strategy, audiences, channels, investment, execution, and activation.
Measure the impact of optimization actions and incorporate learnings into future analyses and models.
AI & Analytics Automation
Apply AI and automation to accelerate monitoring, forecasting, diagnostics, and insight generation.
Automate recurring analytical processes and build scalable performance intelligence solutions.
Partner with Marketing Operations and technology teams to operationalize models and analytics.
Executive Insights
Translate complex analytics into clear, decision-ready business insights and recommendations.
Communicate what is happening, why it matters, and what action should be taken.
Provide leadership with a proactive view of the marketing and pipeline risks and opportunities that require attention.
Qualifications
8+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, performance intelligence, or advanced analytics.
Hands-on data science experience designing, building, validating, and deploying predictive and proactive monitoring models, including forecasting and anomaly detection.
Deep understanding of B2B marketing and pipeline performance, including campaigns, funnel conversion, pipeline creation and progression, sales, revenue, attribution, and ROI.
Proven ability to diagnose performance drivers and translate model outputs and analytical insights into actionable marketing recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using AI, automation, and modern analytics platforms.
Strong business acumen, problem-solving, executive communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.
Success in This Role
Marketing identifies performance risks and opportunities earlier.
Teams understand where performance is changing, why, and what action to take.
Predictive monitoring reduces reliance on retrospective reporting.
Marketing gains greater visibility into campaign effectiveness and pipeline creation, progression, and conversion.
AI and automation enable faster, more scalable performance intelligence.
Leadership receives clear recommendations connecting marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Network Implementation Engineer
Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Pune, Noida
Immediate joiners preferred

Experience: 3+ Years

Skills:
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically
within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or
equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field
experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize
operational disruption.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst
(9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series
routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500
Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for
automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution
cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE /
NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP
neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error
monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming
parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.

NoBroker is World's Largest NoBrokerage Property site offering end to end services in the real estate
space. We are also Indias First Prop-Teah unicorn with a billion dollar valuation.
At NoBroker Builder Channel, we provide seamless experience to future homeowners. We cater to 6
major geographies now - Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, NCR, and Chennai.
About the Role:
The role of a Client Advisor is crucial as it is an intermediary between potential clients and developers,
offering valuable guidance and support during the entire buying journey of the customer
Key Responsibilities:

Contact potential customers via telephone, virtual meet or onsite to explain our new builder
projects and persuade them to schedule an appointment on site or persuade them to make a
purchase.







Attend qualified leads by meeting clients virtually, where you will present tailored made
options and convince customers to come on site.
Facilitate negotiations between clients and builders, ensuring that both parties are satisfied with
the terms of the deal.
The Client Advisor must maintain relationships with clients, ensuring that they are satisfied with
the services provided and are likely to recommend NoBroker to others.
Promote and offer additional NoBroker services to customers, aiming to cross-sell and provide
them with a comprehensive range of offerings that meet their needs.
Ensure all leads are nurtured and create a good quality strong sales pipeline/funnel for achieving
daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Generate referrals and actively encourage customers to recommend our services to their friends,
family, and acquaintances.
The Client Advisor must stay informed about changes and trends in the real estate market,
including pricing, inventory, and demand.

Minimum qualification required is a bachelor's degree or equivalent.
Proven track record of sales experience or a similar role in a sales environment.
Real estate experience is an added advantage.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to convince, persuade, and handle objections effectively.
Knowledge of sales principles and techniques.
Good locality understanding.
Ability to work under a target driven role.
Should have a vehicle of his or her own.





Fluency in the local language and English.
Working Days: 6 days (Saturday and Sunday working).
Competencies to check while interviewing for the Role :







Real Estate Knowledge
Communication skills including questioning and listening skills.
Networking and Relationship Building
Problem-Solving and Negotiation
Rapport Building skills
Convincing skills
Customer-oriented mindset

Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

About Fractal
Fractal is one of the most prominent providers of Artificial Intelligence to Fortune 500 companies.Fractals vision is to power every human decision in the enterprise, and bring AI, engineering, and design to help the worlds most admired companies.Fractal currently has 4000+ employees across 16 global locations, including the United States, UK, Ukraine, India, Singapore, and Australia.
Fractals businesses include Crux Intelligence (AI driven business intelligence), Eugenie.ai (AI for sustainability), Asper.ai (AI for revenue growth management) and Senseforth.ai (conversational AI for sales and customer service). Fractal incubated Qure.ai, a leading player in healthcare AI for detecting Tuberculosis and Lung cancer.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Azure Lead Architect to join our consulting practice. In this leadership role, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for leading architecture engagements, defining cloud strategies, and guiding cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and secure cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design and implementation of Azure-based solutions for complex enterprise applications.
Define cloud architecture and roadmap in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
Assess client s current environment and make architecture recommendations for cloud adoption, migration, and optimization.
Own end-to-end solution architecture and act as a trusted advisor to client leadership.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, Data, and Application teams to align cloud solutions with enterprise strategy.
Mentor and guide development teams on best practices in cloud architecture.
Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and cost-benefit analysis.
Support pre-sales and proposal development including effort estimation, technical solutions, and client presentations.
Stay updated with the latest Azure offerings and industry trends.
Required Skills Qualifications
12+ years of experience in IT, with 6+ years of hands-on experience in Azure architecture and implementation.
Strong expertise in Azure services such as Azure App Services, AKS, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure DevOps, ARM/Bicep/Terraform templates.
Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert) preferred.
Bachelors or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Prior experience in a client-facing consulting role.
Knowledge of other cloud platforms like AWS or GCP is a plus.
Why Join Us
Opportunity to work with top-tier clients across industries.
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud projects and digital transformation programs.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
Learning and development opportunities with access to cloud certifications and trainings.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

We are seeking highly skilled Cloud Data Platform Engineers (45 resources) with deep hands-on expertise across Azure, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Unity Catalog to strengthen our cloud data operations. These roles demand technical execution, not coordination—requiring strong engineering capabilities in infrastructure automation, FinOps, CI/CD, platform governance, environment management, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
The ideal candidates will have proven experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms, ensuring secure, reliable, cost-efficient, and well-governed cloud environments.
Key Responsibilities
1. Cloud Platform Operations
Manage and optimize Azure workloads—ADLS, VNets, Key Vault, ADF, Synapse, Fabric, Databricks.
Configure and maintain Databricks clusters, jobs, DLT pipelines, Delta Lake storage, and Unity Catalog policies.

Job Description: Cloud Data Platform Engineer / SRE (Azure | Databricks | Fabric | Unity Catalog)
Role Overview
Operationalize Fabric Lakehouses, Pipelines, Warehouses, and Semantic Models for production workloads.
Ensure robust platform governance across environments (DEV–QA–UAT–PROD).
2. InfrastructureasCode & CI/CD
Build and maintain Terraform/Bicep templates for environment provisioning and configuration.
Develop end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for Databricks, Fabric, and Azure components (ADO/GitHub).
Automate deployment of notebooks, workflows, access policies, networking components, and Fabric artifacts.
Enforce version control, release governance, and quality gates.
3. FinOps, Cost Management & Capacity Planning
Implement FinOps dashboards, alerts, budgets, and spend governance practices.
Perform Databricks and Fabric cost optimization—cluster sizing, autoscaling, idle management, job tuning.
Conduct capacity planning for compute, storage, Fabric engines, and Databricks workloads.
Develop cost-saving recommendations and automated consumption monitoring.
4. Environment Management, Security & Governance
Provision and manage Azure data environments with consistent policies and naming standards.
Configure RBAC, ACLs, Unity Catalog grants, service principals, network security, Managed Identities.
Implement governance standards for data access, lineage, audit logging, compliance, and risk mitigation.
Ensure secure connectivity using Private Endpoints, VNET integration, and enterprise IAM controls.
5. Monitoring, Observability & Platform Reliability (SRE)
Implement monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Databricks Metrics, Fabric Admin APIs.
Build runbooks, dashboards, and automated remediation workflows for platform reliability.
Conduct performance tuning of data workloads, Fabric pipelines, Databricks jobs, and storage layers.
Lead incident management, rootcause analysis, and environment stabilization efforts.
Required Skills & Experience
6–12 years in cloud data engineering, SRE, or platform engineering roles.
Strong hands-on expertise with:
Azure Data Services (ADLS, ADF, Synapse, Key Vault, VNets)
Azure Databricks (clusters, jobs, Delta Lake, DLT, Unity Catalog)
Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Pipelines, Warehouse, Dataflows)
Unity Catalog governance (catalogs, schemas, access policies, lineage)
Strong scripting and automation experience: Python, PowerShell, Bash, SQL, PySpark.
Experience with Terraform/Bicep for IaC.
Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
Proven FinOps experience with cost governance and optimization across cloud workloads.
Experience in SRE practices—SLIs, SLOs, operational readiness, automated recovery.
Preferred Qualifications
Certifications in Azure Data Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, Databricks Data Engineer, FinOps Practitioner.
Experience in highly regulated environments (BFSI, Healthcare, Retail).
Understanding of zero-trust security models.
Suitable Job Titles
Cloud Data Platform Engineer
Databricks Platform Engineer
Azure/Fabric DevOps Engineer
Cloud DataOps / SRE Engineer
Platform Reliability Engineer (Data Platforms)

Job Description: Salesforce Application Architect Provider Network Management (PNM / Vlocity)

Role Summary
We are seeking a Salesforce Application Architect with deep expertise in Provider Network Management (PNM) within Salesforce Health Cloud, including hands on experience with Vlocity/OmniStudio. The architect will design and implement provider enrollment, credentialing, network management, and contract automation solutions using Salesforce’s PNM capabilities, which streamline provider onboarding, automate guided workflows, and leverage specialized Health Cloud PNM objects and data models.
Responsibilities
Architect end to end PNM solutions (provider enrollment, credentialing, contracts, network setup) aligned with Health Cloud PNM capabilities.
Design and extend the PNM data model using custom objects
Lead solutioning using Vlocity/OmniStudio (OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, DataRaptors).
Provide architectural guidance, ensure scalability, and adhere to Salesforce platform best practices.
Collaborate with business, provider operations, and engineering teams to deliver compliant, industry grade solutions.
Required Skills
Strong hands on experience with Salesforce Health Cloud PNM and healthcare provider lifecycle processes.
Advanced Vlocity/OmniStudio expertise.
Strong Salesforce platform architecture, data modeling, and integration skills.
Preferred certifications: Application Architect, OmniStudio, Health Cloud.
Solid understanding of healthcare payer/provider operational models.
Deep understanding of Salesforce recommended architectural practices, scalability considerations, and cross-cloud solutioning
Proficiency in API design, security, data modeling, system integrations, and event-driven architectures.
General Requirements
8-15 years IT experience with 5+ years in Salesforce.
Salesforce certifications preferred (Application Architect, OmniStudio Consultant/Developer, Health Cloud).
Strong communication skills for stakeholder management, discovery workshops, and solution presentation.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with payer systems, provider credentialing systems, or healthcare interoperability (HL7/FHIR) is a plus.
Experience implementing Provider Search, Network Adequacy, or Provider Directory solutions within Health Cloud ecosystems.
Prior work in regulated healthcare environments with compliance requirements.

Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Immigration Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of immigration policies and regulations in key regions such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, Saudi Arabia, and other Middle Eastern countries.
The Skills You Will Need:
4-10 years of experience in immigration consulting, legal advisory, or a similar role with a focus on US, UK, Saudi Arabia, and Middle Eastern immigration policies.
Strong knowledge of immigration laws, procedures, and visa categories for the US, Australia, the UK, and the Middle East (including Saudi Arabia).
Proven experience in handling complex immigration cases and navigating the intricacies of various countries policies.
Excellent communication skills, with strong attention to detail.
Knowledge of global mobility trends and immigration compliance requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data tracking, reporting, and analysis.
Responsibilities
You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with immigration laws and facilitating the successful processing of visa applications and work permits.
Your Adventure includes:
Advise on immigration processes and policies for the US, UK, Middle Eastern countries (including Saudi Arabia), and other relevant jurisdictions.
Stay updated on changes in immigration laws, regulations, and visa categories.
Assist individuals with obtaining the necessary documentation for visas, permits, residency, and citizenship applications.
Provide guidance on compliance with immigration laws, including work authorization, permanent residency, and citizenship.
Handle all aspects of the visa application process, from initial consultation through to successful approval.
Prepare and review documents, ensuring they meet the specific requirements of each jurisdiction.
Address and resolve any immigration-related issues or complications that may arise during the application process.
Train and mentor junior team members on immigration procedures and best practices.

Role & responsibilities

We are seeking an experienced and driven Manager - Talent Acquisition (Leadership Hiring) to lead end-to-end recruitment for senior and leadership-level positions across the organization. This is currently an Individual Contributor (IC) role, requiring strong stakeholder management, executive search capabilities, market intelligence, and a consultative hiring approach. Based on business needs and performance, the role may evolve into a people management position with team leadership responsibilities in the future.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership Hiring
Manage end-to-end recruitment for leadership and critical positions across business functions.
Partner with senior business leaders to understand talent requirements, organizational priorities, and succession needs.
Develop and execute targeted search strategies to identify and engage high-caliber leadership talent.
Build and maintain strong leadership talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and talent intelligence research.
Stakeholder Management
Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders.
Drive hiring discussions, calibration meetings, and offer negotiations for senior-level hires.
Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Influence hiring decisions through data-driven insights and market trends.
Talent Acquisition Excellence
Design and implement innovative sourcing strategies, including executive search methodologies.
Track and report key recruitment metrics and leadership hiring effectiveness.
Ensure compliance with internal hiring policies and recruitment governance.
Collaborate with HR Business Partners and business leaders on workforce planning initiatives.
Employer Branding & Market Intelligence
Strengthen the organization's leadership hiring brand through networking and industry engagement.
Stay updated on industry trends, talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and competitor movements.
Build strong external networks with industry leaders, executive search firms, and professional associations.
Future Team Leadership Opportunities
Mentor and guide recruiters as needed on leadership hiring best practices.
Support capability building within the Talent Acquisition function.
Potentially lead and manage a team of recruiters based on business growth and organizational requirements.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
8+ years of Talent Acquisition experience with significant exposure to leadership and niche hiring.
Proven experience in hiring for Director, VP, AVP, General Manager, and other leadership positions.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
Strong expertise in executive search, talent mapping, and passive candidate engagement.
Preferred Skills
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strong negotiation and offer management capabilities.
Data-driven decision-making and analytical mindset.
Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
High level of ownership, accountability, and business acumen.
Experience in technology, product, digital, consulting, or corporate leadership hiring is preferred.
Key Competencies

Executive Presence
Strategic Thinking
Stakeholder Management
Consultative Hiring
Talent Market Intelligence
Decision Making
Communication & Influencing
Relationship Management
Problem Solving
Results Orientation
Success Measures
Leadership hiring closure rate and quality of hire.
Time-to-fill and stakeholder satisfaction.
Leadership talent pipeline strength.
Candidate experience and offer-to-join ratio.
Contribution to strategic workforce planning and talent acquisition initiatives.

Role Purpose
Provide on-site leadership for critical business-impacting incidents and act as the primary customer-facing Major Incident Manager.
Key Responsibilities
• Own mission-critical incidents impacting business operations.

• Manage incident escalations and command-center activities.
• Conduct executive-level incident reviews and reporting.
• Identify operational improvement opportunities and drive remediation plans.
• Support customer governance and service review meetings.
Work Schedule & Shift Requirements
• Working an overnight night shift is a strict requirement for this role.

Role & responsibilities
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced SAP ABAP Consultant with 8+ years of hands-on experience in SAP development and implementation projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Core ABAP, OData Services, CDS Views, RAP, and S/4HANA migration/conversion projects, along with integration experience across SAP functional modules.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and support SAP ABAP solutions in S/4HANA environments.
Develop and enhance Core ABAP objects including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Workflows.
Build and maintain OData Services, CDS Views, and RAP-based applications.
Participate in end-to-end SAP implementation projects and support business transformation initiatives.
Work closely with functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver technical solutions.
Develop and support integration solutions between SAP modules and external systems.
Participate in S/4HANA migration and conversion projects, including custom code remediation and optimization.
Perform code reviews, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and production support activities.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Core ABAP Development
Hands-on expertise in OData Services
Extensive experience in CDS Views
Experience with RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model)
SAP Implementation project experience
SAP Integration experience across modules
Experience in Data Migration and Conversion activities
S/4HANA Migration and Conversion project experience
Strong understanding of SAP development standards and best practices
Functional Exposure
SAP SD (Sales & Distribution)
SAP MM (Materials Management)
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working in large-scale enterprise SAP landscapes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Hiring Criteria
Minimum 8 years of relevant SAP ABAP experience.
Must have hands-on experience in S/4HANA Migration/Conversion projects.
Immediate joiners or candidates who can join within 015 days preferred.
Willingness to work from Bangalore, Mumbai, Noida, or Pune locations.

NoBroker is a technology-led real estate platform focused on simplifying the property buying, selling, and renting experience through technology. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment where ownership, customer experience, and business outcomes are highly valued.

Job Title
Fintech Partnership Manager - Sr. Assoc - Corporate Development & Partnerships (Payments)
Short Description
Join the team that is executing innovative Partnerships and Investments for the Payments arm of one of the world s leading banks
Position Description:
The Payments Corporate Development & Partnerships (CD&P) team identifies competitive advantages for the business, leveraging investments, M&A, and partnerships to enhance JPM Payments strategic positioning. The Partnerships function collaborates with the Payments business, cross-LOB, and corporate functions to evaluate, structure, and execute potential partnerships to fill product gaps, create distribution channels, or drive innovation. The role involves significant external and internal engagement to help drive strategy and identify areas where we can add value. In addition to identifying new opportunities, a key part of the role will be managing relationships with our existing partners and driving revenue growth and client updates for these partnerships.
Job Summary :
As a Fintech Partnership Assoc (602) within the Corporate Developments & Partnerships team, you will be at the forefront of payments, responsible for identifying, developing, and managing strategic partnerships with fintech companies across the Payments business with exposure to projects in North America, EMEA, APAC and LATAM. Your focus will be on working with the global CD&P team to analyze new partnership opportunities and supporting with integrating and commercializing these fintech solutions to enhance our banking services and deliver exceptional value to our customers.
Job responsibilities
Identify and Evaluate Opportunities: Conduct market research to identify potential fintech partners that align with the banks strategic objectives, addressing product capability gaps and customer needs. Evaluate partnership opportunities based on regional market trends and technological advancements.
Develop business cases: Utilise strong market knowledge and analytical skills to work with Sales and Product colleagues to establish, and get sign off for, strong business cases which justify our strategic decisions.
Develop Strategic Partnerships: Establish and maintain strong relationships with fintech companies. Negotiate and execute partnership agreements that drive mutual value and support the banks innovation goals
Collaboration: Work closely with product, technology, compliance, conduct, operational risk (CCOR), and legal teams to ensure seamless integration of fintech solutions. Facilitate communication and collaboration between internal stakeholders and fintech partners.
Commercialize Fintech Solutions: Develop and implement strategies to commercialize fintech solutions, ensuring they are effectively marketed and monetized to achieve business objectives. Track and report on the revenue generated from these solutions to assess their financial impact and success.
Monitor and Report Performance: Track and analyse the performance of fintech partnerships with a strong emphasis on governance of partner management (from onboarding to commercialization). Provide regular updates and insights to regional management on partnership outcomes and strategic impact.
Stay Informed on Global Payments Trends: Keep abreast of the latest developments in the fintech industry, including emerging technologies, regulatory changes, and competitive dynamics.
Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:
Minimum of 6 years of work experience in financial services and prefer to have 4+ years of experience in Payments, ideally in a Product or Partnerships roles
Proven experience in Market research, Product, Commercial Partnerships, Business Development, or a related role within the financial services or fintech industry
Strong understanding of fintech trends, technologies, and business models.
Excellent skills and articulation on all modes - written, verbal and presentations to senior management
Previous experience with analysis/strategy with fact based writing skills along with storytelling and presentation skills in a concise and confident manner
Excellent negotiation, communication, management and relationship-building skills.
Understanding of Fintech ecosystem and payments industry
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment
Have logical and analytical approach, commercial acumen, able to identify trends/patterns
Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously and self-manage deadlines and deliverables, clearly articulating progress and milestones
Team-oriented and collaborative approach, balanced with independent thought leadership
Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills
Desire to learn quickly, be flexible and think strategically
Team oriented, inquisitive, critical thinker who anticipates questions from internal clients and management
Proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel
Manage the work and priorities with the team in an independent manner with good work ethics.
Job Location - Bengaluru, India

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Job Title
Senior Manager - Solution Architecture
Job Summary
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager - Solution Architecture to lead the design and governance of end-to-end enterprise solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.
This role combines solution strategy, architecture leadership, and people management, translating complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective solutions. The ideal candidate will connect business processes, applications, data, integration, and cloud technologies to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
You will own solution architecture quality across engagements, lead a team of architects, and partner with enterprise architecture, product, engineering, security, and business leaders to guide solutions from discovery through implementation and business value realization.
Responsibilities
Solution Strategy & Architecture Leadership
Own end-to-end solution architecture across complex transformation initiatives, aligning business capabilities, functional requirements, and technology choices with enterprise strategy.
Lead discovery and architecture workshops to define solution scope, assess current-state landscapes, and develop target-state designs and phased transition roadmaps.
Define architecture across application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains, with clear component responsibilities, interfaces, deployment models, and dependencies.
Evaluate build-versus-buy options, cloud services, enterprise products, and emerging technologies through structured trade-off analysis and targeted proofs of concept.
Establish reference architectures, design patterns, architecture decision records, and review standards; ensure alignment with enterprise principles and govern justified exceptions.
Lead architecture reviews and resolve cross-domain design challenges, balancing business fit, scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.
Architecture Governance & Delivery Excellence
Provide architecture oversight across concurrent engagements, maintaining traceability from requirements to design decisions, implementation, and acceptance criteria.
Partner with engineering and delivery teams to translate designs into actionable work, validate feasibility, and manage technical dependencies, design changes, and architecture risks.
Define measurable non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, recovery, and supportability; guide validation through testing and operational readiness reviews.
Develop migration and modernization approaches, including data migration, coexistence, cutover, and rollback; align sequencing, estimates, and cost assumptions with delivery teams.
Embed security, privacy, data governance, and applicable compliance requirements in solution designs, working with control owners to assess risks and close design gaps.
Team Leadership & Talent Management
Lead and scale a solution architecture team, coordinating application, data, integration, cloud, and security specialists across engagements.
Build an inclusive, high-performance architecture practice focused on sound judgment, collaboration, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
Own hiring, resource allocation, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with business demand and technology priorities.
Mentor architects and technical leads on design quality, business understanding, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen communities of practice and peer reviews.
Business & Stakeholder Management
Partner with business leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, product owners, and clients to clarify needs and translate them into feasible solution options.
Present solution alternatives, investment needs, trade-offs, and risks to decision-makers; secure alignment on scope, target architecture, and expected business outcomes.
Lead architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations, including solution narratives, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and implementation approaches.
Communicate architecture decisions, delivery implications, technical risks, and business value clearly to executive and technical audiences.
Reusable Solutions & Innovation
Develop reusable solution blueprints, accelerators, and integration patterns that improve consistency, reduce delivery effort, and support repeatable client outcomes.
Assess opportunities to simplify application portfolios and modernize legacy solutions, balancing reuse and standardization with business-specific requirements.
Evaluate analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions through business cases and proofs of value, addressing data readiness, security, responsible use, and operational feasibility.
Qualifications
Education & Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
12+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, enterprise integration, or data platforms, including ownership of complex enterprise solution designs.
5+ years of architecture or engineering people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or technical leads across multiple programs or engagements.
Technical Expertise
Deep experience designing solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including hybrid integration, deployment models, resilience, and cost considerations.
Strong expertise in application architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, enterprise integration patterns, and the trade-offs between distributed and simpler architectures.
Strong understanding of data architecture, including transactional systems, data warehouses or lakehouses, data pipelines, master data, and analytics integration.
Experience producing architecture models, interface specifications, decision records, and non-functional requirements; familiarity with frameworks or methods such as TOGAF, C4, or ArchiMate.
Expertise in secure solution design, identity and access management, data protection, and enterprise governance, with working knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational support.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will assist in food preparation and cooking under the supervision of senior chefs. As a Commis III , you re not just preparing great tasting food items - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

Minimum 1 year of experience as a Cook or Trainee in a 5-star hotel or high-standard restaurant.
Basic knowledge of Western or Chinese cuisine.
Ability to remain calm and problem-solve under pressure.
Comfortable working in hot, humid, and noisy kitchen environments.
Strong teamwork and communication skills.
Willingness to learn and follow kitchen procedures and hygiene standards.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Prepare high-quality dishes: Prepare menu items according to designated recipes and quality standards
Delight our guests: Manage guest orders efficiently while ensuring a positive dining experience
Execute complex recipes: Maintain a strong knowledge of menu offerings, handle complex recipes, and oversee stations, execution, quality control, and inventory checks
Inspect and finalize plates: Inspect all preparations and dishes ahead of serving to ensure they meet quality and presentation standards
Maintain a clean and organized workspace: Keep food service stations stocked and sanitary while following proper food handling, storage, and safety protocols
Manage inventory needs: Prepare requisitions for supplies and food items as needed
Comply with regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member well-being

Description:
F&B and Event Service Expert
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table or serving guests during a banquet or event.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our F&B Service Experts is skilled in a wide range of event functions and able to take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests experience is well taken care of from start to finish.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a proactive and analytical Problem Manager - Core Domain to join our L1 NOC (Network Operations Center) team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and managing recurring network problems within the Core network domain, driving root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent fixes to minimize network disruptions. You will work closely with L1, L2, and L3 technical teams, service management stakeholders, and customer teams to ensure problem resolution aligns with SLA commitments and continual service improvement goals. This is a key role in strengthening operational stability and delivering a superior network experience for Ericssons customers.
What You Will Do
Own end-to-end problem lifecycle management for Core network domain incidents
Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and major incidents
Identify problem trends through incident data analysis and proactive problem detection
Raise and manage Problem Records in the ITSM ticketing system (ServiceNow / BMC Remedy / JIRA)
Drive Known Error identification and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB) Coordination & Escalation
Collaborate with L1 NOC, L2, and L3 teams to facilitate timely problem investigation and resolution
Coordinate with Core network engineers, field teams, and vendor support for problem closure
Escalate critical or unresolved problems to senior technical leads and management as per the escalation matrix
Interface with the customer / client teams for problem status updates and post-incident reviews
Prepare and deliver high-quality RCA reports and Problem Management reports to internal and external stakeholders
Document workarounds, known errors, and resolution steps in the knowledge base
Maintain accurate problem logs, closure reports, and trend analysis records
Support audit and compliance activities with relevant documentation
Continual Service Improvement (CSI)
Analyze problem trends and recurring fault patterns to identify improvement opportunities
Work with operations and technical teams to implement preventive actions and process improvements
Contribute to SLA performance improvement initiatives and reduction of repeat incidents
Participate in service review meetings and provide problem management inputs
What You Will Bring
Good understanding of Core network technologies - IMS, VoLTE, EPC, 4G/5G Core, CS Core, MSS, MGW, HLR/HSS
Familiarity with telecom network architecture and end-to-end service flow in Core domain
Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA
Understanding of alarm monitoring platforms and NMS/EMS tools
Working knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes
Experience & Qualifications
7-15 years of experience in telecom network operations, with at least 5 years in a Problem Management or senior NOC role
Hands-on experience in Core domain fault management, incident analysis, or network support
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns across large incident datasets
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder reporting and RCA documentation
Bachelors degree in Engineering (Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science) or equivalent
Preferred Qualifications
ITIL Foundation Certification (v3 or v4) preferred
Exposure to 24x7 NOC operations environment
Prior experience in Managed Services / Network Operations for a telecom operator or OEM
All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification

Job Summary
You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
In line with EY commitment to quality, you'll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.
Your Key Responsibilities
Lead enterprise-scale SAP Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, and analytics transformation programs, defining architecture, governance, integration, and modern data engineering practices across SAP and non-SAP landscapes.
Lead BDC and Datasphere architecture strategy for global S/4HANA transformation programs.
Design enterprise data products, semantic models, data fabric, and analytical architectures.
Define integration patterns between SAP S/4HANA, Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, BW/4HANA, and non-SAP platforms.
Lead workshops, requirement gathering, fit-gap analysis, and solution roadmaps.
Drive data governance, security, cataloging, lineage, and data quality initiatives.
Provide architecture governance and oversee delivery teams during implementation.
Guide migration from SAP BW/BW4HANA to SAP Business Data Cloud and Datasphere.
Support testing, cutover, deployment planning, hypercare, and operational readiness.
Mentor architects and consultants and support business development activities.
SAP Business Data Cloud & Git-Based DevOps Expertise
Strong expertise in S/4HANA to SAP Business Data Cloud integration using GitHub/GitLab driven approaches.
Automated extraction: SAP Datasphere artifacts exported as machine-readable definitions using SAP Datasphere CLI and automation scripts.
Version control: Artifact definitions and deployment scripts maintained in central GitLab repositories for traceability and controlled change management.
CI/CD deployment: GitLab pipelines export artifacts from source environments and deploy approved versions into target SAP Datasphere spaces/tenants through SAP Datasphere CLI.
Define DevOps operating models, release governance, branching strategies, and automated deployment frameworks.
Skills and Attributes for Success
SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC)
SAP Datasphere
SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
SAP bw/4hana
SAP S/4HANA Embedded Analytics
Data Modeling and Data Products
SAP Integration Suite
Data Governance and Metadata Management
GitHub/GitLab DevOps and CI/CD
SQL, Data Engineering and Data Virtualization
Ideally, You'll Also Have
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
SAP Business Data Could, SAP Datasphere, SAC, BW/4HANA, or related SAP certifications.
Experience in RISE with SAP and cloud modernization programs.
What We Look For
12+ years of SAP experience with 5+ years in SAP Datasphere/Business Data Cloud architecture roles.
At least 3 end-to-end SAP transformation or analytics modernization programs.
Experience leading global architecture teams and stakeholder discussions at executive level.
Strong consulting, solutioning, pre-sales, and delivery leadership capabilities.
Experience working with multinational clients and distributed delivery teams.

Job Summary
DE NCLC Manager - Technology Consulting
EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant Senior with strong subject matter expertise in SharePoint, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex modernization. The role will lead teams delivering large Microsoft 365 migration and modernization programs for clients across regions.
Your key responsibilities
Lead Microsoft 365 migration and modernization projects across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, workflows and forms.
Provide technical leadership for SharePoint Online, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations, Nintex and Power Platform.
Define the delivery approach, estimates, migration waves, resourcing, governance and quality controls.
Lead assessments, identify risks and dependencies, and develop practical migration roadmaps.
Guide migration factory setup, pilots, wave execution, cutover and transition.
Oversee Nintex workflow and form modernization using Nintex Automation Cloud or Power Platform.
Review solution designs, migration plans, remediation approaches and deployment documents.
Lead delivery teams, remove blockers, monitor progress and maintain quality.
Manage client, security, Microsoft and vendor stakeholders, decisions and dependencies.
Support proposals, demonstrations, estimates, staffing plans and executive presentations.
Promote reusable methods, automation and continuous improvement.
Ensure compliance with security, quality, organizational and commercial requirements.
Skills and attributes
4-7 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
Strong SME-level knowledge of SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server, SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft 365 architecture.
Proven experience planning and delivering large Microsoft 365 migration programs involving SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
Experience with migration assessment, remediation, migration factory operations, wave planning, velocity management, cutover and hypercare.
Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.
Good to have Skills
Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
Relevant Microsoft, Nintex, project management or agile certifications.
Soft Skills
Ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing teams across locations.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.
Sound decision-making and problem-solving in complex situations.
Ability to manage scope, schedules, risks, quality and competing priorities.
Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.
Ability to review technical deliverables, challenge assumptions and guide consultants and engineers.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelors or masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a professional services or consulting organization.
Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.
Experience developing estimates, delivery plans, governance and stakeholder communications.
Ideally, you ll also have
Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
Led large-scale Microsoft 365 migration or modernization projects from discovery through transition.
Managed multidisciplinary teams covering migration, development, workflow modernization, testing and change activities.
Contributed to proposals, solutioning, capability development and client relationship growth.
