Description:
The Team Leader - ESSCO will spearhead the sales team s efforts to position Essco as a leading brand in the value market segment. This role requires strategic oversight and hands-on management to drive revenue growth across Essco s product lines, including faucets, sanitaryware, cisterns, and H.W.S. The Team Leader will take personal ownership of key Regional Distributors (RDs), ensure effective training of the sales team, and achieve substantial dealer growth. This role is pivotal in executing market strategies, enhancing dealer performance, and leading a high-performing team to meet and exceed targets.
Key Responsibilities
Sales Team Performance: Oversee and drive the performance of the Essco sales team to meet or exceed revenue targets across all product lines: ESSCO Faucets, ESSCO Sanitaryware, ESSCO Cisterns, and ESSCO H.W.S.
Key Account Management: Take personal ownership of select top RDs, ensuring they meet their sales targets and contribute to overall revenue performance
RSD Management: Manage and coordinate with Regional Sub-Distributors (RSDs) to ensure alignment with sales strategies and optimal performance
RD Recruitment & Selection: Identify and recruit suitable Regional Distributors (RDs) in consultation with the HOD/ZH
Dealer Growth: Drive dealer growth, ensuring a minimum of 85% of the dealer universe shows measurable expansion and increased productivity
Sales Team Training: Conduct and oversee targeted training sessions for the RD/RDS sales team to enhance their skills and performance, ensuring all training goals are met
Market Development: Develop and implement strategies to expand Essco s market presence, including penetrating new markets and increasing the brand s footprint in existing areas
Performance Monitoring: Monitor and analyze sales performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions as needed
Dealer Relations: Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers to foster growth, resolve issues, and enhance dealer satisfaction
Reporting: Provide regular reports to senior management on sales performance, market trends, and team progress, including insights and recommendations for strategic adjustments
Operational Efficiency: Ensure efficient and effective execution of sales operations, including compliance with company policies, pricing strategies, and promotional activities
Brand Visibility and Hygiene: Maintain high standards of brand visibility and hygiene across all dealer showrooms and points of sale
Issue Resolution and Coordination: Address and resolve any issues related to supplies, sales policies, and customer care in coordination with the relevant departments
Market Analysis: Conduct market surveys and analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement
Inventory Management: Ensure effective inventory management and supply chain operations to meet market demands
Promotional Activities: Lead the implementation of promotional activities and marketing campaigns to boost brand visibility and sales
Dealer and Customer Pipeline: Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of potential new dealers and customers
Compliance and Ethics: Ensure compliance with company policies and ethical standards in all business operations
OC & Factory Visits: Plan and facilitate visits to Orientation Centers (OCs) and the factory for potential external customers
Supply & Sales Issue Resolution: Address and resolve issues related to supplies, sales, and customer care for dealers and specifiers
Key Attributes
Proven ability to lead and motivate a sales team to achieve and exceed targets
Strong understanding of the building materials industry
Demonstrated success in managing key accounts and driving dealer growth
Effective training and development skills with a focus on enhancing team performance
Strategic thinking with the ability to implement tactical plans for market expansion and revenue growth
Strong analytical skills for monitoring performance and identifying improvement opportunities
Competencies
Customer Focus
Negotiation Skills
Presentation Skills
Competitor Analysis and Market Development
Qualifications and Experience
Education:
Bachelor s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field
An MBA or equivalent is preferred
Experience:
10-12 years of experience in sales within the building materials industry or a related sector
3-4 years of experience in a team leadership or managerial role, with a proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving team performance
Skills:
Excellent leadership and team management skills
Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
Proficiency in strategic planning and execution
Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive decision-making
Effective training and mentoring skills
Proactive problem-solving attitude and adaptability
Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills

Conduct at least 180 productive meetings monthly with external customers
Generate CBS revenue from government institutions
Monitor and keep track of competitors activities

Description:
Ways of Working -

Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

About the Team -

Swiggy Dineout is building Indias largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

Role Summary -

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities -

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently. Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned. Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business. Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc. Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner. Interaction with

Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV) Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel -

Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills -

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life. Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility:

Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative:

Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

SUMMARY
SAP FICO Finance Consultant

Role Summary
We are currently recruiting an experienced SAP FI/CO Consultant with 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions. The successful candidate will exhibit strong functional expertise in core Financial Accounting and Controlling modules, alongside a thorough understanding of system integrations. This professional will be responsible for translating intricate business requirements into streamlined and efficient SAP configurations.

Location: Singhitarai/Mansa/Nellore

Experience: 5-10 years
Key Responsibilities
Direct and manage the full lifecycle of SAP S/4HANA initiatives, ranging from fresh implementations and global expansions to system upgrades and continuous support.
Execute configuration and customization tasks for SAP FI/CO modules, encompassing General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting (BL) for FI; and Cost Center Accounting (CCA), Internal Orders (IO), Profit Center Accounting (PCA), and Product Costing (PC) for CO.
Analyze business needs to design and structure effective financial processes and corresponding SAP solutions.
Collaborate closely with finance teams and technical experts to ensure the successful deployment of business requirements.
Manage the integration between FI/CO and other SAP functional areas, including Materials Management (MM), Sales and Distribution (SD), Production Planning (PP), and Plant Maintenance (PM).
Provide production support by diagnosing issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions.
Draft functional specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms using tools such as IDOCs, BAPIs, and User Exits.
Develop test cases, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and generate comprehensive documentation and training materials for end - users.
Supervise project deliverables, assist various workstreams, and offer guidance and mentorship to junior consultants.

Requirements
Hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field.
Demonstrate 5 to 8 years of specialized experience in SAP FI/CO consulting.
Have successfully led or participated in at least one end-to-end SAP implementation project.
Possess mandatory hands-on proficiency with SAP S/4HANA Finance.
Show in-depth knowledge of S/4HANA features, including New General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Parallel Accounting, and Document Splitting.
Exhibit advanced configuration capabilities in at least three FI/CO sub - modules.
Maintain a solid understanding of accounting standards and core financial business processes.
Have practical experience with integration points linking SAP SD, MM, and other logistics modules.
Possess a proven track record of creating functional specifications for custom developments, reporting, interfaces, and system enhancements.
Display strong analytical skills, problem-solving abilities, effective communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Preferred Skills
Hold a valid SAP S/4HANA Finance certification.
Have prior experience working with Central Finance.
Demonstrate familiarity with SAP Group Reporting or BPC (Business Planning and Consolidation).
Have exposure to SAP Fiori Finance applications.
Possess experience within consulting agencies or client-facing roles.
Understand Agile and Scrum methodologies.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Ensure timely pickup and delivery of shipments within the assigned service area.
Collect shipments from customers/sellers and deliver them safely to the respective destinations.
Perform scanning and updating shipment status accurately through the assigned mobile application.
Ensure proper Cash on Delivery (COD) collection and deposit the collected amount as per company process.
Verify shipment details, address, customer information, and delivery instructions before completing deliveries.
Handle shipments carefully and ensure zero damage, loss, or misrouting.
Maintain regular communication with customers and provide professional service during pickup and delivery.
Follow the assigned route, daily targets, SLA/TAT, and productivity requirements.
Report delivery issues such as customer unavailability, wrong address, shipment mismatch, or failed delivery to the concerned team.
Maintain the vehicle properly and follow all road safety, company SOP, compliance, and discipline requirements.


Interested Candidates please contact : 80192 22821 Fathima HR
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Job description
Role & responsibilities
Customer Engagement & Experience
Greet customers, understand their needs, and provide personalized product recommendations.
Explain product features, specifications, benefits, pricing, and available offers.
Ensure a positive shopping experience and build long-term customer relationships.
Product Demonstration & Sales
Demonstrate smartphones, laptops, tablets, smartwatches, accessories, and other digital products available in the store.
Recommend suitable products based on customer requirements and budget.
Achieve assigned sales, revenue, product-category, and accessory attachment targets.
Promote cross-selling and upselling to improve average bill value and overall sales productivity.
Product & Market Knowledge
Maintain updated knowledge of product specifications, new launches, competitor offerings, and market trends.
Understand product pricing, financing options, exchange programs, warranties, and promotional schemes.
Participate in product training and knowledge-enhancement sessions.
Digital Services & Customer Support
Assist customers with product setup, data transfer, basic device configuration, and application installation, wherever applicable.
Explain relevant digital services, extended warranties, protection plans, and other value-added services.
Support customers in understanding product usage and basic troubleshooting.
Sales Process & Billing Support
Follow the prescribed sales process, documentation requirements, and customer verification procedures.
Coordinate with the billing team to ensure accurate billing and smooth order processing.
Explain applicable payment methods, EMI options, exchange benefits, and terms and conditions clearly to customers.
Store Operations & Merchandising
Maintain product displays, demo devices, price tags, promotional communication, and visual merchandising standards.
Ensure products and accessories are properly displayed and demo units are functional.
Monitor stock availability and coordinate with the Store Leader for replenishment.
Follow company guidelines for inventory handling, product security, and store hygiene.
Customer Relationship Management
Inform customers about relevant offers, product launches, and services through approved communication channels.
Support customer feedback collection and resolution of queries or complaints.
Encourage repeat purchases, referrals, and customer loyalty.
Compliance & Performance Management
Adhere to company policies, standard operating procedures, and ethical sales practices.
Ensure accurate product information and transparent communication of prices, offers, and warranty terms.
Track individual performance against assigned KPIs and take corrective actions where required.
Support the Store Leader in achieving store-level business objectives.
Preferred candidate profile
Candidates from Retail Sales and Electronics background will be preferred

Product Range: Smartphones, laptops, consumer electronics, and accessories.
Customer Experience: Personalized assistance and product demonstrations.
Sales & Productivity: Achieving sales targets through cross-selling and upselling.
Digital Solutions: Helping customers explore relevant digital products and services.
Operational Excellence: Maintaining product availability, merchandising standards, and compliance with company processes.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Perform preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of injection moulding machines.
Troubleshoot mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and pneumatic systems of injection moulding machines.
Identify and resolve machine breakdowns to minimize production downtime.
Maintain hydraulic pumps, motors, cylinders, valves, heaters, thermocouples, and control systems.
Handle maintenance of clamping units, injection units, screw and barrel assemblies.
Monitor and maintain hydraulic pressure, temperature controllers, cooling systems, and machine operating parameters.
Perform regular inspection and servicing of injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.
Troubleshoot and maintain mould temperature controllers, chillers, cooling towers, compressors, and material dryers.
Maintain machine maintenance records, breakdown reports, and preventive maintenance checklists.
Analyze recurring machine failures and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Coordinate with production and quality teams to ensure uninterrupted manufacturing operations.
Ensure spare parts availability and maintain maintenance inventory.
Implement TPM, 5S, and continuous improvement activities.
Ensure compliance with machine safety standards and maintenance procedures.

Preferred candidate profile
Diploma / B.E / B.Tech in EEE.
5 to 8 years of experience in maintenance of plastic injection moulding machines.
Hands-on experience in troubleshooting hydraulic, pneumatic, mechanical, and electrical systems.
Good knowledge of injection moulding machine operations and maintenance procedures.
Experience with preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, and machine servicing.
Knowledge of PLC-controlled injection moulding machines will be an added advantage.
Experience in maintaining auxiliary equipment such as chillers, compressors, dryers, and mould temperature controllers.
Ability to identify machine faults and minimize production downtime.
Good troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Role & responsibilities
Handle alloy development, alloy composition control, and metallurgical process optimization.
Expertise in non-ferrous metals such as Aluminium, Copper, Zinc, Brass, Bronze, and their alloys.
Monitor and control melting, alloying, degassing, fluxing, and casting processes.
Ensure proper chemical composition and metallurgical properties of finished products.
Conduct and analyze spectrometer testing and chemical composition reports.
Perform metallurgical investigations, failure analysis, and root cause analysis.
Optimize alloying practices to improve product quality and reduce material wastage.
Monitor furnace operations, metal recovery, melt quality, and process parameters.
Coordinate with Production, Quality Control, and R&D departments.
Develop and implement process improvements for better productivity and cost efficiency.
Ensure compliance with metallurgical specifications, quality standards, and customer requirements.
Prepare metallurgical reports, process documentation, and technical specifications.
Support new product development, alloy trials, and process validation.
Guide and technically support junior metallurgical engineers and production teams.

B.E / B.Tech / Diploma in Metallurgical Engineering.
5 to 10 years of relevant experience in non-ferrous metallurgy and alloy manufacturing.
Strong hands-on experience in alloying, metal melting, and non-ferrous metal processing.
Practical knowledge of Aluminum, Copper, Brass, Bronze, Zinc, or other non-ferrous alloys.
Experience in chemical composition control and spectrometer operation.
Knowledge of melting furnaces, casting processes, degassing, and fluxing techniques.
Ability to troubleshoot metallurgical defects and improve alloy quality.
Strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in handling production teams and coordinating with quality departments.

Area

Description:
Job Title: Project Manager - Civil Engineering


Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of high-rise and commercial building projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in civil engineering, excellent leadership skills, and a proven track record of managing complex construction projects from inception to completion.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Planning: Develop detailed project plans, including scope, timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.
Execution: Lead the execution of construction activities, ensuring adherence to project specifications, safety standards, and quality control.
Team Management: Supervise and coordinate the activities of project teams, including engineers, architects, and subcontractors.
Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, stakeholders, and regulatory bodies, providing regular updates on project status.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize project delays and cost overruns.
Budget Management: Monitor project budgets, ensuring financial accountability and adherence to cost estimates.
Quality Assurance: Ensure that all work meets industry standards and complies with local regulations and building codes.
Documentation: Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including contracts, change orders, and progress reports.

Qualifications:

Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
years of experience in project management within the construction industry, specifically with high-rise and commercial buildings.
Proven experience with project management software and tools.
Strong understanding of construction methods, materials, and legal regulations.
Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Professional certification (e.g., PMP, LEED) is a plus.

Benefits:

Competitive salary and performance bonuses.
Health, dental, and retirement benefits.
Opportunities for professional development and training.

Description:
About the Project
TSMG is looking for Quality control specialists to support an AI language project focused on improving speech recognition systems.
As a QC contributor, you will review completed language annotation tasks and ensure that AI-generated transcripts have been accurately converted into natural, readable display text according to the project guidelines. You will focus on identifying and correcting formatting, punctuation, capitalization, and text normalization issues.
What You Will Do
Review completed Display Transcription tasks for accuracy and consistency.
Compare the Display Transcription against the original lexical transcript and project guidelines.
Verify the correct use of:
punctuation;
capitalization;
numbers, dates, times, and currencies;
abbreviations and other text normalization rules.
Ensure that the original words and meaning have been preserved.
Identify and correct formatting or guideline-related errors.
Use the reference audio when necessary to verify ambiguous cases.
Apply project-specific quality standards consistently.
Provide accurate feedback and flag recurring issues when required.
Complete assigned QC tasks within project deadlines and productivity targets.
Requirements
Excellent written skills in the target language.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Good understanding of punctuation, capitalization, and written language conventions.
Ability to identify inconsistencies and errors in formatted text.
Ability to follow detailed guidelines and apply them consistently.
Basic computer skills and a reliable internet connection.
Ability to work independently and meet quality and productivity targets.
Previous experience in transcription, proofreading, quality control, annotation, or linguistic projects is a plus.
Training and project guidelines will be provided before the project starts.
What We Offer
Opportunity to contribute to the development of AI and speech recognition technologies.
Flexible project-based work.
Clear guidelines and training before starting.
The opportunity to gain experience in AI language data and quality control projects.

Designation: Commercial Manager

Position description: As a Commercial Manager, your main goal is to lead your team, drive sales, and manage the store's overall performance. Your key responsibilities include:

Primary Responsibilities:
1. Team Leadership:

? Build a Strong Team: Develop a motivated and high-performing team that is committed to achieving goals.

? Lead by Example: Encourage your team and create opportunities to boost sales through positive leadership.

? Manage Performance: Oversee Section Managers and store staff, offering guidance and coaching to improve performance.

2. Sales Store Operations:

? Drive Sales: Promote sales growth by analyzing trends like footfall, customer conversion rates, and average purchase value (UPT).

? Achieve Sales Targets: Ensure the store meets its sales targets and adjust strategies when needed to stay on track.

? Seasonal Planning: Make sure the store is prepared for seasonal events and has the right staffing levels in place.

3. Store Presentation Competition:

? Implement Brand Guidelines: Follow and enforce guidelines for visual merchandising (VM) and marketing to maintain the brand image.

? Stay Competitive: Keep an eye on local competitors and take steps to gain an advantage in your market.

4. Customer Experience:

? Connect with Customers: Build strong relationships with customers by understanding their needs and preferences.

? Respond to Feedback: Listen to feedback from both customers and staff, and share valuable insights with relevant departments for improvement.



5. Stock Management Operations:

? Efficient Stock Management: Ensure smooth and accurate stock processes to keep the store well-organized and prepared.

6. Staff Engagement Communication:

? Regular Briefings: Keep your team updated with regular meetings, sharing important information and recognizing their achievements.

? Employee Development: Provide timely feedback to help your team improve and conduct performance appraisals to track growth.

Job Description
Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500 cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation.
Built on the back of robust ML technology and fueled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming a logistics hub of excellence today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
With Swiggys New Supply and the recent launches of Swiggy Instamart, Swiggy Genie, and Guiltfree, we are consistently making waves in the market, while continually growing the opportunities we offer our people.
Job Responsibilities:
Initiate partnerships with new accounts and actively manage existing relationships, being their P.O.C. for Swiggy Sustaining and growing the relationships which translates to a growth in revenue for the city
Maintaining a strong relationship with restaurant owners (Specifically Key Accounts of the City Country) and advising them on issues related to the market and offering solutions on the same
Conduct promotional events marketing activation, primarily BTL, in conjunction with the internal teams Manage the sales administration function, and operational performance reporting, streamlining processes and systems wherever possible and advising senior management on maximizing business relationships and creating an environment where customer service can flourish, also managing a huge team
Responsible for training new recruits, especially Sales Managers, and mentoring them
Desired Skill Set:
Graduate with 5-6 years of experience in Business Development, Sales or Account Management
A competent decision-maker with the ability to develop, own and build a strategic plan for ensuring the best restaurants partner with us
Effective communication skills with Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life Should be able to lead and mentor the team
Identifies builds and uses a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach
Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions. Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence for change to increase the effectiveness and success on campaigns
Creativity Initiative - demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward Qualifications
Graduate with 4-6 years of experience in Business Development, Sales or Account Management

Job Location : Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Pune (PCMC Area), Nagpur, Indore, Bangalore, Mumbai, Guwahati, Ludhiana

Products Segment - Vascular, Aneasthesia, Neonates, Vascular, Hemodynamics , Critical Care,
Role Overview:
The Territory Executive will be responsible for driving sales growth within the assigned territory by identifying new business opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and promoting the company's product portfolio.

Key Responsibilities -
Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers, including hospitals, nursing homes, healthcare institutions, and distributors.
Promote and demonstrate company products to healthcare professionals and key decision-makers.
Generate product demand through regular field visits and customer engagement activities.
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to territory revenue growth.
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with doctors, surgeons, nursing staff, purchase managers, biomedical teams, OT technicians, and other key stakeholders.
Provide product-related training, demonstrations, and support to customers.
Ensure consistent follow-up with existing customers to strengthen business
Ensure timely secondary sales generation and coordinate with internal teams for efficient order processing and product delivery.
Monitor inventory availability and support demand forecasting activities.
Follow up on outstanding payments and ensure timely collections in line with company policies.
Maintain accurate sales records and submit periodic sales and market reports as required.

Preferred candidate profile -
Minimum 4 years experience in sales of Medical Devices / Pharma industry.
Experience working with specialists such as Anesthesiologists, Pediatricians, Neonatologists, Oncologists, and Surgeons will be preferred.
Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.

Role & responsibilities
The Sales Executive shall be responsible for promoting and selling solar power solutions offered by Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd., with a primary focus on residential rooftop solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, along with commercial and industrial solar projects.

Preferred candidate profile
A minimum Class XII pass candidate with good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to generate leads and develop customer relationships in the solar power sector.

Annual Bonus: Annual bonus as per company policy and applicable eligibility criteria.
Travel Allowance (TA): Travel expenses for authorised official visits and sales activities, as per company policy.
Daily Allowance (DA): Daily allowance for eligible official travel and field assignments, subject to applicable company rules.

Perks and benefits
Food allowance, Annual bonus
AboutCompany:
GIBBON INFRASTRUCTURES PVT. LTD.
Company Profile
Renewable Energy | Solar Power Solutions | Civil Construction & Infrastructure Development
1. About the Company
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. is an infrastructure and renewable energy company engaged in the solar power industry since 2021, alongside civil construction and infrastructure development activities. The company is committed to delivering reliable, technically sound, and cost-effective solutions that address the growing demand for sustainable energy and quality infrastructure.
With a focus on professional project execution, customer satisfaction, and responsible business practices, the company undertakes solar power installations and civil construction works for residential, commercial, institutional, and other project requirements.
Through its presence in the renewable energy sector and its involvement in construction activities, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. aims to contribute to India's clean energy transition and infrastructure development.
2. Solar Power & Renewable Energy Division
Since 2021, the company has been engaged in solar power solutions, supporting the adoption of renewable energy through rooftop solar installations and commercial solar projects. Its activities include project planning, system supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated technical services.
The company undertakes solar projects across a range of capacities, from 3 kW residential rooftop systems to large-scale projects of up to 100 MW, subject to project scope and technical requirements.
Key Areas of Expertise
Residential rooftop solar power systems.
Solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.
Commercial and industrial solar power projects.
On-grid, hybrid, and off-grid solar solutions.
Solar photovoltaic (PV) system design and installation.
Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of solar systems.
Solar project coordination and technical support.
Assistance with project documentation and relevant utility coordination.
The company works with solar equipment brands including Premier, Pahal, Adani, Vikram Solar, INA, Microtek, and Citizen, subject to project specifications and availability.
3. Civil Construction & Infrastructure Division
In addition to renewable energy, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. undertakes civil construction and infrastructure-related works. The company recognises the importance of sound engineering practices, proper planning, quality materials, and efficient execution in delivering durable and dependable infrastructure.
Scope of Activities
Civil construction and building works.
Plain Cement Concrete (PCC) and Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) works.
Structural and allied construction activities.
Site preparation and development.
Foundation and related civil works.
Construction support for solar power installations.
Other civil and infrastructure works as per project specifications.
The company seeks to execute projects in accordance with applicable technical requirements, contractual obligations, safety practices, and agreed project schedules.
4. Our Vision
To establish Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. as a trusted organisation in renewable energy and infrastructure development by delivering sustainable solutions, maintaining professional standards, and creating long-term value for clients and stakeholders.
5. Our Mission
To promote the adoption of clean and renewable energy.
To deliver reliable and efficient solar power solutions.
To undertake civil construction works with a focus on quality and durability.
To maintain transparency, accountability, and professionalism in business operations.
To develop long-term relationships through customer satisfaction and dependable project delivery.
To contribute to sustainable development through responsible construction and energy solutions.
6. Our Core Values
Quality: Maintaining appropriate standards in materials, workmanship, and project execution.
Integrity: Conducting business with transparency, accountability, and ethical practices.
Reliability: Focusing on dependable solutions and professional service delivery.
Safety: Promoting safe working practices across project sites and operations.
Sustainability: Supporting renewable energy adoption and environmentally responsible development.
Customer Focus: Understanding client requirements and providing solutions aligned with project objectives.
7. Our Approach to Project Execution
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. follows a project-oriented approach based on understanding client requirements, planning resources, coordinating technical activities, and executing works in accordance with agreed specifications.
For solar projects, the approach may cover site assessment, system design, equipment selection, installation, testing, commissioning, and associated documentation. For civil construction projects, the approach focuses on work planning, material and resource coordination, construction quality, site safety, and timely completion.
8. Commitment to Sustainable Development
The company recognises the growing role of renewable energy and dependable infrastructure in economic and social development. By operating across solar power and civil construction, Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. seeks to support energy efficiency, infrastructure improvement, and sustainable growth.
The company remains committed to strengthening its capabilities, developing professional partnerships, and delivering value-driven solutions for its clients.
9. Conclusion
Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd. combines its experience in the solar power industry since 2021 with its involvement in civil construction and infrastructure works. Through a commitment to quality, technical competence, responsible execution, and customer satisfaction, the company aims to build lasting relationships and contribute meaningfully to India's renewable energy and infrastructure sectors.
GIBBON INFRASTRUCTURES PVT. LTD.
Powering a Sustainable Future. Building Infrastructure for Tomorrow.

Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.

About the team:
QR & Soundbox is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

Expectations/ Requirements:
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.

7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role:
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us:
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:
Graduate/Post Graduate.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

Description:
.Role & responsibilities:
Inpatient and Outpatient Care: Conduct daily hospital rounds in general wards and Intensive Care Units (ICUs) to manage acutely or chronically ill patients.
Diagnosis and Evaluation: Diagnose conditions such as Acute Kidney Injury (AKI), Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), Glomerulonephritis, Nephrotic Syndrome, and diabetic/hypertensive nephropathy.
Renal Procedures: Perform and supervise procedures including diagnostic kidney biopsies, temporary/permanent dialysis catheter placements, and AV fistula evaluations.
Dialysis Management: Oversee and prescribe Hemodialysis, Peritoneal Dialysis, and Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT) for critical care patients.
Kidney Transplantation: Evaluate donors and recipients, manage pre-transplant workups, and provide long-term post-transplant immunosuppressive and medical care.
Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with urologists, critical care specialists, renal dietitians, and transplant surgeons to deliver comprehensive care.
Consultations: Provide expert renal consultations to emergency, cardiology, and other hospital departments

Preferred candidate profile
Education: MBBS followed by an MD/DNB in General Medicine, culminating in a super-specialty DM (Nephrology) degree (or equivalent Fellowship/DNB Nephrology).
Licensure: Valid state medical council registration and active board certification/specialty recognition.
Skills: High-level clinical decision-making, procedural competency (biopsies, dialysis access), emergency resuscitation skills for severe electrolyte/acid-base crises, and patient/family communication.

Description:
Position: Area Sales Manager (Depot In-charge)
Function: Retail
Location: Guwahati (Lower Assam)
Department: Sales

Role Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to lead and manage the sales operations of a dedicated Depot within a specified territory. The ASM will be responsible for driving the sales volume, value, and growth targets by leading and motivating a team of frontline sales personnel. You will be instrumental in expanding the retail distribution network, tracking competitive activities, and monitoring local market trends to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. The ASM will also have full accountability for the performance of the Depot and will oversee its day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Performance & Target Achievement:
Lead and manage the sales operations of a single Depot, ensuring the achievement of monthly and annual sales targets (volume and value).
Develop and implement effective sales strategies and action plans to drive growth in the territory.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions as necessary to meet business goals.
Foster a high-performance culture within the sales team, setting clear objectives and expectations.
Team Management & Development:
Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of frontline sales personnel, ensuring optimal performance and development of team members.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and training to improve sales effectiveness.
Build a strong, cohesive team with a focus on collaboration and achieving sales targets.
Market Analysis & Competitor Tracking:
Continuously monitor the local market landscape and competitor activities to identify trends and business opportunities.
Provide insights to senior management regarding market changes and competitive strategies.
Analyze sales data and market trends to adjust sales strategies accordingly.
Distribution Network Expansion & Management:
Identify opportunities for expanding the retail distribution network within the territory.
Develop and implement effective distribution management schemes to maximize coverage and penetration.
Ensure the optimal allocation and management of resources within the Depot.
Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Act as a liaison between customers and the organization, addressing their needs and concerns proactively.

Professional Qualifications:
Essential:
Bachelors degree (Graduate)/MBA (Marketing)

Experience Requirements:
10-12 years of hands-on experience in sales management through a channel network, preferably within the paints, building materials, tyre or related industries.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in a highly competitive market.
Strong experience in managing a sales team and Depot operations independently.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Age Range: 30-35 years

Personality Traits:
Dynamic and Goal-Oriented: Able to work in a fast-paced environment with a focus on results and business growth.
Strong Leadership and Managerial Skills: A natural leader with the ability to inspire and manage teams effectively.
Customer-Centric: Excellent interpersonal skills with a customer-first approach to sales and service.
Analytical Thinker: Strong ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive informed decisions.
Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with various departments.

Description:
Account Manager Wireline Services

Do you want to be part of a diverse Account team, and propel growth across our Baker Hughes Wireline Business

Are you excited to win business and develop strategies
Join our Baker Hughes Wireline Account team!
Our Wireline division, a Baker Hughes business, has been supporting industries for over 100 years, celebrating many successes and first to market innovations along the way. Our Account team ensures our innovative products perform safely and efficiently, for all our customers. We deliver state of the art solutions time and time again that provide exemplary functionality and high-level technical support.

In Baker Hughes Wireline we strive to change energy, meeting the world s growing demand for energy, and the world s demands for energy to be cleaner, safer and more efficient. Our Wireline technologies help industry advance on the path to net-zero and to a sustainable energy future.
Partner with the best
Job Title: Account Manager, Wireline Services
The Account Manager will be a customer facing role, responsible for winning business within the end user and projects space in India.
They will develop a customer interface roadmap with a short, medium, and long-term perspective but also with the intensity of turning leads into actual orders. This is a unique role to contribute to real opportunities, with real solutions and real equipment.
As the Account Manager, you will be reporting to Country Sales Manager- India, and will be responsible for:
Growing Wireline Business in Northeastern part of India.
Positioning the Baker Hughes Wireline business as a critical Wireline partner for all customer present in region.
Leading account (End Users, EPCs, OEMs, Licensors) engagement and strategy.
Leading Billing and collection to ensure cash flow.
Managing and developing a solid pipeline of end user and project opportunities.
Executing on assigned Account targets and driving Account growth.
Providing regional market intelligence, competitive intelligence, and customer intelligence within the designated area.
Reporting on all regional activities related to market awareness and new project updates.
Negotiating contracts in collaboration with the commercial operations and risk management teams, and proactively leading negotiations on the most significant aspects of the assigned opportunities.
Demonstrating commercial and technical expertise in the Wireline market and maintaining knowledge of the market trends and product needs.
Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:
Have a degree in an engineering discipline or similar, with work experience in the wireline business.
Have excellent technical knowledge of Wireline Services across all industry sectors.
Have excellent interpersonal and presentation skills.
Be able to communicate at all levels within the organization and effectively influence others without authority.
Have the ability to coordinate and negotiate across several projects
simultaneously with varying complexity.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills and be fluent in English.
This role requires on-site presence.
Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive
Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect.
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sales Senior Specialist - Key Accounts

About Lenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales

Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence

He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Responsible for providing short-term, specialized patient care, diagnostic monitoring, and minor surgical procedures that do not require overnight hospitalization.

Clinical & Patient Care
Outpatient Consultations (OPD): Conduct primary medical examinations, take comprehensive patient histories, and assess acute or chronic illnesses.
Daycare Management: Supervise and manage short-stay patients undergoing procedures like IV fluid therapies, chemotherapy sessions, dialysis, blood transfusions, or prolonged diagnostic monitoring.
Minor Procedures: Perform or assist in minor surgical or medical procedures such as wound suturing, dressings, incision and drainage (I&D), foreign body removal, and catheterization.
Diagnostic Interpretation: Order and evaluate basic clinical investigations (e.g., blood tests, X-rays, ECGs) to formulate quick and accurate treatment plans.
Emergency & Stabilization
Acute Care & Triage: Identify critical shifts in a patient's vital signs or general condition during their short stay.
Emergency Management: Administer first-line emergency medical care and stabilize patients experiencing sudden medical crises before coordinating transfers to higher care centers.
Operations & Administration
Multidisciplinary Liaison: Coordinate closely with nursing staff, specialist consultants, and administrators to ensure seamless patient care and timely discharges.
Medical Documentation: Maintain highly precise Electronic Medical Records (EMR), including admission notes, procedure records, drug charts, and discharge summaries.
Referrals & Follow-ups: Structure comprehensive discharge guidelines and schedule routine outpatient follow-up care.

Qualifications & Licensing
Degree: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) from a recognized medical council.
Licensure: Valid and active registration with the relevant State Medical Council or National Medical Commission (NMC)

Description:
About the Role

A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.

Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Responsible for availability of Raw Material & Components as per agreed delivery dates aligned to Production Schedule by effective vendor management and internal escalations.
To prepare the RM delivery schedule against Purchase Orders in alignment with the Production schedule based on supplier capacity in mind.

Vendor Management & Expediting
Drive proactive vendor engagement with a go-getter attitude to ensure timely deliveries.
Prepare and monitor scheduling lines post-PO release; align supplier schedules with plant requirements.
Track delivery performance, escalate critical delays, and ensure adherence to monthly supply plans.
Utilize Vendor Portal for streamlined communication and grievance resolution.
Collaborate with planning and plant teams to maintain safety stock and optimize storage utilization.
Develop and maintain procurement dashboards for performance tracking and reporting.

Operational Procurement & P2P Cycle

Process orders via SAP MM; manage both domestic and import purchases using various Incoterms.
Implement engineering change notifications (ECR/ECN) and manage rejection material disposal within defined timelines.

Ensure the Long Lead Time parts are well planned based on Season requirement
Supplier RM wise (ABS) monitoring and ensure uninterpreted supplies.

Inventory & Material Management
Manage raw material inventory and refine lead times based on plant requirements.
Measure and report RM/component availability against production plans.
FSN Analysis & Aging Inventory Analysis
Indirect Purchase (Opex/Capex) Experience.

Governance & Compliance
Ensure adherence to government norms related to taxation, safety, and environmental regulations.
Apply 5S, QC tools, and process control charts to enhance procurement operations.
Support corporate SCM initiatives across logistics, planning, strategic sourcing, and supplier development.
Desired Skills & Experience
Strong analytical and communication skills.
Exposure to vendor negotiations, import/export regulations, and compliance frameworks.
SAP End user skill level important
Must have experience in relevant Consumer durable /Appliance industry, handled Metals/Plastics/Packaging/Fabrication item.
Indirect purchase experience

Description:
GROWTH MANAGER
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Growth Manager plays a pivotal dual role at the intersection of new customer acquisition and long-term partner success. This role is responsible for driving expansion through data-driven sales and marketing strategies, while ensuring the deep engagement, retention, and growth of existing school partners. By combining the outreach excellence of an Area Manager with the relationship depth of a Customer Success Manager, the Growth Manager ensures that LEAD's mission of excellent education for every child is delivered - from the very first demo to sustained, on-ground academic impact.
ROLES RESPONSIBILITIES
Build and manage a strong sales pipeline; deliver compelling demos and close high-value school partnerships.
Align LEAD solutions to school owner needs; negotiate contracts and ensure seamless onboarding.
Collaborate with marketing for lead generation and stay updated on competitor and industry trends.
Manage and nurture existing partner schools to ensure strong, long-term relationships and satisfaction.
Grow base business revenue through targeted upsell and cross-sell initiatives across the school portfolio.
Identify opportunities to improve school NPS; drive timely renewals and support admissions growth.
Support the Academic team in implementing academic processes effectively at partner schools.
Ensure timely collection of outstanding dues from partner schools.
Conduct training for teachers and staff; track implementation quality in coordination with Academic and Sales teams.
Maintain accurate CRM records, execute BTL campaigns, and share periodic progress reports.
EXPERIENCE
Educational Background:
Graduate in B.Tech, B.Com, B.Sc, or MBA.
Professional Experience:
46 years of experience in EdTech or other industries, particularly in B2B, institutional, or corporate solution sales.
Demonstrated top quartile performance with formal recognition.
Strong ability in sales pipeline management, lead generation, contract negotiation, and client onboarding.
5+ years in customer-facing roles in EdTech (field sales, account management, or key accounts).
Experience in collections, upselling, and school relationship management.
Fluent in local language and open to travel to partnered schools.
Graduate; MBA/BTech or math background preferred.
COMPETENCIES REQUIRED
Proficient in CRM tools, product pitching, stakeholder management, and academic solution selling.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills; strong customer orientation and training ability.
High ownership, solutions-driven, and collaborative with strong interpersonal skills.
Curious, resilient, and tech-savvy; thrives in fast-paced environments with a proactive approach.
