Description:
Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers is looking for a Social Media Live Anchor to host engaging Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions. The role involves wearing and showcasing jewellery collections, demonstrating their features, and interacting with online audiences in real-time. The ideal candidate should be confident, well-spoken, and have a passion for fashion, jewellery, and customer engagement.
  Primary Responsibilities
  Live Anchoring & Jewellery Demonstration:
Host Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube Live sessions, presenting and explaining jewellery collections.
Wear and model various jewellery pieces to enhance their appeal.
Provide detailed descriptions of gold, diamond, and silver jewellery, including design, craftsmanship, weight, pricing, and customization options.
Answer real-time customer queries related to jewellery products and offers.
Engage with viewers, encouraging them to interact, comment, and share.
Maintain high energy levels and professional on-screen presence.
Customer Engagement & Query Handling:
Respond to customer queries, comments, and messages during and after live sessions.
Share updates on ongoing offers, collections, and new arrivals.
Maintain a friendly and persuasive tone to encourage sales and brand loyalty.
Content Creation & Social Media Growth:
Plan and coordinate live session schedules to maximize reach and engagement.
Collaborate with the social media team to strategize content and themes for Live sessions.
Assist in short video content creation (Reels & YouTube Shorts) for additional promotions.
Ensure content aligns with brand tone, aesthetics, and audience expectations.
Event Coverage & Brand Representation:
Host store events, jewellery exhibitions, and festive launches through live sessions.
Be the digital face of Shyam Sundar Co Jewellers, building brand recognition and trust.
Key Skills & Requirements: Educational Qualification Graduation in Mass Communication, Marketing, Fashion, or any relevant field. Experience 1-3 years in anchoring, live streaming, or social media hosting (jewellery or fashion industry preferred). Skills Required
Strong communication & presentation skills in Bengali, Kokborok and Hindi.
Confident and charismatic on-camera presence.
Ability to engage with online audiences and answer queries professionally.
Basic knowledge of social media trends, audience interaction, and marketing strategies.
Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and YouTube Live management.
Location Agartala, Tripura

Description:
Position Overview
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based in Tripura and will report to the Program Lead.


Responsibilities
Own the implementation and outcomes of the program
Provide leadership and managerial support to the field team, mainly to the Block professionals.
Manage Block professionals to ensure quality implementation on the ground through regular meetings and field visits
Develop process and system for onboarding and capacity building of Block professionals
Develop process and system for regular monitoring and cont. feedback
Work closely with The/Nudge's financial unit to develop budgets and ensure timely and effective of such budget
Work closely with the SRLM in developing the annual budget and preparing financial plans
Support TRLM in the research and development of a strategy and program design to target the extremely vulnerable families through the graduation approach built on top of community institutions enabled by the DAY-NRLM
Support TRLM in the implementation of action research of the graduation approach through a special project based on the strategy and design developed in consultation with key stakeholders
Enable convergence of various state initiatives (social security, livelihood promotion, financial inclusion, social empowerment) and programs towards the end goal of graduating women and their households living in extreme poverty.
Support TRLM to review the progress of the program periodically in order to iterate and scale
Support the mission on the use of data and technology to ensure continuous flow of data from the field
Build relationships with key government stakeholders in Tripura such that the special project is successful
Build relationships with key government departments and support the successful adoption of strategies targeting the extremely vulnerable


What's in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, and monitor solar EPC projects, including rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations, from project initiation to commissioning and handover.
Prepare project schedules, execution plans, resource allocation plans, and deployment strategies to ensure timely project completion.
Supervise site execution activities, including civil, structural, electrical, module mounting, inverter installation, cabling, and earthing works.
Coordinate with engineering, procurement, vendors, contractors, and site teams to ensure the timely availability of materials and resources.
Monitor project progress against approved timelines, budgets, technical specifications, and quality standards.
Manage project costs, control expenses, and ensure optimum utilization of manpower, materials, machinery, and other resources.
Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety standards, statutory requirements, quality procedures, and project specifications.
Coordinate with clients, consultants, government authorities, DISCOMs, and other stakeholders for approvals, inspections, grid connectivity, and project-related clearances.

Identify project risks, resolve site-level technical and operational issues, and implement corrective actions to avoid delays and cost overruns.
Conduct regular site visits and review contractor performance, work progress, safety practices, and quality of execution.
Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports, MIS, budget updates, and management review reports.
Ensure proper documentation of drawings, material records, inspection reports, commissioning certificates, and project handover documents.
Coordinate with the operations and maintenance team for smooth project handover and resolution of pending issues.
Lead and manage project engineers, supervisors, technicians, and subcontractors to achieve project delivery targets.

Required Skills

Strong knowledge of solar PV systems, solar EPC execution, and project management.
Experience in project planning, site execution, commissioning, and contractor management.
Knowledge of electrical systems, solar modules, inverters, mounting structures, DC/AC cabling, and grid connectivity.
Proficiency in MS Excel, project scheduling, cost estimation, and project reporting.
Strong leadership, client coordination, problem-solving, and team management skills.

Description:
About The/Nudge
The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime."
What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also nancially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals contributing member to the economy:
Enable govt to adopt by providing research,design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iteratethe design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale & with quality.
Position Overview:
The/Nudge Institute is partnering with the Tripura Rural Livelihood Mission (TRLM), Rural Development Department, Government of Tripura, to promote the adoption of the Graduation Approach (Economic Inclusion Program) for supporting extremely vulnerable households in achieving sustainable and dignified livelihoods. As part of this partnership, a State Project Management Unit (SPMU) has been established at TRLM, Agartala, to support the Government of Tripura in designing and implementing the Tripura - Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana (TR-SAY) & Chief Ministers Nabadisha Abhijan (CM-NDA). This position will be based at the concerned blocks of Tripura, work closely with block officials of TRLM and will report to the Program Lead.

What will you do
Understand and practice the values and spirit of The/Nudge Institute and the State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM).
Identify and select vulnerable women in the designated project geographies across the state.
Mobilize vulnerable women into hamlet-level groups and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
Support the selection, placement, and capacity building of community cadres from local villages/Gram Panchayats to provide intensive handholding and facilitation support to targeted vulnerable women and their households.
Facilitate vulnerable households access to eligible government entitlements and social security schemes by leveraging convergence platforms, including community cadres, community institutions, social capital, block-level line departments, and internal convergence mechanisms within the SRLM.
Facilitate livelihood planning for targeted households and support them in accessing formal credit and loans through community institutions to establish and strengthen livelihood activities.
Strengthen the capacities of community institutions and community cadres to ensure the long-term well-being of vulnerable women by fostering community ownership through the communitization process.
Ensure that all project activities are implemented on time and with the highest quality, in accordance with the approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Package of Practices (PoPs), and Community Operational Manual (COM).
Ensure the timely collection, entry, processing, analysis, and reporting of program data.
Develop case studies and contribute contextualized content to strengthen the programs knowledge management initiatives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with grassroots stakeholders to ensure effective stakeholder engagement and collaboration.
What s in it for you
Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.
.
Required Skills
Problem-Solving Government experience field operations business development Communication Skills Data Analysis Documentation Skills better, together

Description:
About the Role
DScholar Research Consultancy Analytics (OPC) Private Limited is looking for a professional, responsible, and student-focused Academic Consultant Admission Guidance to join our Career Guidance Department in Agartala.
The Academic Consultant will be responsible for counselling students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education opportunities and assisting them in understanding courses, institutions, eligibility requirements, admission procedures, documentation, and application processes.
The role requires excellent communication skills, an interest in higher education, strong information-research abilities, and the ability to guide students and parents in a professional and transparent manner.


Key Responsibilities
Counsel students and prospective applicants regarding higher-education and admission opportunities.
Understand each student s academic background, qualifications, interests, preferences, and educational objectives.
Provide information about suitable courses, programmes, colleges, universities, and other educational institutions based on the student s stated requirements.
Explain course eligibility criteria, admission requirements, application procedures, required documents, fees, important dates, and other relevant information.
Guide students regarding educational opportunities after Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation, and other relevant stages of education .

Description:
URGENT HIRING - CONSULTANT ANAESTHESIOLOGIST
Location: Kailashahar, Unakoti District, Tripura
Hospital Type: Multi-Speciality Hospital
Contact 639865 2832
POSITION
Consultant Anaesthesiologist - OT ICU
QUALIFICATION
- MD Anaesthesiology
- DNB Anaesthesiology
- DA (Diploma in Anaesthesia)
- Valid NMC / Tripura State Medical Council Registration
EXPERIENCE
- Experienced candidates preferred
- Candidates with hands-on OT and ICU experience will be given preference
SALARY
3 Lakhs - 3.5 Lakhs per Month
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Conduct pre-operative anaesthesia assessment and evaluate surgical fitness
- Administer general, regional and other appropriate anaesthesia techniques
- Provide anaesthesia support for elective and emergency surgeries
- Monitor patients throughout surgical procedures and ensure safe peri-operative care
- Manage airway and intubation, including emergency airway situations
- Provide post-operative pain management and recovery care
- Support ICU management of critically ill patients in coordination with the treating team
- Assist with ventilator management and hemodynamic stabilization as required
- Respond to OT, ICU and hospital emergencies
- Coordinate with surgeons, physicians, intensivists, OT staff and nursing teams
- Maintain accurate anaesthesia records and clinical documentation
- Follow infection-control, patient-safety and hospital protocols
SKILLS REQUIRED
- Strong clinical knowledge of Anaesthesia and peri-operative care
- Good airway management and emergency response skills
- OT and ICU experience preferred
- Knowledge of ventilator and critical care management
- Good clinical decision-making and teamwork skills
- Professional and patient-centric approach
JOB TYPE
- Full-Time Consultant
- OT ICU Responsibilities
BENEFITS
- Attractive compensation package
- Good OT and ICU clinical exposure
- Supportive multidisciplinary team
- Long-term professional growth opportunity
Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with current salary, expected salary, notice period and relevant OT/ICU experience.
Immediate joiners will be preferred.

Web Developer - Full-Stack and Client Web Solutions (Job location - Agartala, Tripura, India)
Full-Time Web Developer Job in Agartala, Tripura | DSCHOLAR WEB
Full-Time Desk Job | Agartala, Tripura
Unit: DSCHOLAR WEB | DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics
Job Type: Full-Time, Desk-Based Position
Job Location: Agartala, Tripura, India
Employment Type: Full-Time
About Us
DSCHOLAR WEB is a specialized service unit of DScholar Research Consultancy & Analytics, providing end-to-end website design, development, hosting, management, maintenance, and digital solutions.
We design, develop, deploy, host, maintain, and manage websites and digital platforms for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Position Overview
We are seeking a skilled and versatile Full-Time Web Developer based in Agartala, Tripura.
This is a full-time, desk-based professional position in Agartala. The selected candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, maintaining, securing, and optimizing client websites and digital platforms.
The employee will handle the complete lifecycle of assigned web projects-from understanding client requirements and designing the website to development, deployment, hosting, maintenance, troubleshooting, updates, and ongoing technical management.
The position also involves client and project coordination, technical operations, business-development support, project procurement, and training activities when required.
Key Responsibilities 1. Website Design & Development
Design and develop modern, responsive, professional, and high-performance websites.
Develop websites for individuals, professionals, businesses, organizations, institutions, and other clients.
Convert client requirements and concepts into functional digital solutions.
Develop corporate websites, professional/profile websites, institutional websites, e-commerce websites, landing pages, portals, and custom web solutions.
Ensure websites are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Develop and customize websites using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, CMS platforms, themes, and plugins.
Customize WordPress, Elementor, and other CMS-based websites according to project requirements.
Integrate forms, payment systems, APIs, analytics, third-party services, and other functionality where required.
2. Website Management & Maintenance
Take responsibility for the ongoing technical management of assigned client websites.
Perform regular CMS, WordPress, theme, plugin, and software updates.
Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, compatibility problems, and technical issues.
Maintain backups and website recovery procedures.
Monitor website functionality, availability, and performance.
Implement requested content, design, layout, and functionality changes.
Provide ongoing technical support for completed client projects.
3. Hosting, Domains & Technical Operations
Configure and manage domains, subdomains, DNS records, and nameservers.
Manage website hosting environments, VPS servers, cPanel/WHM, and cloud-hosting platforms.
Configure and maintain SSL certificates.
Configure professional and business email services where required.
Perform website migrations, deployments, staging, backups, and restorations.
Troubleshoot hosting and server-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical records and documentation for client projects.
4. Website Security & Performance
Implement website security best practices.
Conduct routine website security checks.
Identify and resolve vulnerabilities and security-related issues.
Assist with malware prevention/removal and unauthorized-access incidents.
Optimize website loading speed and overall performance.
Configure caching, CDN, database optimization, image optimization, and related performance technologies.
Maintain appropriate website backup and disaster-recovery procedures.
5. Client & Project Coordination
Understand and document client requirements.
Communicate professionally with clients through meetings, phone calls, email, and approved digital channels.
Participate in client meetings and project discussions when required.
Provide project updates and coordinate revisions.
Maintain project timelines and ensure timely completion and delivery.
Handle multiple website development and maintenance assignments.
Maintain professional records of requirements, changes, project progress, and deliverables.
6. Project Procurement & Business Development
Identify prospective clients and new website-development opportunities.
Assist DSCHOLAR WEB in acquiring website design, development, hosting, maintenance, and related digital projects.
Communicate the services and solutions offered by DSCHOLAR WEB to prospective clients.
Develop professional networks and business relationships capable of generating projects.
Follow up with prospective clients and business leads where assigned.
Participate in organizational business-development initiatives.
Performance Incentive: Attractive additional performance-based incentives will be provided for eligible projects successfully procured by the employee, subject to organizational terms and policies.
7. Training & Mentorship
Conduct training sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and practical classes when assigned.
Train interested candidates and team members in website development and related technologies.
Provide practical training in WordPress, website development, hosting, domains, and web operations.
Prepare technical documentation and training materials where required.
Mentor trainees and provide guidance during practical web-development activities.
8. Daily Desk-Based Responsibilities
As this is a full-time desk job based in Agartala, Tripura, the selected employee will be expected to:
Maintain regular attendance and punctuality.
Remain available for assigned responsibilities throughout designated working hours.
Work independently as well as collaboratively with the team.
Attend internal meetings, client discussions, training sessions, and project reviews.
Maintain daily or periodic records of assigned and completed work when required.
Coordinate professionally with management, colleagues, clients, and trainees.
Meet project deadlines and assigned performance expectations.
Maintain professional workplace conduct and discipline.
Handle multiple assignments efficiently in a professional desk-based environment.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile Web Developer to build, deploy, and maintain custom client websites. In this role, you will take full ownership of client digital assets from initial design and layout conceptualization to ongoing technical maintenance, CMS integration, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Web Design & Development: Conceptualize, build, and maintain responsive, high-performance websites and digital portals for our clients.
Maintenance & Security: Perform regular website maintenance, updates, security audits, and performance optimization.
Project Procurement & Business Growth: Identify and acquire new web development projects/clients for DSCHOLAR WEB (attractive performance incentives paid per procured project).
Training & Mentorship: Conduct training sessions and workshops for internal team members and interested candidates looking to upgrade their web development skills.
Technical Operations: Manage web hosting, domains, SSL, CMS platforms, and client delivery workflows.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Education: B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Experience: 1 5 years of web development experience building and maintaining client-facing websites or web applications.
Core Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP/Node.js, and popular frameworks (React.js, Next.js, or Vue.js).
CMS & Database Management: Experience with WordPress/Elementor, headless CMS tools, and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Web Operations: Solid understanding of domain configuration, cloud hosting (AWS, Vercel, cPanel), SSL certificates, and web security best practices.
Work From Home (WFH) Setup Requirements
As a fully remote position, the candidate must have a functional and dedicated home workstation equipped with:
Hardware: High-performance laptop/desktop (Intel i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7, minimum 16GB RAM, 256GB+ SSD).
Display & Peripherals: External monitor setup recommended for multi-tasking, along with a working webcam, noise-canceling headset, and microphone for video meetings.
Internet Connectivity: High-speed broadband connection (minimum 50 Mbps) with a secondary backup power connection (e.g., router UPS or mobile hotspot) to ensure uninterrupted service during power outages.
Workspace: A quiet, professional home office space conducive to video calls with clients and trainees.
Compensation & Perks
Negotiable based on experience, portfolio, and technical assessment.
Work Environment: e-Workspace, Collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to international clients and cutting-edge web technologies.
Mode of Selection
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and called for an interview.
Candidates with good networking skills will be preferred.
Job Features
Job Category: Consultant, DScholar Web
Location: Remote
Work setup: Work from Home, Set-up required
Mode of Selection: Online Video Interview

Description:
Job Purpose
1. Drive sales growth of solar products through distributor training and customer engagement.
2. Expand the dealer and distributor network by onboarding high-potential partners from the solar industry and competitors.
3. Build long-term trust with channel partners to ensure Loom Solar remains their first choice for solar solutions.
Primary Responsibilities
Meet retail shops, solar dealers, and distributors daily (minimum 10 visits) to promote Loom Solar products.

Any Graduate.

Strong knowledge of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and rooftop solar solutions.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Willingness to travel extensively to meet dealers and distributors.
Self-driven, target-oriented, and passionate about renewable energy.



Benefits
Any Graduate.
15 years of experience in solar product sales / channel sales / electrical product sales.
Strong knowledge of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and rooftop solar solutions.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Description:
Job Purpose
The responsibility of this role is to plan, implement and achieve the sales targets for the branch by developing channels like Banking, National Distributors and IFAs for central & harbor suburbs through distributor engagement & expansion.
Job Context & Major Challenges
Job Context/Job Challenges:Organisation ContextEstablished in 1994, Aditya Birla Sun Life Asset Management Company, (ABSLAMC) is a joint venture between Aditya Birla Group &Sunlife Ficial Inc. , a leading international ficial services company in Canada. ABSLAMC is a fund manager for Birla Sunlife Mutual Funds ¤tly ranks as the fourth largest fund Management houses in India with a total Average AUM base of over INR 2 Lakh 45 Thousand crores(as on Nov 2017). Out of the 42 fund houses in the country, ABSLAMC ranked 1st in Fixed Income AUM &5th in Equity AUM category respectively. As of November 2017, the Average AUM market Share of the organisation was approx 10. 73%. The company grew its investor client base by 44% to about 5. 2 Mn from 3. 6 Mn from the previous year, thereby bagging a second position in this category. Distribution Network: ABSLAMC has a footprint in more than 200 locations across the country with approx 65, 000 IFAs, 210 National Distributors & 85 banking partnership. ABSLAMC also has its offshore presence through its rep offices in Singapore, Dubai & Mauritius. Its offerings also include Portfolio advisory services for High Net worth individuals as well as offshore funds for Non Resident Indians. The Company follows a longterm, fundamental research based approach to investment &thrives to provide a transparent ðical services to its investors. One of the key challenges for ABSLAMC has been to maintain a balance between moving with dynamic &constantly changing regulatory norms of the country &maintaining growth &profitability in the extremely competitive market. &some of key strengths of the organization that have helped it to sustain &grow are:
Focus on TechnologyThe organization has been in the forefront in implementing technological innovation to foster innovation &also to improve efficiency for its stakeholders, whether it is employees, clients or distributors
Product InnovationABSLAMC has been known to be a pioneer in terms of products &has a history of launching innovative, category defining products like Birla Cash plus, etc. Research based approachABSLAMC has one of the largest team of research analyst dedicated to tracking down the best companies to invest in. Strong Distributor Delivery MechanismThe Company has developed a 4pronged sales/delivery mechanism to ensure maximum reach &penetration to the end customers. This mechanism includes Company s direct Channels (branches/online), Independent Ficial Advisors (IFAs), National Distributors (ND) &Banks.
Regulator InterfaceABSLAMC plays a key role in the Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI) with quite a few members of the top management being a part of the AMFI Board. It has hence ensured that it can discuss any new Industry development from a regulatory perspective at the initial stages with the Regulator as well as the Industry Association
People Management ABSLAMC believes in continuously measuring the perception of its people using a 4S approach, namely Satisfaction, Say, Stay &Strive, which has enabled it to garner a workforce committed &aligned to the overall business success. In context to the organization, the Banking Distribution, IFA &ND channels are a very integral &critical part of the Retail Distribution setup.
Plan, organize & manage all activities to drive Retail Sales through all the channels in the region to increase AUM, market share, quality &profit potential of assets. The Banking Distribution compromises of the Retail &Private Banks. As these retail channels cater to very different class &set of clients &client requirements, it gives us a platform to promote our diversified set of products based on these requirements.
Key Challenges for the role are as follows:
a)To ensure an increase in visibility activities.
b)Lack of a measurement tool for performance, thus the branch manager has to manually maintain &update performance data.
c)Difficulty of coordination with different channels of distribution
Key Result Areas KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters) Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters) KRA1 Retail Sales Execution Drives ongoing sales from the defined relationships and contribute towards regions achievements
Obtains and analyzes information from market to identify new clients, makes direct pitches, liaises with channel partners to increase sales
Profiles distributors and caters to their requirements to ensure ongoing business from them
Ensures targeted number of folios are added and achieves targeted amount of new SIPs KRA2 Retail Sales Execution
Distributor Empanelment & Engagement Conducts regular meetings and contact with the distributors
Undertakes empanelment and activation of distributors
Disseminates updates and other product related information in timely manner
Organizes and executes trainings and engagements for partners KRA3 Reporting and compliance Ensures 100% compliance with internal reporting & audit systems
Provides weekly reports to Regional Heads
Updates sales portal with requisite information to facilitate information collation and analysis
Undertakes installation of advertising and publicity materials for brand visibility KRA4 Branch Administration Ensure branch administration in order to help maintain and grow sales in the region.
Ensure good rating for the branch and get well equipped for internal audit.
Ensure compliance and SEBI code of conduct issues are adhered to KRA5 Overseeing Branch administration and monitoring branch issues to ensure a smooth delivery of service to clients Facilitate smooth operations of the branch including branch imprest, administration, operations and client servicing standards KRA6 Providing relevant reports to management for assigned territory. Furnishing relevant sales reports of the branch to Cluster & Zonal Head KRA7 Managing and monitoring team members for better productivity 1. Facilitating regular training, guidance and development of team members
2. Ensuring AMFI Certification of team members
3. Monitoring performance of RM s on monthly basis and take corrective measures if achievement deviates from the required achievements.

Job Description
HCM BI Publisher (BIP)/ OTBI Senior Analyst (5-8 Years of experience)
As an BIP Sr. Associate, you will work with technical and projects teams to deliver cutting edge reporting solutions on Oracle cloud platforms for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new Oracle cloud solutions; migrating applications to co-exist in the hybrid cloud (On-Premise and Cloud); deploying a global cloud application across multiple countries. Our teams have a diverse range of skills and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. Primary focus on developing custom solutions using BIP/ OTBI reports
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze reporting requirements from HR and business stakeholders
Design and develop reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher (BIP)
Build custom data models using SQL, and create RTF, Excel templates
Create and configure OTBI analyses, subject area queries, and dashboards
Develop reports for HCM areas such as Core HR, Absence, Payroll, Talent, Compensation, and Benefits
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot data and logic issues
Support unit testing, SIT, UAT, and production issues
Prepare technical specifications, test cases, and user documentation
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in BI Publisher (BIP): data models, templates, bursting, and scheduling
Strong hands-on experience in OTBI: subject areas, analyses, and dashboards
Good knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM data model and tables
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills
Experience with HCM Extracts
Understanding of Fusion security, roles, and data access
Good communication and documentation skills
Good to have
Knowledge of Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) or Oracle Analytics
Knowledge on OCI, REST/SOAP APIs and APEX/ VBCS application would be added advantage
Exposure to multiple end-to-end Fusion HCM implementations
Oracle HCM Cloud certification
Consulting Requirements
5-8 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
Proven knowledge of Oracle Cloud platform and tools
Excellent team player
Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Strong communicator
Willingness to travel up in case of project requirement
Strong knowledge of software implementation best practices
Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment and learn new concepts and software
Self-motivated, independent, detail oriented, responsible team player and exhibit exceptional relationship management skills
Passionate about building high-quality systems with software implementation
Professionalism and integrity
Strong interpersonal and written communication skills
Ability to work in fast paced environment

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.
Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.
Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Data Science Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work on exploratory and descriptive analysis, statistical modeling, and creating data visualizations to help solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing data-driven strategies using machine learning, predictive modeling, and artificial intelligence
- Overseeing the creation and maintenance of data pipelines and data lakes to support large-scale data processing
- Collaborating with stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging data science to drive business growth
- Utilizing programming languages such as R and MATLAB to develop and refine data models and algorithms
- Promoting the use of innovative technologies and methodologies within data science teams
- Confirming data quality and integrity through rigorous data validation and troubleshooting processes
- Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team
- Engaging in strategic planning and execution to align data science projects with organizational goals
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Business Analytics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Systems Engineering
- Demonstrating proficiency in data science algorithms and workflows
- Utilizing machine learning and deep learning techniques effectively
- Excelling in data-driven decision making and predictive modeling
- Managing data pipelines and confirming data quality
- Leveraging programming languages such as R and MATLAB
- Applying natural language processing and neural network methodologies

AboutCompany:
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. This position offers a unique opportunity to develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, allowing you to make informed insights and recommendations.

The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As an AI Engineer – Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving software and product innovation within our Technology Consulting practice. You will focus on developing innovative software solutions that enhance business performance and drive digital transformation for our clients. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards, motivating and inspiring others to deliver quality. You will leverage your growing business knowledge to identify opportunities that contribute to the success of our firm, leading with integrity and authenticity.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, confirming their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. Your responsibilities will include analyzing and identifying the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system, effectively mentoring others, and addressing conflicts or issues with clients and team members. You will uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's purpose and values in a meaningful way.
Responsibilities
- Leading software engineering projects to drive digital transformation and enhance business performance
- Designing, coding, and testing applications using Python, React Native, and Flutter to deliver exceptional user experiences
- Managing application development and lifecycle management to optimize software solutions
- Implementing microservices architecture to improve system scalability and reliability
- Developing solution architecture and system software to support innovative product development
- Overseeing software project management to confirm successful planning, budgeting, and execution
- Mentoring team members to leverage their strengths and improve performance
- Addressing conflicts and engaging in difficult conversations with stakeholders to resolve issues
- Validating professional and technical standards, including adherence to the firm's code of conduct
- Encouraging the use of innovative technologies and methodologies to enhance delivery and inspire teams
-Proven delivery of production full-stack systems (React + Python) and AI/ML or GenAI solutions
-Strong architectural judgment across front-end, back-end, and LLM/agent orchestration
-Deep familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, ReAct) and LLM orchestration
-Experience with enterprise integrations, distributed systems, cloud (Azure / AWS / GCP), containers/Kubernetes, and security best practices
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 8 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Computer and Data Engineering, Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems/Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering
- Excelling in application development and software design
- Utilizing Python and scripting languages for innovative solutions
- Managing software project lifecycles with Agile methodologies
- Leading teams in microservices architecture and system development
- Developing solutions with React Native and Flutter frameworks
- Troubleshooting complex issues in software engineering environments

Description:
Afcons Infrastructure Limited is an Indian multinational construction and engineering company based in Mumbai. The company provides infrastructure services and is involved in the construction of infrastructure projects such as viaducts, flyovers, metros, bridges, pipelines, roads, ports, barrages, oil and gas projects etc.
Roles and Responsibilities 01
Vendor s Quality
Review vendor document index submitted by vendor.
Review of all deliverables such as Inspection & Test Plan, NDT procedure, Pressure Test Procedure, PWHT procedure, FAT procedure, etc. submitted by vendor and further submission to DCC for forwarding to Client / Nominated Inspection Agencies for review/approval.
Coordinate with vendor for submission of inspection notifications as per Inspection and Test Plan.
Forward inspection notifications to Third Party Inspection agency for participation at vendor s premises.
Attend pre-inspection or Kick of meetings with critical vendors.
Visit suppliers for attending inspections as directed by Project Quality Manager or Head-Quality.
Carry out a stage wise and final inspection (such as identification of raw material, fit up, weld visual, NDT, PWHT, Hydrotest, FAT etc.) as per approved ITP & drawings.
Ensure that all inspections have been performed as per approved ITP and inspection report is received from Inspection Agencies.
Keep a track of receipt of Inspection reports vis- -vis inspection notifications.
Coordinate with Client or their nominated inspection agencies for their participation for various inspections.
Ensure that inspection release note is received prior to dispatch of items.
Coordination with Procurement department for submission of MRB s from vendors and ensure that MRB s are reviewed and submitted to client.
Coordinate with site team and forward necessary documents to them for preparation of material receiving inspection report.
Follow up with vendors on closure of punch points if any.
Roles and Responsibilities 02
Site/Yard Quality
Prepare list of quality deliverables that need to be submitted to Client for review/approval.
Follow up with client / nominated agencies for approval of documents within scheduled time frame.
Prepare material receiving inspection report upon receipt of material and obtain approvals from relevant parties.
Ensure all testing and measuring instruments/equipments are duly calibrated and possess valid calibration certificates.
Attend welder qualification / welding procedure qualification test program, prepare WPS/PQR/Welder Qualification Test Record.
Ensure that all relevant documents are duly approved prior to start of fabrication or commencing relevant activities.
Carry out regular inspections at site to ensure that QA/QC requirements are fulfilled as per relevant codes / standards / specifications / approved drawings/ITP.
Monitor the performance of welders and take timely action upon unsatisfactory welder performance.
Follow up with sub-contractor on closure of punch points.
Obtain Inspection Release note from Client or their nominated inspection agency / certifying authority upon completion of work.
Coordinate with sub-contractor for submission of As Built / Final documentation.
Roles and Responsibilities 04
QMS/Audit Management
Ensure Project Quality requirements are met.
Monitor the set project quality objectives and ensure that it is achieved.
Issue NCR upon finding any non-conformances and ensure that necessary corrective or remedial actions has been taken and NCR is closed within stipulated time frame.
Conduct internal audit per scheduled audit program as directed by Project Quality Manager / Head-Quality.
Participate in internal / external QMS audit.
Key Objective of the Job Position
To control, monitor QA/QC activities at site, fabrication yards, vendor s premises and ensure that it is complied to client requirements
Education Qualifications
Diploma/B.E/ B Tech in Mechanical Engineering
Candidate should be ASNT Level 2 Certified
Computer Software Proficiency
Experience Range
10 to 20 Years experience in Handling QA/QC activities for Offshore Oil and Gas Projects
Piping/Structural/Mechanical
Must be well versed with inspection of mechanical, piping, structural items and quality control/ quality assurance activities during procurement, construction, installation, pre-commissioning, and commissioning of Oil & Gas projects.
Must be well acquainted with materials and fabrication (Welding, NDT, dimensional control etc.) and have adequate knowledge of various construction/test codes as ASME Sec V, Sec VIII, Sec IX, ASME B31.3, AWS D1.1, API etc.
Work Environment
May need to travel to vendor s premises at domestic or overseas locations.
May be deputed at construction site during the project construction
Need to travel to Offshore Platform during Modification, Hook up, installation, Commissioning of the project
May have to work long hours, including evenings and weekends.
Work in all rough climatic conditions at Sea during offshore campaign

Reading and analysis of the Contracts
Drafting of Contract Appreciation Documents based on perusal of Contract documents.
Assistance to Project Team in initial contractual compliances required during LOA/Commencement stage and during Contract closure i.e., to keep a check on contractual-commercial obligations/financial closure along with other obligations defined (of all the parties) under the Contract. Accordingly, preparation of necessary contractual documentation and their requisite submission
Check and implementation in respect of applicable acts and applicable permits or assist Contracts In-charge in the same.
Roles and Responsibilities 02
Phase III: Setting and Implementation of the Contract Monitoring System
Drafting of contractual correspondence and maintaining all the correspondence/documents in completeness both in hard and soft copy in co-ordination with the Document controller. Also, maintain the documents tracker online
Timely notifying intra and inter-department w.r.t. contractual requirements
Cross functional coordination (Assist Contracts In-charge,)
inter alia
with planning, execution, QS, QA QC, finance etc. and extend support to project & execution teams including contractual communications, compliance requirements.

Initiation of Change Orders/ Change in Scope with the Employer and/or Engineer

Computer Software Proficiency
MS Excel, MS Word, Power Point

Minimum 5 - 15 years experience under Contracts domain (Experience in Oil and Gas Onshore and Offshore projects shall be preferred). Have a good understanding of Contract forms like NITI Aayog / FIDIC (Red and Silver books)
Work Environment
May need to travel to work sites at domestic or overseas locations. Majorly operating from office.

Description:
Afcons Infrastructure Limited is an Indian multinational construction and engineering company based in Mumbai. The company provides infrastructure services and is involved in the construction of infrastructure projects such as viaducts, flyovers, metros, bridges, pipelines, roads, ports, barrages, oil and gas projects etc
Roles and Responsibilities 01
Painting Quality
Preparation of painting procedure and Painting Inspection & Test Plan in accordance with relevant codes/standards and client specifications.
Review of paint requirements as per project specifications and provide input to planning/execution team for quantity of paint material required for the project.
Preparation of receiving material inspection report upon receipt of paint material and get approval from client
Conduct inspection of paint materials at manufacturer s premises and witness necessary tests.
Preparation and execution of Coating Qualification plan prior to commencement of painting activities.
Monitor Weather condition suitable for the painting operation.
Monitor surface preparation to assure the cleanliness.
Monitor paint mixing procedures & technique, application technique to achieve the required standards.
Conduct all tests such as Surface profile test, dust level test, chloride contamination test, WFT, DFT, Adhesion test, Holiday test etc.
Frequent interaction with Paint manufacturers for the product related advice in case of need & for approvals purpose.
Monitoring of Paint storage conditions, Expired paint records, Batch numbers, shelf-life records, First in first out monitoring etc.
Conduct stage wise coating inspection on daily basis before offering to client and preparation of necessary reports.
Oversee the entire painting operation including correct usage of equipment, avoid wastage, keep a log of paint material consumption etc.
Review of alternate paint system offered by vendor/sub-contractor vis-a-visa required paint system and obtain clearance/approval from client .
Roles and Responsibilities 02
Painting Quality
Review of painting procedure submitted by vendor/sub-contractor.
Coordinate with Client or their nominated inspection agencies for inspection as per approved Inspection and Test Plan.
Ensure that all inspections have been performed as per approved ITP and inspection report is maintained.
Comply with all safety requirements as per HSE manual / instructions.
Roles and Responsibilities 03
QMS/Audit Management
Ensure Project Quality requirements are met
Monitor the set project quality objectives and ensure that it is achieved
Issue NCR upon finding any non-conformances and ensure that necessary corrective or remedial actions has been taken and NCR is closed within stipulated time frame.
Participate in internal project audit per scheduled audit program as directed by Project Quality Manager / Head-Quality.
Participate in internal / external QMS audit.
Key Objective of the Job Position
To control, monitor painting activities at site, fabrication yards, vendor s premises and ensure that it is complied to client requirements
Education Qualifications
Educational Essential: Diploma or bachelor s degree in Mechanical/ Electrical Engineering or Painting Technology
Educational Desirable: Certification in painting (NACE Level II or BGAS Grade 2 or SSPC PCI/SSPC Level 2)
Computer Software Proficiency
Experience Range
5-15 years of experience in painting in oil and gas construction projects.
Shall be fully conversant with applicable industry standards such as NACE, SSPC, ASTM, DIN, ISO etc.
Should be acquainted with offshore painting standard/specification
Work Environment
May need to travel to vendor s premises
Deputed at construction site during the project construction
Need to work at offshore platform during painting campaign
May have to work long hours, including evenings and weekends. Work in all rough climatic conditions at Sea during offshore campaign

Description:
Afcons Infrastructure Limited is an Indian multinational construction and engineering company based in Mumbai. The company provides infrastructure services and is involved in the construction of infrastructure projects such as viaducts, flyovers, metros, bridges, pipelines, roads, ports, barrages, oil and gas projects etc.
Roles and Responsibilities 01
Design Review of Offshore Structures
Detailed design and drawing review of Offshore structures
Pre-tender Document Review
Understand the material requirements, design procedures & assumptions, constraints. Prepare and finalize design basis report.
Prepare conceptual designs
Review pre-tender documents, attend kick off meeting, understand client s requirements, attend discussion with Team Leader about addition, omission, or deletion form scope of service.
Information affecting design, discuss with Team Leader and follow instructions accordingly.
Prepare design delivery schedule and agree with Team Leader.
Organize, draft, review and coordinate technical documents.
Ensures that designs are constructable, safe and economical, satisfy contract requirements, law of land, statutory provisions, if required advice modifications, additional calculations.
Roles and Responsibilities 02
Design Anaylysis
Finalize the designs developed for Offshore structures such as jackets, topside, modules, bridges, skids, various types of offshore structural designs.
Be a part of the offshore design team on offshore feasibility, basic engineering, and detailed engineering.
Co-ordination with and handling queries from client, design sub-contractor and consultant. etc.
Prepare scope of work, man hour and cost estimation for proposal.
Provide engineering input, review and approve 2D drawing and 3D models prepared by drafting team/other stake holders.
Should have knowledge and experience of preparing structural design basics, structural design specification, construction and installation work procedure and cost estimation.
Should have experience in performing in service analyses like in-place analysis, seismic analysis, fatigue analysis, dynamic analysis etc.
Should have experience in performing preservice analyses like lift analysis, loadout analysis, transportation analysis, launching analysis, floatation and upending analysis etc.
Roles and Responsibilities 03
Design Methodology
Develop and carrying out construction stage design checks. Prepare the construction sequence to be adopted during construction in discussion with Team leader and Planning team.
Participate in discussion for possible options/ methodology for installing offshore structures. Finalize the scheme with team leaders.
Preparation and review of submittals such as method statements,
Take responsibility of all design issues and ensure successful delivery of the projects.
Direct the activities of the department members working with other departments to ensure alignment on priorities.
Roles and Responsibilities 04
Preliminary Design and Analysis
Prepare preliminary design based on Detailed Project Report/ Information available from clients. Ensure feasibility, constructability, and viability of the structures in terms of cost, time. Prepare Bill of Quantities.
Develop preliminary structural framing plan and sizing of structural members.
Manage design submission for approval according to the schedule finalized.
Ensure design review is completed prior to the construction process commencing.
Design Submission and Review of Design for Approval/ Monitor Work Progress
Prepare design and issuance of GFC documents for construction.
Employee Engagement
Co-ordination with and handling queries from clients, sub-contractors, and other stake holders.
Design Review and Optimization of design prepared by JV partners/ designs sub-contractor to achieve cost effectiveness.
Key Objective of the Job Position
To ensure that the Engineering department is fully engaged in supporting Structural safety and occupational safety programs.
Perform Structural Design of Offshore structures such as Jacket, Topside & Bridges etc. using software like SACS etc.
Examine and approve design orders, evaluating changes, and drawing releases; collaborating with operations on design and packaging specification; and creating front end packages designed to control project expenses.
Evaluate vendor bids, produce services and equipment bid requirements, and generate material RFQs /procurement recommendations. Devise methods to reduce costs.
Review T & I Engineering and/or propose structural design based on Installation requirements
Design Installation Aids / padeyes, etc.
Assist Manager/Senior Manager in generating structural deliverable, schedule & client/Sub Contractor interface.
Liaise with client and MWS etc. for approval of structural documents
Education Qualifications
Educational Essential: B.E in Civil Engineering or equivalent from a reputed Institute/University
Educational Desirable: M.E in Civil/Structural/Ocean Engineering/ or equivalent from a reputed Institute/University.
Computer Software Proficiency
Should be specialized in International Codes and Standards like ASME, BS/PD 5500, API, ANSI, ISO NFPA, ASTM, AWS, AISC, ISA etc.
Should be familiar with software like HYSYS, PIPESIM, TLNET, TGNET, FLARENET, OLGA etc.
Experience Range
Minimum 3 to 10 Years of experience in Structural Design Professional in Projects involving Offshore Platform.
Work Environment
Requires the ability to travel to client sites. Ability to work overtime as needed based on project.
Mostly Office work and occasional Field travel

Description:
Senior Associate Workforce Solutions (Dayforce)
Job description
is responsible for independently managing assigned workstreams and supporting end-to-end Dayforce HCM implementation projects across functional areas, including Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, and Talent Management, as well as technical areas such as Data Conversion, Integrations, and Reporting. The role requires strong expertise in one or more Dayforce modules, with a working understanding of related modules and cross-functional dependencies. Key responsibilities include requirements gathering, business process design, solution design, system configuration, data migration and validation, integrations, reporting, testing, cutover, and post-go-live activities. The position involves collaborating closely with clients, project managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into effective HCM solutions, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery. Additionally, the role supports regulatory compliance, process optimization, and transition to managed services while ensuring solution quality and alignment with client business objectives.
Essential Responsibilities
Support the end-to-end implementation and transformation of Dayforce HCM solutions for external clients, covering discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, within your primary module and in coordination with other module workstreams.
Own assigned Dayforce functional workstreams, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of project milestones, deliverables, and client requirements.
Facilitate client discovery workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, document current-state HR and payroll processes, business rules, organizational structures, and data flows, validate design decisions, resolve open items, and align client needs with Dayforce capabilities.
Translate business and functional requirements into Dayforce configurations, solution design documents, configuration workbooks, and test scenarios.
Support data migration activities, including coordination of legacy data extraction, data mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution to ensure accurate conversion into Dayforce.
Collaborate with technical and integration teams on inbound and outbound integrations between Dayforce and third-party systems, including data mapping, integration testing, error resolution, and data flow validation.
Plan and execute testing activities, including functional, system integration (SIT), user acceptance (UAT), regression, and end-to-end business process testing; support payroll parallel testing where applicable by validating calculations, analyzing variances, and reconciling results; and manage defects through resolution.
Advise clients on Dayforce capabilities, HCM business processes, regulatory compliance considerations, and leading practices, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and optimization by assessing manual workarounds, control gaps, and system capabilities.


Requirements
48 years of relevant experience in HCM implementation, HR technology consulting, HR transformation, or enterprise HRIS projects, including hands-on Dayforce HCM implementation experience.
Hands-on experience configuring Dayforce in at least one primary module (Core HR, Time & Attendance, Payroll, Benefits, or Talent Management), with working knowledge of cross-module dependencies.
Experience across the end-to-end Dayforce implementation lifecycle, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, data migration, integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover, go-live, and post-production support.
Experience independently managing a functional workstream, facilitating client workshops, translating business requirements into system solutions, troubleshooting configuration issues, and delivering documentation and project milestones.
Solid knowledge of HCM data migration, mapping, validation, reconciliation, integration testing, and defect management.

Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.

Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Agile & JIRA Experience

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.

Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.

Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

About the Job:


The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for a Technical Service Manager with expertise in hybrid cloud platforms, cloud-native development, and middleware offerings to join us in Mumbai, India. Background selling complex customer solutions in a rapidly evolving technology environment

Natural storytelling ability with an above-average written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills
Advanced presentation skill set with ability to present to executives at large companies
Background in consultative customer engagement with a consulting or technology company or organization
