Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring

standards

SOP adherence &
implementation Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues

maintenance equipment at the store

Description:
Profile Summary
Our Area Operations Manager is responsible for developing and expanding the business in the respective area and managing the store operations across the respective area thereby increasing the customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Driving Sales and Customer Service
a. Driving and ensuring to meet or exceed the sales plan of the respective territory monthly/ quarterly and annually
b. Driving and focusing on providing the customer services thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store
c. Drive culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. SALES Leadership
d. Motivates and inspires field team to drive for results.
e. Review financial performance at regional level to identify improvement opportunities.
f. Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
g. Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into business plans.
h. Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.
Manpower Planning & People Development
a. Working with the HR team and the Store Manager in ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store
b. Direct responsibility for professional development of Lenskart Associates
c. Assess and prioritize advanced management skill gaps including those related to design and implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication.
d. Conduct two-way, formal and informal performance evaluations of Lenskart Associates which review professional development needs and accomplishments as well as overall achievement of management objectives
e. Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
f. Overall responsibility for associate development
Managing P&L of the Assigned Stores
a. Responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at store as well as territory level
b. Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
c. Responsible for reducing shrinkage
d. Managing the productivity of the staff
e. Using cost effective methods to ensure productivity of the respective territory
Managing and Maintaining High Standards of Retail Operations
a.Regular Store Visits to:
Audit stores
Coaching the Store Managers
Motivate staff through sales discussions
Check VM, stock availability
Check store hygiene, grooming
Assess discipline levels in store opening times, staff attendance, process adherence etc.
b. Analyze data before Store Visits
Monitoring Sales through data.
Assessing the productivity and achievements of the stores
Store Staffing levels.
Product flow, supply, demand and shrinkage.
NPS and MC scores
Reviewing measures to achieve performance targets
a.Bridge communication between Management and floor
Recommending changes to ZM/BH basis visits.
Ensure Timely reporting of Data when needed.
Implementing and enforcing company regulations
Implement process change
Attending conferences, events and meetings at regional as well as corporate level to enhance knowledge and skill sets
Inventory Management
a. Ensures availability of required merchandise and services at each of the assigned stores
b. Ensuring that inventory levels are well balanced and making key decisions about inventory control at each of the assigned stores
c. Ensuring physical verification of inventory on regular intervals is being conducted at each of the assigned stores
d. Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
e. Ensuring necessary quality checks for the new products is being conducted in a timely manner
f. Responsible for reducing shrinkage at store level
g. Working very closely with various departments in the organization till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Key Personal and Professional Attributes:
a) Collaborative Skills: The role requires the incumbent to work closely and coordinate with the Internal and external teams to create success. S/he should be able to seamlessly navigate these relationship dynamics in a high growth, young, agile business environment.
b) Functional understanding: The role is critical for the business performance and would require the incumbent to create a competitive business advantage. It would be critical to analyze the effectiveness of the processes on a day to day basis and course correct.
c) Data driven/ Analytical: The role is required to drive specific process efficiency metrics and would be accountable to drive data-driven decision making.
d) Results oriented: The role is required to work on deliver on daily numbers, short-term goals and long-term milestones set by business and efficacy. Meeting these milestones would be critical to create success.
e) Extroverted Personality
f) Pleasant & Friendly who can be easily approached
g) Pragmatic Leaders who are self -motivated and resilient
h) Passionate
i) Energetic
j) Positive Attitude
k) Ability to handle stressful situations
l) Problem Solving & Decision Making
m) Assertive
n) Sales Driven & Number Oriented Team player
Candidate Profile:
a) Full Time Post Graduate with 7-9 years of relevant experience into retail industry
b) Post-Graduation is a must
c) Very strong communication skills- both written and verbal and must be a good orator
d) Should have hands on experience working on Microsoft Office- Including Excel, PPT & Word
e) Strong inter-personal skills (friendly, caring & patient)
f) Sales oriented
g) Strong Management/leadership skills.
h) Strong organizational skills.
i) Strong team builder
Required Managerial Competencies
People Management
a) Mentors team members and colleagues; guides them with regard to development and career progression.
b) Clearly communicates work responsibilities and expectations and takes steps to balance the workload among team members.
c) Anticipates the effect of an action on other people and modifies such action accordingly.
d) Resolves conflicts among colleagues in just and fair manner
Proactive Problem Solving Skills
a) Anticipates problems before they develop, and takes steps to avert them.
b) Considers a situation from multiple perspectives before deciding on a course of action.
c) Adept at managing the flow of information in times of crisis.
d) Appeals to reason, facts, and figures and adapts managerial style based on the demands of the situation
Commercial Savviness
a) Protects the commercial interests of the company with the aim of maximizing revenue.
b) Takes appropriate business decisions after performing a cost-benefit analysis and pre-empts problems and resolves them, ensuring minimal business loss.
c) Builds and manages workforce based on organizational goals and budget constraints
Customer Expectation Management
a) Adept at balancing the interests of the company with the needs and expectations of the client/customer
b) Responds deliberately and diplomatically to protect company interests
c) Communicates effectively about sensitive matters and influences the client/customer when required
Planning and Organizing
a) Adept at prioritization and time management to ensure efficient and timely completion of assignments
b) Manages and shifts priorities as required and incorporates new approaches
c) Delegates work effectively among team members
Required Personality Traits
a) Extraversion - The trait is marked by pronounced engagement with the external world. Extraverts enjoy interacting with people, and are often perceived as full of energy. They tend to be enthusiastic, action-oriented individuals. They possess high group visibility, like to talk, and assert themselves
b) Conscientiousness- It is a tendency to display self-discipline, act dutifully, and strive for achievement against measures or outside expectations. It is related to the way in which people control, regulate, and direct their impulses. High scores on conscientiousness indicate a preference for planned rather than spontaneous behavior
c) Openness to Experience- Openness is a general appreciation for art, emotion, adventure, unusual ideas, imagination, curiosity, and variety of experience. People who are open to experience are intellectually curious, open to emotion, sensitive to beauty and willing to try new things. They tend to be, when compared to closed people, more creative and more aware of their feelings
d) Agreeableness- The agreeableness trait reflects individual differences in general concern for social harmony. Agreeable individuals value getting along with others. They are generally considerate, kind, generous, trusting and trustworthy, helpful, and willing to compromise their interests with others.
e) Polychronicity- it is defined as a continuum, and preferences for degrees of engagement. At one extreme is the pattern of focusing on one task at a time, interpreting other potential tasks and events as interruptions and attempting to shield one's chosen task from such interference. The other extreme is actually open-ended, it involves engagement in several tasks simultaneously, sometimes literally simultaneously and sometimes in a frequent back-and-forth engagement pattern
f) Emotional Stability- People high on emotional stability do not tend to have a negative outlook of the future and hence are usually calmer. Persons who score low in emotional stability generally have a fearful and negative disposition, with an ominous foreboding about things.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example
Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals
Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals
Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance
Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team
Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns
Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate
Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Required Skills
Troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Basic documentation and reporting abilities.
Ability to work in shifts and handle operational emergencies.
Strong safety awareness and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and coordinate with the maintenance team.

UX Architect Job Description (JD) Job Title UX Architect Experience 1015+ Years Location Bangalore / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai (Hybrid)
We are looking for an experienced UX Architect to lead the definition and execution of user experience strategies for enterprise and customer-facing digital products. The ideal candidate will drive information architecture, interaction design, design systems, and user-centered design practices to create seamless, intuitive, and scalable experiences across web, mobile, and omnichannel platforms.
Role & responsibilities
UX Strategy & Architecture
Define and drive the UX vision, strategy, and experience roadmap.
Establish UX principles, frameworks, and design standards across products.
Translate business goals and customer needs into scalable experience architectures.
Ensure consistency and usability across multiple digital touchpoints.
Information Architecture
Design information architecture, navigation structures, taxonomy, and content hierarchies.
Create customer journey maps, user flows, wireframes, site maps, and service blueprints.
Simplify complex workflows into intuitive user experiences.
User Research & Validation
Lead user research, stakeholder interviews, contextual inquiries, and usability testing.
Develop personas, empathy maps, and customer journey frameworks.
Analyze quantitative and qualitative user data to guide design decisions.
Validate concepts through usability studies and iterative design improvements.
Interaction Design
Define user interactions, workflows, and experience patterns.
Develop low-fidelity and high-fidelity prototypes.
Create design specifications and interaction guidelines for development teams.
Ensure accessibility and usability best practices are embedded in solutions.
Design Systems & Governance
Establish and maintain enterprise-wide design systems.
Promote reusable design components and UX standards.
Drive UX governance, design reviews, and quality audits.
Ensure compliance with accessibility standards (WCAG).
Collaboration & Leadership
Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Stakeholders, Engineers, and Designers.
Mentor UX/UI Designers and provide architectural guidance.
Facilitate workshops, design thinking sessions, and stakeholder reviews.
Advocate for user-centric design across the organization.

Preferred candidate profile
Experience architecting large-scale enterprise applications.
Strong understanding of omnichannel and customer experience design.
Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2).
Experience with analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel, or Amplitude.
Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and SAFe frameworks.
Experience designing AI-powered, conversational, or personalized user experiences.

Role & responsibilities
SAP controls design, integration and assurance
Lead pre- and post-implementation control design assessments, fit-gap reviews, configuration testing, and operating effectiveness support across R2R, O2C, P2P, P2M and related cross-functional processes.
Oversee development and review of control activity narratives (CANs), manual control procedures (MCPs), control test scripts (CTSs), risk and control matrices (RCMs), process flows and control ownership/RACI documentation.
Assess automated application controls, configurable controls, interfaces, key reports, data dependencies, exception handling, and manual controls reliant on SAP-generated information.
Challenge design deviations, identify control gaps, evaluate business and financial reporting impact, and recommend remediation or compensating controls with clear ownership and deadlines.
Oversee RICEFW/WRICEF reviews, functional specifications, custom enhancements, defect and change assessments, testing evidence, and control impacts throughout project releases and hypercare.
Technology risk, security and regulatory compliance
Direct SAP ITGC reviews covering user access, privileged access, authentication, change management, operations, logging, and configuration governance, aligned to relevant SOX and audit requirements.
Guide SAP GRC and Pathlock-related reviews, including access request approvals, periodic access reviews, segregation of duties (SoD), sensitive access, ruleset governance and mitigating controls.
Provide implementation assurance through design checkpoints, go-live readiness reviews, risk escalation, remediation validation, and coordination with internal and external assurance teams.
Engagement and people leadership
Own engagement planning, budgets, resourcing, work allocation, milestones, quality review, issue resolution and senior stakeholder reporting across concurrent projects.
Coach and review multidisciplinary teams; set clear expectations for documentation, evidence sufficiency, technical accuracy, productivity, and timely delivery.
Build trusted relationships with overseas engagement teams, client process owners, SAP functional and technical leads, compliance teams, and program management offices.
Contribute to proposals, solution development, methodology improvement, knowledge assets, reusable testing accelerators and practice growth.

Company: NoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Job Type: Full-time | Field Sales
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune
Experience: Minimum 1 year / Smart Freshers
Industry: Real Estate
Job Summary
We are looking for energetic and customer-focused Business Development Associates (BDA) to join our field sales team. You will interact with property owners and customers, conduct property/site visits, explain NoBroker services, and help drive successful property transactions.
Qualified leads will be provided by the company.
Key Responsibilities
Meet property owners and customers for property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property details, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate with buyers and sellers to support deal closure.
Onboard property owners and promote premium services where applicable.
Visit commercial properties and collect owner details.
Update property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
Eligibility
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory.
Smart Freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of field sales experience.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Comfortable with field sales and customer interaction.
Mandatory Requirements
Own bike and valid driving licence.
Smartphone.
Ability to communicate in at least one of these combinations:
English + Kannada
English + Telugu
English + Tamil
English + Hindi
English + Marathi

Job Summary
The Seller Business Development Associate (BDA) is responsible for acquiring and engaging property owners, conducting field visits, showcasing properties, assisting buyers, and driving successful property transactions. The company provides qualified leads.

Meet property owners and customers to facilitate property sales, rentals, and leases.

Description:

Code: 108260-42
Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Sr. Developer
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Developer with strong hands-on expertise in AMPscript, CloudPages, SQL, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting personalized marketing communications, landing pages, data-driven campaigns, and automated customer journeys within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This role requires strong technical development skills as well as the ability to translate business and marketing requirements into scalable SFMC solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy solutions within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Develop personalized and dynamic email content using AMPscript.
Build and maintain CloudPages, landing pages, microsites, forms, preference centers, and subscription-management pages.
Develop server-side functionality on CloudPages using AMPscript and Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) where applicable.
Create dynamic forms and landing pages that read from and write data to Data Extensions.
Implement form submission, validation, data capture, confirmation pages, and error-handling logic.
Develop secure and personalized CloudPages using URL parameters, encrypted query strings, subscriber attributes, and Data Extension lookups.
Build reusable AMPscript components for personalization, conditional content, data retrieval, data updates, and campaign logic.
Develop complex SQL queries for audience segmentation, campaign targeting, reporting, and data transformation.
Design and manage Data Extensions, subscriber data, Contact Builder relationships, and SFMC data architecture.
Develop and maintain automated processes using Automation Studio, including SQL Query Activities, imports, extracts, file transfers, and scheduled workflows.
Build and support customer journeys using Journey Builder, including entry events, decision splits, personalization, triggered communications, and journey data.
Develop responsive HTML email templates and landing pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Integrate Salesforce Marketing Cloud with Salesforce CRM and other enterprise platforms using Marketing Cloud Connect, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, SFTP, and other integration mechanisms.
Troubleshoot AMPscript, CloudPages, automations, journeys, email rendering, and data-related issues.
Perform unit testing, code reviews, deployment validation, and production support.
Develop reusable technical components and follow development standards for security, maintainability, performance, and scalability.
Maintain technical documentation for CloudPages, data models, APIs, automations, journeys, and integrations.
Work closely with marketing, business, technology, and data teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Required Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).
Strong proficiency in AMPscript, including:
Personalization
Conditional logic
Lookup functions
Data Extension reads and updates
Subscriber and contact attributes
String, date, and formatting functions
Redirects and URL handling
Error handling
Dynamic content
Strong hands-on experience developing CloudPages.
Experience developing:
Landing pages
Lead capture forms
Registration forms
Preference centers
Unsubscribe pages
Confirmation and thank-you pages
Dynamic personalized pages
Experience using AMPscript functions such as Lookup, LookupRows, RetrieveSalesforceObjects, UpsertData, InsertData, UpdateData, RequestParameter, Redirect, CloudPagesURL, and related functions.
Strong SQL skills for segmentation, data transformation, and audience management.
Hands-on experience with:
Content Builder
Email Studio
Journey Builder
Automation Studio
Contact Builder
Data Extensions
Experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Understanding of responsive email and web development.
Experience integrating SFMC with external systems using REST and/or SOAP APIs.
Experience with SFTP-based file integrations and automated data processing.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
Understanding of Salesforce Marketing Cloud subscriber, contact, and consent-management concepts.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Experience with CloudPages security and secure data handling.
Experience implementing encrypted and personalized URLs using CloudPagesURL.
Experience working with Salesforce CRM through Marketing Cloud Connect.
Familiarity with JSON and API-based integrations.
Experience building custom preference centers and consent-management solutions.
Knowledge of email deliverability and subscriber-management best practices.
Understanding of CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, and related data-privacy requirements.
Experience with enterprise-scale Salesforce Marketing Cloud implementations.
Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications are preferred.
Experience
8+ years of Salesforce Marketing Cloud development experience preferred.
6+ years of hands-on AMPscript development experience.
Demonstrated experience designing and developing CloudPages and custom landing-page solutions.
Experience supporting production marketing campaigns, automated journeys, and enterprise-scale customer communications.

Description:
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Application Support Engineer to join our IT team supporting finance-related business applications in a financial services environment.
The candidate will assist in ensuring the availability, stability, and smooth functioning of critical finance applications by monitoring systems, troubleshooting production issues, coordinating with business users and technical teams, and supporting routine operational activities.
Key Responsibilities
Provide L1/L2 production support for finance-related applications.
Monitor application health, scheduled jobs, interfaces, and batch processes.
Investigate and troubleshoot application issues, errors, and data discrepancies.
Log, track, prioritize, and resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
Coordinate with business users, infrastructure teams, database administrators, and application vendors for issue resolution.
Perform routine application checks, daily reconciliation checks, and operational monitoring.
Support scheduled deployments, patching, release activities, and change management.
Maintain incident records, technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles.
Escalate critical production issues promptly and provide timely status updates.
Participate in root cause analysis and preventive actions to reduce recurring incidents.
Support audit requirements by maintaining accurate operational records and evidence.
Required Technical Skills
Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases (SQL Server or Oracle).
Understanding of Windows & Linux Server environments and basic troubleshooting.
Familiarity with application logs, error messages, and scheduled jobs.
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, and connectivity troubleshooting.
Familiarity with ITIL concepts, incident management, and change management is an advantage.
Basic knowledge of scripting (PowerShell, batch scripts) is desirable.
Good hands on knowledge regarding Cloud architecture.
Desired Skills
Basic understanding of finance, accounting, banking, or financial services processes.
Exposure to enterprise applications, financial systems, ERP, or reporting applications.
Familiarity with monitoring tools, ticketing systems, and IT service management platforms.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good verbal and written communication.
Attention to detail and a customer-focused approach.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple incidents.
Willingness to learn business processes and technical systems.
Teamwork, accountability, and a proactive attitude.
Work Environment
The role involves supporting business-critical finance applications in a production environment. The candidate should be comfortable with time-sensitive incident resolution and occasional after-hours support during critical incidents, releases, or scheduled maintenance.

Forward Deployed Software Engineer

AI & Agent SystemsAgent Design & Workflows:
Multi-agent systems, tool-using/self-learning agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool publishing, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Graph-RAG,
prompt engineering, model selection, and accuracy-per-cost routing.Evaluation & Guardrails: LLM evaluation harnesses (labeled sets, LLM-as-judge, RAGAS), guardrails, prompt-injection defense, audit trails, and rollback mechanisms.

Orchestration & AutomationWorkflow
Orchestration: Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge for building durable, retryable, and idempotent AI pipelines.Task Management: Idempotent task design, retries, failure recovery, and backfills.

AI-Assisted Development
AI Coding Assistants: Claude, Cursor, Codex-style tools for scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, and code review

Cloud & DeploymentCloud Platforms:
AWS (Bedrock, S3, Glue, Lambda, EMR, Athena, CloudFormation, EventBridge), Kubernetes, Docker.Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (reusable modules), GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CI/CD, GitOps-style declarative deployments.

Observability & LLMOps
Monitoring & Tracing: Datadog, Grafana, Amazon CloudWatch, LangSmith for distributed tracing, prompt versioning, token/cost and latency monitoring, alerting, and regression-eval gating.

Data Platforms & Streaming
Databases: Snowflake, PostgreSQL/pgvector, MongoDB, Amazon Redshift, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Oracle, SQL Server, Teradata.
Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Apache Flink.
Vector Search: Pinecone, embeddings, chunking, reranking.

Programming & Model Training
Languages & Frameworks: Python (pandas, PySpark, REST API), SQL, PL/SQL, Unix/Linux shell scripting, pytest.
Model Training/Serving: Fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT, SFT, DPO/RLHF), distillation, quantization (GGUF/AWQ/GPTQ), self-hosted inference (vLLM, TGI), Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch
Governance, Risk & Compliance
Controls & Validation: Regulatory reporting datasets, audit trails, RBAC, PII masking, data quality controls (Great Expectations, dbt tests), governed schemas/catalogs (AWS Glue Catalog, Erwin), dimensional/semantic data modeling.
Project Experience
End-to-End AI System: Built and deployed a custom agentic GenAI system (AROS) using AWS Bedrock, Airflow, Pinecone, and Kubernetes, with CI/CD via GitHub Actions and Terraform, monitored by Datadog and Grafana, and governed by audit trails and RBAC.
Data Platform Modernization: Consolidated multiple databases (Redshift, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server) into a single governed source, orchestrated with Airflow and validated with Great Expectations

Job Title - Pricing & CPQ - Analyst - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 11 - Analyst
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad
Must have skills:PROS Smart Price Optimization

Good to have skills:Pricing Tools
Experience:2-3 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
Job Summary
Results-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2-3 years of hands-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote-to-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams-sales, finance, product, and IT-to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.
Roles & Responsibilities:
Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus
Build robust pricing models using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to track key pricing KPIs, and build leadership dashboards in visualization tools.
Work on assessing pricing processes in alignment with business imperatives and client-s sales strategy through client data diagnostics and gap analysis including current state assessment and future state design, Vendor assessment and selection.
Work on designing and implementing pricing waterfall, pricing strategy, competitive pricing, pricing elasticity, margin analysis, pricing diagnostics, pricing catalog, and contract pricing of services, leading to a positive impact on topline and bottom line for global B2B organizations
Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis & Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best-in-class KPIs
Work as an integral part of the client-s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing & CPQ area.
The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills:
2-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications & High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization & Management (POM) & Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
Knowledge of other Pricing & CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

Additional Information
Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management
PROS Smart Configure Price Quote

Description:
Electrical Supervisor

Job Overview

We are seeking a results-driven Electrical Supervisor to join our Engineering & Projects Department at Phoenix Electricals. In this role, you will lead and manage on-site electrical infrastructure operations, ensuring high-quality field execution, technical compliance, and strict
adherence to safety standards across assigned project locations.
This position reports directly to the Project Head and plays a vital role in delivering our infrastructure projects on time and within specification across our Pan-India operational footprint.
Key Responsibilities
1. On-Site Field Execution & Operations

Direct and supervise daily on-site electrical works, including overhead transmission line installation, underground cabling, substation equipment setup, and distribution infrastructure.
Coordinate field labor, riggers, fitters, and specialized sub-contractors to maintain daily execution targets.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, and tracking of project materials, heavy machinery, and specialized field equipment on site.
2. Quality Assurance & Technical Compliance
Verify that all field installation work complies with approved single line diagrams (SLDs), route layouts, engineering drawings, and quality assurance plans.
Conduct stage-wise inspections, cable insulation testing (Megger), earth resistance testing, and pre-commissioning checks.
Maintain site quality records, track punch lists, and manage request-for-inspection (RFI) procedures with client or utility representatives.

3. Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Compliance
Enforce strict compliance with site safety regulations, permit-to-work (PTW) protocols, and risk assessment procedures.
Conduct regular morning toolbox talks (TBT) covering site-specific hazards, high-voltage risks, and working-at-height safety.
Ensure 100% compliance with mandatory personal protective equipment (PPE) across all field personnel.

4. Progress Tracking & Site Coordination
Prepare and submit daily progress reports (DPR), material consumption logs, and site activity records to project management.
Assist in local site management, including Right-of-Way (RoW) clearances, utility coordination, and landowner interactions along project corridors.
Support senior engineers in measuring executed quantities for billing and subcontractor reconciliation.

Required Qualifications & Credentials
Education: ITI Or Diploma
Experience: Proven field execution experience in electrical infrastructure projects, transmission lines, cabling, or substations.

Licenses/Certifications: Valid Electrical Supervisor Competency Certificate / License issued by a State Electrical Licensing Board preferred.
Core Skills:
Strong technical understanding of high-voltage systems, earthing, stringing, and cable jointing procedures.
Ability to read and interpret complex electrical engineering drawings and site schematics.

Strong team leadership, local workforce management, and field problem-solving skills.
Physical fitness to manage active field operations under remote or outdoor site conditions.

Description:
Role Purpose
Own and drive the complete Water Purifier Service across the product lifecycle, ensuring superior customer experience, service excellence, operational efficiency, revenue growth, and profitability. The role will work closely with Product Management, R&D, Quality, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Service teams from product conception to end-of-life support.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations Excellence
Ensure achievement of category service SLAs, TAT, FFR, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets.
Drive operational excellence through Daily Work Management (DWM), Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Monitor installation, complaints, warranty, and preventive maintenance performance across Direct Service Centers (DSC) and ASP networks.
Ensure effective CRM utilization, customer registration compliance, and consumer database management.

Category Ownership & Business Responsibility
Own the overall Water Purifier Service Category performance, including customer satisfaction, operational KPIs, revenue, cost management, and profitability.
Manage end-to-end service P&L, including warranty cost, spare parts profitability, AMC business, accessories sales, installation revenue, and finished goods referrals.
Develop and execute category service strategy aligned with business growth objectives.

Product Development & NPD Support
Represent Service as a key stakeholder in New Product Development (NPD) and stage-gate reviews.
Provide field insights, voice of customer, serviceability inputs, reliability requirements, and cost optimization recommendations during product design.
Drive service readiness activities before product launch, including service manuals, spare parts planning, troubleshooting tools, training modules, and SOPs.
Monitor post-launch performance and drive corrective actions through RCA and CAPA initiatives.

Product Quality & Process Improvement
Analyze field failures, recurring complaints, and service trends to identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and collaborate with Quality, R&D, and Supplier Development teams for corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor product reliability, warranty performance, spare consumption trends, and service cost optimization.

Training & Capability Development
Develop and implement comprehensive training programs for Direct service technicians, Service managers, call center teams, and ASP partners.
Create technical training modules, e-learning content, SOPs, installation guides, service advisories, videos, and knowledge repositories.
Drive capability enhancement through field coaching, skill assessments, certification programs, and performance monitoring.

Service Content & Knowledge Management
Develop and maintain service documentation, troubleshooting guides, installation procedures, technical bulletins, warranty policies, and service advisories.
Ensure timely communication of product updates and service process changes to all stakeholders.

Spare Parts & Supply Chain Management
Own spare parts strategy, forecasting, inventory planning, availability, and lifecycle management.
Optimize spare parts cost, fill rate, inventory health, and service readiness across the network.
Drive standardization and cost-effective sourcing initiatives.

Customer Experience & Digital Service
Drive NPS, CSAT, customer retention, and service experience enhancement programs.
Monitor customer feedback from CRM, contact center, MTRSS customer and marketplaces.
Lead digital initiatives related to service automation, field mobility, self-service tools, customer communication, and analytics.

Revenue & Business Growth
Drive AMC, accessories, consumables, spare parts, upgrades, and installation revenue growth.
Develop service-led business opportunities and customer lifecycle monetization programs.
Enable referral generation and conversion for Water Purifier finished goods sales.
Monitor revenue realization, margins, and profitability across all service revenue streams.

Partner & Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with DSC team, Branch CS team, ASP partners, Category Business lead, Digital marketing team, Ecom partners, and KAMs.
Ensure alignment between service operations and business objectives through regular reviews and governance mechanisms.
Drive marketplace ratings, reviews, and service performance metrics.

Performance Management & Reporting
Establish and monitor category KPIs, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.
Review business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions.
Prepare periodic MIS, management reviews, business forecasts, and performance reports for leadership.

Key KPIs
NPS / CSAT
Service SLA & TAT Achievement
First-Time Fix (FTFR)
Installation Success Rate
Warranty Cost % to Sales
Spare Parts Availability & Fill Rate
AMC Revenue Growth
Accessories & Consumables Sales
Service Revenue & Profitability
Field Productivity
Field Failure Rate (FFR)
Marketplace Ratings & Reviews
Product Reliability & Quality Metrics
Overall Category P&L Performance

Preferred Experience

10+ years of experience in Service Operations, Product Support, Consumer Durables, Water Purifiers, Appliances, or Similar Categories.
Strong exposure to Product Development, Service Operations, Quality, Spare Parts Management, Revenue Generation, and Business Management.
Proven experience in leading large field service networks and driving customer experience transformation.
Strong analytical, commercial, stakeholder management, and leadership capabilities.

Education Qualification:
Bachelors degree, MBA with any specialization

Key Skills/Competencies:
Global mindset - Ability to understand different markets, competitor overview and set the differentiated trend for Vguard
Excellent domain knowledge
Problem Solving & Decision making
Influencing
Business Acumen
Strategic Thinking
Interpersonal Relationships
Effective Decision Making
Enabling Change Management and Developing People
Familiarity with MS office, CRM systems and other CRM related practices
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.


Job Summary
EY GDS - RCT
Staff - Python & Advanced SQL
Staff - Software Engineering
Experience: Strictly 2+ years
Eligibility requirement: Candidates must have 2-4 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on cloud experience. Freshers, candidates with less than 2 years of experience, and candidates without cloud experience are not eligible for this role.


The opportunity
Join a financial crime technology team building data-driven solutions for global financial services clients. This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.


Role overview
We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.


Key responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.
Write complex, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and investigation use cases.
Work with large financial datasets, including customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data.
Translate Financial Crime Compliance requirements into technical designs, data rules, scenarios, and reusable components.
Support KYC and AML workflows such as customer onboarding, customer risk rating, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and periodic review.
Contribute to Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud solutions, including rule implementation, threshold logic, alert generation, data validation, and issue analysis.
Develop APIs, batch jobs, automation scripts, and integration components using Python.
Perform unit testing, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and production support.
Collaborate with compliance SMEs, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders in Agile delivery teams.
Follow secure coding, version-control, documentation, and deployment practices.


Primary skills - Must have
Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
Databases: Practical experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
Data engineering: Experience processing structured data using Python libraries such as pandas and integrating with databases, files, or APIs.
APIs and services: Working knowledge of REST APIs and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Engineering practices: Git, unit testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and CI/CD fundamentals.
Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Candidates should have practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting data-driven applications or services in a cloud environment.


Good to have
Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing.
Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.


Financial Crime domain knowledge
KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.


Experience and education
Experience: Strictly 2-4 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.

Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Assists in the daily supervision restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team
- Handles employee questions and concerns.
- Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.
- Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.
- Assists in supervising daily shift operations.
- Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.
- Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.
Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations
- Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.
- Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.
- Ensures compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
- Manages to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.
- Opens and closes restaurant shifts.
Providing Exceptional Customer Service
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.
- Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
- Meets and greets guests.
Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Supervises on-going training initiatives.
- Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.
- Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.
- Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Restaurant Manager.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer with deep expertise in the Azure cloud platform and experience applying AI to CloudOps. This role is responsible for end-to-end infrastructure and deployment automation, CI/CD engineering, reliability, and incident resolution, while using generative AI and AIOps capabilities to improve observability, triage, root cause analysis, runbook automation, and operational efficiency. The role will lead escalations, design secure and governed AI-enabled operations solutions, and collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, security, data, and AI teams to deliver highly available services.
Service line - Position Title: Tech Ops_Cloud Ops_Azure_Dev Ops_Senior
Responsibilities
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
Design, deploy, and manage scalable AKS clusters for mission-critical workloads.
Implement secure cluster networking, workload identities, and governance policies.
Optimize AKS performance, reliability, and cost as part of the platform architecture.
Integrate AKS with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and monitoring solutions.
ARM Templates & Bicep
Develop reusable ARM/Bicep infrastructure-as-code templates for automated deployments.
Standardize resource deployments through parameterized and modular Bicep templates.
Migrate legacy ARM templates to Bicep for improved maintainability.
Ensure consistency, compliance, and repeatability across environments using IaC best practices.
Azure DevOps
Architect and implement end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure.
Lead DevOps automation initiatives across build, release, testing, and deployment workflows.
Implement secure DevOps practices, including secrets management and pipeline governance.
Manage Azure Repos, Boards, Pipelines, Artifacts, and environment configurations.
Landing Zone Architecture
Design and implement Azure Landing Zones aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
Define foundational architecture for identity, networking, governance, policies, and management groups.
Build scalable enterprise-ready landing zones for multi-subscription and multi-environment setups.
Implement guardrails such as Azure Policies, RBAC structures, and blueprint-style templates.
Terraform & Terraform Cloud
Develop and manage Terraform modules for consistent provisioning across environments.
Implement Terraform Cloud/Enterprise for remote state management and secure pipelines.
Automate Azure infrastructure deployments using version-controlled IaC.
Enforce policies, workspaces, and governance using Terraform Cloud capabilities.
AI-enabled CloudOps & Agentic Automation
Design and implement AI-assisted operational workflows for alert enrichment, incident triage, event correlation, root cause analysis, knowledge retrieval, and runbook execution.
Build and operate secure cloud operations agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Foundry Agent Service, Azure AI Search, and orchestration frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework or Semantic Kernel.
Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions grounded in approved runbooks, knowledge articles, telemetry, and configuration data; apply vector, hybrid, and semantic search patterns.
Integrate agents securely with operational tools and APIs using function calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP), with approval gates for production actions.
Engineer production controls for identity, private networking, secrets, prompt-injection defence, data protection.

The Opportunity
We are looking for an SAP OpenText VIM Senior Consultant to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS - TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing functional support for SAP OpenText VIM across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to address issues, implement enhancements, and optimize invoice management processes to meet business requirements.
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth as you get to work with a high-quality team to support clients, ensuring seamless invoice processing, automation, and operational excellence through best-in-class solutions, innovation, and continuous improvement.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor's degree in engineering/technology (B.E./B. Tech) or Commerce/Finance (B. Com, M. Com), MBA (Finance), CA, ICWA/CMA, or equivalent professional experience.
3-7 years of experience in SAP OpenText VIM/OpenText VIM implementation or AMS support, preferably with global clients.
Your Key Responsibilities
Responsible for providing support for SAP OpenText VIM incidents and service requests, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
Support incident resolution by analysing issues raised by users and providing effective solutions.
Work closely with customers and support teams to ensure issues and requests are followed up and addressed in a timely manner.
Handle change requests with a clear understanding of business requirements and invoice processing workflows.
Understand business needs and deliver solutions that improve invoice automation, approval workflows, and operational efficiency.
Cross-functional communication skills; experience in offshore/onsite delivery models.
Defect analysis and resolution related to SAP OpenText VIM and integrated SAP modules.
Ability to work with minimal guidance or supervision in a time-critical environment.
Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills within a global support environment.
Flexibility in managing work hours due to the nature of Application Management Services, including shift support and on-call availability for critical business requirements.
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.

Strong knowledge of SAP OpenText VIM components including: Invoice Capture Center (ICC), Document Processing, Approval Workflows, Exception Handling, Duplicate Invoice Checks, Business Rules Framework, Reporting and Analytics.
Experience with SAP FI and MM integration points, including: Accounts Payable, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Vendor Master Data, Payment Processing.
Knowledge of workflow troubleshooting, configuration, and enhancement activities.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA and VIM migration/support projects.

What you will do
Provide day-to-day Application Management support for SAP OpenText VIM and related SAP applications across IT Service Management, including service requests, incident management, enhancement requests, change management, and problem management as a Level 2 or Level 3 Application Management Specialist.
Lead and coordinate the resolution of complex VIM process issues, workflow failures, invoice processing exceptions, and system outages, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather business requirements, assess operational challenges, and provide recommendations on SAP

Description:
Position Title
TechOps_CloudOps_DevOps_Senior


The Opportunity
We are looking for a skilled Senior DevOps Engineer with expertise in AWS cloud operations, observability, incident management, and automation. The role is responsible for building and maintaining monitoring and alerting solutions, leading production incident triage and root cause analysis, and improving service reliability across AWS and heterogeneous technology platforms. The engineer will leverage AI/ML and AIOps capabilities to predict and prevent incidents, accelerate diagnostics, automate operational processes, and reduce response times while collaborating with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to deliver highly available services.


Your Key Responsibilities
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


Alerting, monitoring and Triage
Build and maintain comprehensive monitoring and alerting to proactively identify performance degradation and application disruptions
Perform end to end triage and in depth troubleshooting of production incidents by analysing logs, telemetry signals, and related diagnostic data to quickly identify root causes and restore service
Implement ML models that analyse telemetry, logs and metrics to predict and prevent incidents before they impact users.
Implement best in class detection mechanisms to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and accelerate incident response
Develop systems that learn from historical incidents, continuously improving diagnostic accuracy and accelerate incident response time
Build innovative, scalable alerting solutions across a heterogeneous technology landscape, including AWS, Unix, and Mainframe platforms.
Develop and maintain synthetic monitoring to simulate real user interactions and ensure early detection of failures.
Perform daily health checks, triage and troubleshoot alerts, and resolve issues to minimize downtime and user impact.
Conduct trend analysis, identify recurring patterns, and partner with application teams to enhance system reliability and availability


Incident Management
Participate in standard incident management processes, leveraging incident playbooks, diagnostic tools, and technical expertise to quickly identify impact and restore service
Proactively trigger incident management when early signals indicate potential disruption
Review and act on maintenance notifications, service advisories, and platform updates to mitigate operational risks.
Maintain a centralized incident response playbook, ensuring steps, processes, and escalation paths are clearly documented.
Document incidents, recovery steps, and learnings, and communicate them to relevant stakeholders to drive continuous improvement


Problem Management
Collaborate closely with application (App) development teams to identify, diagnose, and resolve operational problems impacting the platform or applications.
Act as a bridge between platform operations and development teams to ensure timely root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.


Collaboration and Continuous Improvement
Work collaboratively with developers, DevOps engineers, and IT stakeholders to improve performance, reliability, and operational maturity.
Continuously refine alerting to reduce false positives and false negatives.
Stay current with emerging observability tools, monitoring strategies, and SRE practices.
Promote and support adoption of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles across teams.
Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned
Willingness to work in a 24/7 support model, as needed


Skills and attributes for success
AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification (mandatory); AWS Solutions Architect certification preferred.


Requirements
Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience as an operations engineer, full stack developer, or automation engineer.

Job Summary
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - L&D Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Your key responsibilities
Learning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned.
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team cant support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant).
Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1-L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment.
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions.
Team
Contribute to other activities or projects across wider Talent Development functions.
Support the induction of new team members.
Skills and Attributes for Success
To qualify for the role you must have:
Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks.
Proactive problem solver with a solutions mindset, willing to adjust work schedules as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Strong IT skills, particularly in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. There will be a test to determine your knowledge.
Experience in using Power BI, PowerApps, and an openness to learn and use AI will be preferred.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Commercial acumen and business awareness.
Commitment to driving and delivering quality services and products to Talent, ensuring high standards are met.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly, adapting to changing environments and priorities.

Job Summary
We are looking for a seasoned and proactive Senior DataOps Engineer to lead and manage data operations across modern Azure/AWS based data platforms. In this role, you will take ownership of mission-critical data pipelines, contribute to reliability engineering initiatives, and guide the continuous improvement of data ingestion, transformation, and monitoring processes. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive operational excellence, troubleshoot complex issues, and help shape our DataOps strategy.
Your key responsibilities
Ensure reliability and operational stability of enterprise data pipelines through proactive monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement across cloud data platforms.
Lead the root cause analysis of recurring incidents, implement preventive actions, and establish best practices to improve system resilience.
Mentor junior engineers and guide them in incident resolution, automation, and process standardization
Collaborate with Data Engineering, DevOps, and Analytics teams to support production deployments and performance optimization.
Proactively identify gaps in data and operational workflows and implement scalable solutions using scripting, automation, AI-assisted capabilities, Agentic AI patterns, and CI/CD practices.
Drive improvements in operational processes by maintaining and enhancing runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge bases.
Ensure compliance with data governance, logging, observability, and security best practices.
Participate in rotational on-call duties and act as a point of escalation for complex operational issues
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
Skills and attributes for success
Deep understanding of cloud data services (Databricks, Snowflake, Data lakes, Informatica) and data engineering operational models.
Solid understanding of ETL/ELT design and implementation principles.
Strong SQL and PySpark skills for data transformation and validation.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on proactive incident prevention.
Experience building or supporting Agentic AI solutions integrated with enterprise data platforms, APIs, databases, or operational tools.
Experience architecting AI agents for operational use cases such as incident triage, root cause analysis, data quality investigation etc.
Ability to identify opportunities to apply AI-assisted automation within DataOps, improving monitoring, incident resolution, operational efficiency, and engineering productivity.
Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration abilities across distributed teams
Leadership mindset with experience mentoring team members or guiding junior staff
Attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality and documentation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree in computer science and engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
5-8 years of experience working in data operations, data engineering support, or application management roles
Strong experience supporting and maintaining cloud-based data pipelines, data storage and processing platforms, with hands-on experience in Databricks and Informatica.
Expertise in root cause analysis, incident resolution, and monitoring for large-scale data workflows
Experience with CI/CD tools like Azure DevOps, Git, and deployment automation
Proficiency in SQL and scripting languages such as Python or PySpark
Solid understanding of data governance, performance tuning, and cloud-based data architecture best practices.
Experience in global delivery models and distributed teams.
Excellent stakeholder collaboration skills to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
Willingness to participate in 24/7 support rotations or cover critical business hours
