Position Title: TechOps - Digital Engineering Operations - AI Engineer - Manager
As a Manager in EY GDS Tech Ops practice, you will be responsible for hands-on technical leadership, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery ownership, designing, and operationalizing intelligent AI agents and autonomous workflows that leverage LLMs, AI services, and enterprise integrations. The role requires strong expertise in AI engineering, automation, software development, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable, secure, and business-impacting Agentic AI solutions.
Your Key Responsibilities
Lead and manage a team of AI Engineers, Developers, and Solution Architects, providing technical guidance, coaching, mentoring, and career development support.
Create a high-performance culture focused on innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Own end-to-end delivery of AI and automation engagements, ensuring quality, timelines, budget adherence, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), multi-agent architectures, retrieval systems, and AI orchestration frameworks to automate complex business and engineering workflows.
Architect and implement AI-powered autonomous workflows and intelligent agents capable of reasoning, planning, decision-making, and executing tasks across enterprise systems.
Integrate LLMs, NLP, Computer Vision, and other AI/ML services into enterprise applications and platforms through APIs, SDKs, and cloud-native architectures.
Identify, analyze, and transform repetitive and high-value operational and engineering processes into scalable AI and automation solutions.
Develop custom applications, services, and automation logic using Python and modern AI frameworks to connect disparate systems and enable end-to-end workflow automation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define agent behaviors, tool integrations, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and success metrics for AI solutions.
Monitor, maintain, troubleshoot, and continuously optimize AI agents and automated workflows to ensure reliability, scalability, security, and performance.
Establish technical standards, reusable components, best practices, and reference architectures for Agentic AI and automation implementations.
Create and maintain technical documentation, solution designs, operational runbooks, and deployment guidelines for AI-powered automation solutions.
Collaborate closely with AI Platform, Engineering, Operations, and Business teams to identify, integrate, and operationalize AI services, tools, accelerators, and enterprise AI capabilities.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and agent orchestration platforms, recommending innovative solutions that drive business value and operational efficiency.
Drive adoption of AI, Agentic AI, automation solutions, and reusable accelerators across engagements, practices, and client programs.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers, contributing to solution design reviews, code quality, architecture governance, and engineering best practices.
Support business development activities related to AI and automation, including solution design, proposals, client workshops, demonstrations, and technical presentations.
Ensure all AI and automation solutions comply with organizational security, governance, risk management, privacy, and responsible AI standards.
Contribute to resource planning and technical execution by estimating effort, prioritizing work, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring successful delivery of AI initiatives.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies.
Strong understanding of Generative AI, NLP, machine learning concepts, and integration of AI services into enterprise workflows.
Experience integrating AI, automation, and enterprise systems through REST APIs, SDKs, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services.
Ability to analyze complex business and engineering processes and design scalable Agentic AI and intelligent automation solutions that deliver measurable business value.
Experience developing and deploying autonomous workflows leveraging AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and decision-making frameworks.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including AI and machine learning services.
Knowledge of vector databases/embeddings/knowledge graphs is highly desirable.

Global Managed Service - Identity and Access Management - Senior
Job Summary
As a Senior Azure AD Operations Support Analyst, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth and secure operation of Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) services within the organization. Your expertise in Azure AD will be vital in maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing identity and access management (IAM) services to support business continuity and compliance
Responsibilities
Oversee the operational management of Azure AD services, ensuring high availability, reliability, and performance.
Lead the resolution of complex Azure AD incidents and service requests, providing expert support and guidance.
Develop, maintain, and enforce operational procedures and documentation for Azure AD management.
Collaborate with IAM engineering and architecture teams to support the implementation of Azure AD solutions and integrations.
Perform regular system health checks, monitor Azure AD performance, and conduct capacity planning.
Coordinate with IT and security teams to ensure IAM operations align with security policies, compliance standards, and best practices.
Mentor junior operations support analysts and contribute to their professional development.
Manage Azure AD features such as conditional access, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and privileged identity management (PIM).
Drive automation and process improvement initiatives to enhance IAM operational efficiency.
Act as an escalation point for high-impact operational issues and provide strategic recommendations for Azure AD enhancements
Lead operational support tasks, including system monitoring, user provisioning, access reviews, and troubleshooting.
Implement and maintain operational procedures and documentation for identity services, including disaster recovery plans.
Collaborate with the IAM engineering team to transition new features and services into production, ensuring operational readiness.
Conduct regular operational reviews and audits to identify and remediate potential security gaps or inefficiencies.
Drive the automation and optimization of operational processes to enhance system reliability and reduce manual workload.
Mentor junior operations analysts and contribute to the development of training materials and best practices
Preferred Skills
Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong emphasis on Azure AD and related Microsoft identity solutions.
Demonstrated experience in operational support, incident management, and problem-solving within an IAM context.
In-depth knowledge of cloud security, IAM protocols, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.
Excellent communication and leadership abilities, with a track record of successful stakeholder management.
Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, ITIL, or similar
Education
Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
Work Requirements
Willingness to travel as required
Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
Willingness to work in shifts as required

Job Summary
As part of our Consulting Enterprise Risk team, our clients look for EY s expertise across the consulting solutions and specifically for engagements related to Internal Audit, Process compliance and reviews, SOX 404, Third Party Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance and Enterprise Risk Management.
There really is no average day in this role, since every client will have multi-faceted challenges and a distinct business environment. What it means is that you ll have an opportunity to learn and adapt to our clients cultures and contribute towards developing unique solutions that are tailored to individual engagements. Whichever industry or client you re working with, you ll have plenty of opportunities to expand your business network and transform yourself into a truly global professional.
The Opportunity
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies, by improving their processes and leveraging technologies. By plugging into our market-leading global network, youll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional Risk Advisor
Your key responsibilities
Delivery
Manage a team of Staffs (if needed) or independently deliver SOX engagements for multiple processes across client(s)
Participate in process discussions and walkthrough meetings with clients, prepare / review process flows/ narratives and risk & control matrices, and identify process gaps and provide recommendations
Conduct, documents and review (if needed) test of design and operating effectiveness, and suggest controls to improve the client s control framework, as per the defined standards and quality benchmark
Drive / Support the Manager in scoping, rationalization, standardization, status update, deficiency and project management
Monitor project progress, manage multiple assignments and related project teams, if needed
Meet quality guidelines within the established turnaround time (or allotted budget) for assigned requests
Client Management
Develop strong working relationships with the client and onshore client teams
Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with the client
Demonstrate application and solution-based approach to problem solving
Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.
Operational excellence
Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
People related
Display teamwork, integrity and leadership. Work with team members to set goals and responsibilities for specific engagements. Foster teamwork and innovation.
Utilize technology & tools to continually learn and innovate, share knowledge with team members and enhance service delivery.
Conduct workshops and technical training sessions for team members. Contribute to the learning & development agenda and knowledge harnessing initiatives.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong command on spoken and written English
Analytical, organized and meticulous consulting skills
Strong academic history and professional experience (degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or similar work experience)
Proficient in MS-Office Suite
Team player with strong interpersonal skills
Ability to prioritize deliverables effectively in order to achieve optimum results.
To qualify for the role, you must have
More than 1 year of experience after completion of CA or 3+ years of experience (as B.Com/M.Com, BBA / MBA) in risks & controls, with experience mainly in Internal Audit / SOX / internal controls
Strong academic history (degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or similar)
CIA certification is preferred
Ideally, you ll also have
Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
Opportunities to work with EY Risk -Internal Audit practices global with leading businesses across a range of industries

Job Summary
Headless CMS Developer - Contentful - Senior
EY GDS Consulting digital is looking out for experienced headless CMS developer, especially on CMS platforms like Contentful, Contentstack, Strapi etc. Experience with SEO, Web Search. Resource will be part of NCLC team delivering to clients across regions.
The opportunity
We re looking for resources with expertise in Headless CMS development, implementation, and related technologies to join the group of our NCLC Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.
Your key responsibilities
Should be able to create a complete blueprint to deploy a modernized Headless CMS on CMS platforms like Contentful, Contentstack, Strapi etc.
Hands-on expertise in Headless CMS developments with strong competencies in Next.js/React.
Prior deep experience building, developing and solutioning Drupal applications. Managing and developing Core CMS applications, application with Web Content Management and content publishing for external facing sites
Hands-on experience with frontend integration using API first approach.
Experience in multiple 3rd party integrations. Integration with CRM and ERP systems.
Should have skills to estimate the work required for developing Sitefinity based solutions. Should have
Experience in HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript
Experience in JavaScript libraries such as jQuery / Angular / React / VueJS / Ember etc
Experience in server-side development with Next.js
Expertise in developing code compliant to WCAG 2.x for user accessibility
Experience with SQL Server, NoSQL Databases such as Mongo is an added advantage.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery using DEVOPS or similar Tool.
Skills and attributes
4+ years of experience in document/record management implementation.
Exposure in developing and configuring Custom Applications and headless CMS solutions using CMS platforms like Contentful, Contentstack, Strapi etc.
Strong command of semantic HTML5 and modern CSS3 and JavaScript (ES2015+)
Experience working with JavaScript libraries such as /React/Next.js/Angular/VueJS etc
Experience with Typescript
Experience with Next.js for server-side rendering and static site generation
Experience with testing frameworks like Jest, React Testing Library or Playwright
Familiarity with source control. E.g. Git
Understanding of mobile first and modular/component-based development
Understanding of server-side development with Next.js
Experience working with task runners and bundlers, such as Gulp/Grunt and Webpack
Understanding of key website design principles and SEO optimisation
Understanding of asynchronous code
Experience developing code compliant to WCAG 2.x for user accessibility
Good problem solving, communication and interpersonal skills
Must have strong analytical and technical skills using variety of tools to deliver client-side solutions.
Must have technical competency in designing, developing, and debugging solutions.
Must have technical knowledge and experience in delivering software / platform engineering solutions (depending on specialism), providing technical advice and managing user requirements.
Object-Oriented Programming and Design Patterns.
Mentor and lead technical implementation team of 10+ Software Engineers.
Agile development methodology
Passion for the web, open-source development, and for helping us build meaningful experiences
Experience consulting strongly preferred
Ability to understand complex business processes and can transform them into programming logic
Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred.
Soft Skills
Excellent Communication Skills
Team Player
Self-starter and highly motivated
Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
Excellent presentation skills
Ability to work with globally distributed teams
To qualify for the role, you must have
A bachelors or masters degree
A minimum of 4+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm.
Strong knowledge of CMS platforms like Drupal, Strapi, Contentful etc.
Strong knowledge of TypeScript, Next.js/React JS.
Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred
Ideally, you ll also have
Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. ES- Finance and Accounting: Reporting and Analytics Centre of Excellence
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all
We provide reporting solutions or requirements through finance, markets and operations reporting along with cyclical and critical controlling processes such as Forecasting, Financial Planning, Revenue Planning, Markets Leadership Planning and Cash Reporting to help you take better business decisions. With projects like Mercury, we also support business transformation, and we are continuing to expand our services to support all Regions with their Reporting and Data Analytics needs.
The opportunity
The purpose of this job is to prepare standard reports and study Market/Engagement results, cost analysis and budgets. Analysis to conclude root causes, variances and suggest corrections to management. Design and create complex reports to user specifications. The position will ideally have to handle more complex issues and special projects than a junior financial analyst
Japan Finance Reporting and Analytics - Senior Finance Analyst
The Japan Reporting and Analytics team provides financial, operational, and strategic reporting support to Japan stakeholders across Tax, SaT, and Consulting. The team delivers weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting that enables performance monitoring, financial planning, operational transparency, and informed decision-making.
Your key responsibilities
Generate standard reports (Sales and Pipeline, Global Revenue reports) on a periodic basis and identify and solve issues that affect reporting
Knowledge of global reporting and consolidation (Area, Region, Service ling reporting)
Handle complex ad hoc reports from Stakeholders on a timely manner
Proactively take part in the revenue planning as well as financial planning process
Ensure proper review mechanism is in place for the respective teams
Develop new reports as well as enhance existing reports by working on automating the report preparation as much as possible
Mentor, guide, train junior analysts and new recruits
Skills and attributes for success
Possess statistical or data driven and problem solving skills
Have sound understanding of basic accounting concepts
Possess good communication skill
Be strong in MS Excel skill
Understand financial reporting goals and basic process flow
Ability to understand numbers and arrive at inferences
Have strong interpersonal skills with the ability to teach the juniors
To qualify for the role, you must have
3-6 years in reporting and other accounting processes.
Bachelor s degree in Accounting or Finance
Strong MS Excel skill
Knowledge of basic accounting concepts
Good communication skill
Ideally, you ll also have
Exposure to Power BI, SQL or any other visualization tools
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
Opportunities to work with EY FA practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight locations - Argentina, China, India, Philippines, Poland, Mexico, Sri Lanka and Spain and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
EY | Building a better working world
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

The opportunity
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - LD Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Your key responsibilities Learning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned.
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team cant support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships

Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1-L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment.
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions.
Team

Support the induction of new team members.

Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as one team .
Commercial acumen and business awareness.

Experience in curating and maintaining knowledge resources, including documentation and SharePoint sites, to enhance accessibility and usability for participants.
Experience in establishing and managing key stakeholder relationships, including external vendors and key internal stakeholders.
Strong team worker with an enthusiastic, can-do approach, capable of coordinating and working as one team .
AI Skills
Working knowledge of Generative AI tools and effective prompting.
Ability to leverage AI to improve efficiency, automation, reporting, and learner experience.

Experience in learning deployment or programme coordination, or a strong interest in developing a career in learning.
Experience in a professional services or corporate environment and working across international and diverse teams.

EY- Process & Controls Risk Consulting – Senior - IA Capital Projects
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
The opportunity
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
Your key responsibilities
The role requires supporting and executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate and construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
Execute assigned workstreams in client engagements and coordinate effectively with the onsite team across the MENA region.
Interact professionally with client stakeholders and support discussions with senior management.
Perform end-to-end internal audit activities, including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrices and audit work programs, control testing, documentation of findings, and preparation of draft reports.
Apply knowledge of risks, issues, trends, and end-to-end business processes in the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction sectors.
Support reviews of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
Review capital project business cases, including key assumptions, structure, and feasibility.
Perform audit procedures covering engineering, planning, and cost-related areas, including master planning, engineering phases, stage-gate methods, and design maturity.
Apply cost-estimating principles, cost-estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and undertake BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
Review procurement, contract, and commercial practices and apply project-control principles relating to schedule, cost, risk, and reporting.
Analyze the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, and risk plans, and interpret contracts, reports, and dashboards.
Review resource plans and schedules to assess their alignment with project objectives.
Complete assigned work within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards, and promptly escalate issues to engagement leadership.
Identify process improvement opportunities and develop practical, evidence-based recommendations.
Support business development activities, including research, proposal preparation, and development of marketing collateral.
Comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies at all times.
Manage multiple assigned tasks and workstreams under the guidance of engagement leadership.
Maintain proactive communication and professional working relationships with clients and team members.
Guide junior team members on assigned tasks and review their work where required.
Support engagement administration, budget monitoring, methodology development, and preparation of new solutions.
Skills and attributes for success
Excellent command of spoken and written English
Globally mobile and flexible to travel to onsite locations at short notice
Strong analytical, organizational, and consulting skills
Ability to manage assigned workstreams, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of deliverables
Ability to multitask and deliver quality work under tight deadlines
Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively
Attention to detail and commitment to quality
Proficiency in MS Office Suite, data analysis, and validation
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in Internal Audit or Risk Management, preferably within the Real Estate, Construction, or Capital Projects sector.
Experience executing or supporting audits involving cost estimation, engineering reviews, procurement, or project controls.
Ability to interpret and assess project documentation, including project charters, schedules, cost plans, and risk assessments.
A valid passport and willingness to travel internationally.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Helps drive company values and philosophy and ensures all training and development activities are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision. Works with property leadership team to identify and address employee and organizational development needs. The position is responsible for ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results. Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills. Conducts needs assessments, designs and develops training programs and facilitates the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs. Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision.
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Makes any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Managing Training Budgets
- Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.
- Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property ficial goals.
- Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Associate Director
AI Strategy
EY-Parthenon | EY Global Delivery Services (GDS)
Role Overview
EY GDS is seeking a highly experienced Associate Director - AI Strategy to lead the development and execution of AI-led business transformation engagements within EY-Parthenon s global strategy consulting practice.
This role sits at the intersection of strategy, artificial intelligence, generative AI, data analytics, digital transformation and value creation. The Associate Director will partner with global EY-Parthenon leadership and client executives to shape enterprise AI strategies, identify growth and efficiency opportunities, establish AI governance frameworks and deliver large-scale AI transformation programmes.
The individual will play a critical role in building EY-Parthenon s AI Strategy capabilities across GDS while supporting client pursuits, thought leadership, innovation initiatives and high-impact transformation engagements.
Key Responsibilities
AI Strategy Enterprise Transformation
Lead AI strategy engagements for Fortune 500 and private equity-backed organisations across sectors.
Advise C-suite executives on AI-enabled growth, operating model transformation, productivity enhancement and innovation opportunities.
Develop enterprise AI and Generative AI roadmaps aligned to business and value creation objectives.
Conduct AI maturity assessments and identify capability gaps across people, process, technology and governance.
Define target operating models for AI adoption at enterprise scale.
Support post-merger integration and value creation programmes through AI-enabled business transformation.
Generative AI Agentic AI Advisory
Identify, prioritise and evaluate AI, GenAI and Agentic AI use cases.
Design AI-driven value realisation frameworks and business cases.
Advise clients on Large Language Models (LLMs), AI platforms, intelligent automation, digital workers and emerging technologies.
Support enterprise-wide GenAI adoption strategies and scaling approaches.
Collaborate with technology teams to translate strategy into execution roadmaps.
AI Governance, Risk Responsible AI
Design and implement Responsible AI frameworks.
Establish AI governance models, controls, policies and oversight mechanisms.
Assess AI-related risks including data privacy, cybersecurity, model bias, explainability and regulatory compliance.
Support clients in developing Trusted AI and AI assurance programmes.
Advise executive stakeholders on emerging AI regulations and industry best practices.
Private Equity Value Creation Support
Partner with EY-Parthenon value creation teams to identify AI-enabled EBITDA improvement opportunities.
Support commercial due diligence and technology diligence engagements from an AI perspective.
Develop AI-led transformation opportunities for portfolio companies.
Identify opportunities for cost optimisation, process automation and operational efficiency.
Business Development Market Leadership
Lead proposal development and client presentations.
Support account growth and strategic pursuit initiatives.
Build reusable AI strategy methodologies, assets and accelerators.
Publish thought leadership, white papers and market insights.
Represent EY-Parthenon at industry forums and client events.
Leadership People Development
Lead multidisciplinary teams of strategy consultants, data scientists, AI specialists and transformation professionals.
Coach and mentor Managers, Senior Managers and Consultants.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Promote awareness of brand image internally and externally. Use sales techniques that maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott. Recognize opportunities to up-sell the customer and sell enhancements to create a better Marriott experience or event. Encourage guests or callers to purchase or schedule preview package sales/tours. Explain details and requirements related to attending a sales presentation to potential owners. Verify that individuals meet eligibility requirements for preview package sales/tours prior to scheduling a tour for a Marriott vacation club property. Determine and give complimentaries to guests as gifts for their patronage (e.g., rewards points, show tickets). Answer guest questions about property facilities/services. Receive, record, and relay messages accurately, completely, and legibly.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance; stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

Description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Support
About EY
At EY, we re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
The Opportunity
Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within the Business Enablement - Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility - the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Operations
Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.
Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.
Support preparation of leadership - ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.
Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.
Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.
Operational Excellence
Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.
Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.
Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.
Share knowledge, insights, and updates with stakeholders using agreed communication channels.
Support preparation of status reporting and dashboards, ensuring clarity in coordination with Performance & Data Insights where applicable.
Assist the triage of requests for ad - hoc analysis, reporting, and information, helping to embed new ways of working and reinforcing self - service where possible.
Stakeholder Engagement
Develop strong working relationships across domains, functions, and pods, anticipating needs and supporting broader team objectives.
Manage stakeholder communications and expectations, providing clear, timely updates on progress, risks, and next steps.
Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring follow - through on actions and high - quality execution.
Participate actively in regular update calls and forums, contributing insights and supporting other team members as needed.
Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.
Skills & Attributes for Success
Good analytical and problem - solving skills, with attention to detail.
Experience supporting operational process design, improvement, and handoff.
Competence in reporting, data visualization, and storyboarding, with the ability to translate data into clear insights.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, delivering high - quality outputs under tight timelines.
A client - focused mindset, with the ability to respond to changing needs and redirect effort as required.
Clear, confident communicator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders effectively.
Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.
Familiarity with AI/other automation to enhance processes, project outcomes and personal deliverables
What we offer you
At EY, we ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Designation: Associate/Senior Associate Customer Service
Experience: 0 - 6 years
Location: Trivandrum
Skill Required: Excellent communication skill, Word, Excel and Outlook

The Associate Customer Service representative is responsible for delivering exceptional customer support through inbound calls and web-chat channels. The role involves assisting new and existing customers with insurance products, handling policy-related queries, supporting sales activities, and providing efficient after-sales service while ensuring a positive customer experience.

Key Responsibilities
Handle inbound customer calls and web-chat interactions professionally and efficiently.
Assist prospective customers by providing product information, quotations, and support for motor and home insurance products.
Support sales activities by guiding customers through the policy purchase process using internal systems and underwriting guidelines.
Identify customer needs and provide appropriate solutions while maintaining service quality standards.
Deliver a positive and professional customer experience across all touchpoints.
Resolve customer queries efficiently while adhering to company policies and procedures.
Escalate complex issues to appropriate teams when necessary.
Meet established service, quality, and productivity targets.
Work collaboratively with team members to achieve departmental goals.
Participate in training programs and continuously update product and process knowledge.
Support a culture of continuous improvement and customer-centric service delivery.

Required Skills & Competencies
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Ability to learn and use internal customer service and insurance systems effectively.
Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with customers.
Self-motivated and proactive approach to work.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.

Job Summary
As a Functional Test Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring software quality through manual testing practices. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, execute test cases, and support the overall testing lifecycle. This role is ideal for junior candidates with a strong foundation in manual testing.


Roles and Responsibilities
Understand and analyze project requirements and acceptance criteria.
Design, write, and execute manual test cases for applications.
Perform Functional, UI, Regression, and Smoke testing.
Identify, log, track, and verify defects throughout the defect life cycle.
Prepare and manage test data required for test execution.
Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to clarify requirements and raise concerns.
Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
Support release activities and maintain test documentation.
Contribute ideas to improve testing processes and efficiency.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
Around 1 year of hands-on experience in manual testing.
Familiarity with Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
Strong understanding of requirement analysis, test case preparation, and execution.
Basic knowledge on API manual testing using Postman or similar tools.
Exposure to test management tools like Jira, Xray, or TestLink is a plus.
Basic understanding of cross-browser and cross-device testing.
Good to have knowledge/experience in the E-commerce domain.
Strong attention to detail with excellent problem-solving and logical thinking abilities.
Ability to communicate clearly and work well within a team environment.
Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and meet deadlines
Eagerness to learn and grow in the testing domain.

Description:
Picture yourself brightening someones day. When you join our Hotels team, thats exactly what youll do every time you come to work. As a Food Beverage Attendant, youll play an essential role in delivering friendly, attentive, and efficient service across our dining outlets.
Whether welcoming guests, taking orders, serving food and beverages, or ensuring the outlet is ready for service, youll help create experiences that make every stay special.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Previous experience in food and beverage, hospitality, or customer service is preferred.
A passion for delivering friendly and attentive guest service.
Basic knowledge of food and beverage service procedures.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Positive, team-oriented, and adaptable approach.
Well-presented, reliable, and committed to maintaining high service standards.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform the physical requirements of the role.
Heres what youll do during a typical day:
Deliver warm and attentive service: Welcome guests, take orders accurately, serve food and beverages, and respond promptly to guest requests.
Create memorable guest experiences: Build positive relationships with guests, anticipate their needs, and handle feedback professionally.
Maintain service excellence: Follow Hiltons service standards and ensure food and beverages are presented and delivered to the highest quality.
Support smooth outlet operations: Assist with table setup, clearing, resetting, cleaning, and preparing the outlet before, during, and after service.
Work effectively as a team: Coordinate closely with colleagues, supervisors, kitchen teams, and other departments to ensure seamless service.
Support revenue and efficiency: Promote menu items and special offers where appropriate, process orders accurately, and minimize wastage.
Uphold health and safety standards: Follow food safety, hygiene, sanitation, alcohol awareness, and workplace safety procedures at all times.
Develop your skills: Participate in training and continuously build your knowledge of menus, service techniques, and hospitality standards.

Job Title: Senior Business Analyst- Assistant Director
Experience- 10 to 16
Location- Bangalore, Kochi

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with experience implementing global projects and programs with a high level of competency in Talent systems.  The ideal candidate will play a key role in gathering complex requirements, designing integrated solutions, and contributing to the strategic use of Talent data to support business objectives.

Your key responsibilities:
Requirement Gathering: Lead the gathering of complex business requirements from stakeholders, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of needs related to Talent systems, with a focus on SAP SuccessFactors and data integration
Process Engineering/Optimization: Analyze existing Talent processes, identify areas for optimization, and recommend solutions that leverage SAP SuccessFactors and other technologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
Data Integration: Collaborate with data architecture team to enable the data integration strategy, working closely with the technical teams. Work seamlessly to achieve efficient data exchange between SAP SuccessFactors and other relevant systems, with a focus on data quality and accuracy
Solution Design: Collaborate with technical teams to design integrated solutions, translating business needs into technical requirements, data mapping, security (RBP), and system functionalities
Data Analysis: Perform advanced data analysis, identifying trends, patterns, and insights from Talent data, and presenting findings to support data-driven decision-making
Documentation: Create detailed requirement documents, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents, and other relevant documentation to guide project implementation
Stakeholder Management: Engage with business stakeholders, executive leadership, and project teams, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and delivery of project objectives
Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain best practices for data quality, testing, and validation to ensure that SAP SuccessFactors and integrated systems meet business needs and quality standards
Change Management: Drive change management efforts to support end-users in adapting to new systems and processes resulting from SAP SuccessFactors implementations
Continuous Improvement: Proactively seek opportunities for process improvement, recommend enhancements to business processes and system functionalities

Skills and attributes for success
In-depth knowledge of Talent processes, system functionalities, data integration methodologies, and best practices
Proficiency in data analysis and tools, database query languages (e.g., SQL), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights
Excellent documentation and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong project management capabilities, including the ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams
Positive attitude, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
Results-oriented, with a focus on achieving project objectives and driving positive outcomes
Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills
Ability to work virtually with global teams

To qualify for this role
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; additional certifications in business analysis or SAP SuccessFactors preferred
Proven experience as a Senior Business Analyst with a focus on Talent systems, SAP SuccessFactors, and data integration
As a Senior Business Analyst, 8 to 10 years of industry experience preferably in Talent

Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

Additional Information
Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.
AI/ML or Generative AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, NVIDIA, or other recognized technology providers are advantageous.
Experience working in large enterprise environments, consulting organizations, or complex multi-cloud transformation programs.
Experience defining or contributing to organizational AI architecture standards, Generative AI platforms, AI Centers of Excellence, or enterprise AI governance frameworks would be advantageous.

We are looking for experienced SAP CPI Consultants to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting integration solutions using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and SAP Integration Suite.The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Scripting, OData Services, API integrations, and cloud-based integration scenarios. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.

Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
Role : Data Modeler
Experience Guide : 6 to 15 years
Primary Skill Area : Data Architecture & Data Modeling
The opportunity
We are seeking a highly skilled Data Modeler / Data Architect with strong expertise in Enterprise Data Modelling, Data Architecture, Semantic Modelling, Data Governance, and Wealth & Asset Management data domains. The ideal candidate will lead enterprise-scale data modelling and transformation initiatives while collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders.
The candidate should possess strong experience in logical, physical, and dimensional data modelling, enterprise architecture, data governance, data quality, data lineage, semantic modelling, Ontologies, and either Knowledge Graphs or AI-enabled Data Engineering practices.
Your key responsibilities
Skills and attributes for success
Must Have - Physical Data Modelling, Logical Data Modelling, Dimensional Modelling, Enterprise Architecture, Strong SQL Skills, Erwin or ER/Studio (either one mandatory), CI/CD, Wealth & Asset Management (WAM) Domain Knowledge, Data Governance, Data Lineage, Data Quality, Semantic Modelling, Enterprise Data Warehousing, Data Warehouse Design & Development, Enterprise ETL Architecture, and strong experience in Ontologies, and either Knowledge Graphs or AI skills on data engineering.
Preferred - Conceptual Data Modelling, Oracle SQL Developer Data Modeler, Git, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Semantic Layer Design.
To qualify for the role, you must have
6 to 15 years of experience in Data Modelling, Data Architecture, Enterprise Data Warehousing, or Data Engineering.
Strong hands-on expertise in Physical, Logical, and Dimensional Data Modelling.
Proven experience designing enterprise-scale data models and enterprise data warehouse solutions.
Experience using Erwin and/or ER Studio for enterprise data modelling.
Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
Strong understanding of Enterprise Architecture principles and data modelling best practices.
Experience implementing Data Governance, Data Quality, and Data Lineage initiatives.
Prior experience within Wealth & Asset Management, Investment Management, or Capital Markets is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of Semantic Modelling concepts and modern data architecture patterns.
Strong experience in Ontologies, and either Knowledge Graphs or AI skills on data engineering.
Experience working within CI/CD-enabled development environments.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Experience leading enterprise data transformation initiatives.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Ideally, you'll also have
Graph Data Modeling, RDF, OWL, SPARQL, GraphRAG, Semantic Search, Enterprise Search, Vector Search, AI Knowledge Retrieval, LLM Grounding, Agentic AI, AI-Ready Data Products, ETL/ELT, APIs, Databricks, Snowflake, KPI Frameworks, Data Storytelling, Insight Generation, Advanced SQL, Business Analysis, AI Observability, Documentation, and Architecture Support.
What we look for
We look for professionals who combine strong hands-on delivery, architecture awareness, stakeholder collaboration, production ownership and a continuous learning mindset.
What working at EY offers
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

Job Title: Learning Deployment Specialist
Job Summary:
Talent Services is a core service function within the Global Delivery Services organization, providing multiple HR and learning related support services including Recruitment support, Onboarding support, People Data Administration, Learning Administration, Cross Border Travel, Global Mobility and Performance Management support to EY member firms.
Talent Services supports Europe West (EW) as part of the extended Region Learning team. It is fully integrated with onshore colleagues in Europe West and participates in meetings, projects and planning activities as part of one team. It is aligned with the Learning Global Process Model and initiates learning processes through the existing workflow for execution by the CAT and DAT teams.
The person selected for this role will be at the rank of Senior Associate and will be responsible for the deployment of multiple courses within one or more curricula for Europe West, working alongside the Senior Deployment Specialist and/or Learning Program Manager. The Senior Associate will oversee learning administration activities and report on course feedback. (50%)
The Senior Associate will support the end-to-end program lifecycle, including program planning, stakeholder coordination, participant and facilitator management, communications, learning logistics, program documentation, delivery readiness, evaluation, and continuous improvement. (50%)
Applications Used: SuccessFactors (Learning Management System), ServiceNow

Deployment (0.5 FTE)
Ensure end-to-end coordination of learning deployment activities, including validating training request forms, submitting item and class requests, and ensuring that CE credits are awarded.
Submit requests for online, virtual, and physical classroom sessions, as well as program requests in SuccessFactors for learner consumption.
Address learner queries related to credits, class requests, and compliance.
Monitor participant nominations and manage cancellations, no-shows and missed sessions.
Monitor and analyse reports, including credit reports, NASBA reports and evaluation feedback.
Ensure CE credits are awarded to learning participants and instructors, where applicable.
Build and maintain close working relationships with the EW Learning team.
Program Management (0.5 FTE)
Support EW Tax Learning Leads in executing regional learning priorities and learning initiatives.
Coordinate the planning and delivery of Europe West Tax learning programs, including timelines, action trackers, governance activities and key deliverables.
Manage participant, facilitator and stakeholder engagement activities, including nominations, communications, briefing activities and delivery readiness.
Support stakeholder meetings and governance forums, including agenda preparation, documentation, action tracking and follow-up.
Maintain program documentation, status reports, trackers and learning resources.
Support virtual and face-to-face learning events, including learner experience, logistics coordination and delivery support.
Monitor risks, dependencies and program actions, escalating issues where appropriate.
Analyse participant and stakeholder feedback, evaluate program outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with business stakeholders, facilitators and learning teams across Europe West.

Stakeholder management.
Strong IT skills in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook and SharePoint.

Strong team player with an enthusiastic, can-do approach and the ability to coordinate and work as one team’.
Drive the delivery of quality services and products to Talent.

Work with minimal supervision and guidance

A user-centric mindset with creative, innovative, and analytical approach
Working knowledge of creating infographics and data visualization techniques
Excellent communication (comprehension, verbal and written) and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate and persuade
Exceptional attention to detail
Ability to interact effectively and positively in a fast-paced environment
Understanding of current and future visual trends
Aptitude for art direction

Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop
5+ years of relevant experience

Team management experience
