Learning Deployment Specialist Senior Associate
The opportunity
As a Learning Deployment Specialist within the GDS Talent Services - L&D Hub, you will coordinate the end-to-end deployment of learning programmes and projects for EY teams across regions and time zones. You will manage schedules, learning-system setup, logistics, budgets, compliance and stakeholder engagement, while producing virtual sessions as needed and delivering a consistent, high-quality learner experience in line with agreed service levels.
Your key responsibilities
Learning and project deployment
Build initial course scheduling offering schedule for review
Submit requests to schedule offerings and to publish content in SuccessFactors
Support the end-to-end execution of Learning course deployment plans and budgets, including conference and event management including:
Arranging training material
Monitoring of participant nominations working alongside Deployment Administration Team
Management of learner cancellations, no shows and missed sessions, including coordinating training dates and nominations from different areas of the business
First point of contact for queries from the practice in relation to the courses assigned, in addition to ongoing management of learning mailboxes and referrals from Deployment Administration Team
Prepare facilitators for delivery of Learning courses (logistics) and support in the management of facilitators
Provide oversight of Learning Deployment administration activities, taking responsibility for the detailed review of work performed by the Deployment Administration Team assigned.
Manage and maintain SharePoint sites and maintain content relevancy for SL, curriculum, program or course including joining instructions (if required), learner, facilitator information
Support the hosting and production of online modules, webcasts and virtual learning projects. Advise on best practice, for example interactivity during virtual classroom sessions
Virtual Producer role where Virtual Producer team can't support
Realise operational excellence through maintaining thorough understanding of, and adherence to, the Learning Deployment Operating Model
Ideas generation and rollout of networking elements within virtual learning programmes
Venue booking, accommodation booking for residential courses and ongoing management
Ensure CE credits awarded to Learning participants and instructors where applicable
Supporting on projects across the Learning and/or Leadership Development TD team(s) as required
Financial Management
Support the budget, accruals, forecasts, and actual costs of courses/projects you are responsible for.
Support all Finance related activities as per the Deployment model.
Support with monthly/annual finance activities/requests from Enablement/Operations team.
Stakeholder Relationships
Build and maintain close working relationships with onshore and offshore colleagues.
Build and maintain close working relationships with Deployment Administration team (where relevant).
Coach and support the Deployment Administration team to increase their knowledge, skills and competence within their role along with their understanding of the region, by providing transparent and supportive feedback.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders relevant for courses and client groups to enable the successful deployment. Stakeholders may include Deployment Administration Team, Portfolio Managers, Senior Learning Associates, Learning Associates, Enablement team, Service Line Talent Development Teams, Global Deployment Team, Facilitators, external suppliers.
Measure Learning
Access reports on Learning course L1–L3 evaluation feedback and analyse feedback from course participants to continually improve course offerings.
Accurate reporting and tracking of course consumption and satisfaction reporting.
Continuous Improvement
Document lessons learned and refine deployment processes.
Stay updated on SuccessFactors features and best practices in learning deployment.
Generate new ideas/suggest improvements/possible solutions.
Team
Contribute to other activities or projects across wider Talent Development functions.
Support the induction of new team members.

Strong project management skills to deliver and ensure seamless execution of portfolio tasks.
Proactive problem solver with a solutions mindset, willing to adjust work schedules as necessary to meet peak demands and customer requirements.
Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Strong IT skills, particularly in the Microsoft Office 365 suite, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and SharePoint. There will be a test to determine your knowledge.
Experience in using Power BI, PowerApps, and an openness to learn and use AI will be preferred.
Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels.
Strong team worker, with enthusiastic, can-do approach, with ability to coordinate and work as “one team”.
Commercial acumen and business awareness.
Commitment to driving and delivering quality services and products to Talent, ensuring high standards are met.
Ability to learn new processes and skills quickly, adapting to changing environments and priorities.
Ability to engage and influence others, demonstrating good change management skills and a desire to drive process improvements.
Experience in curating and maintaining knowledge resources, including documentation and SharePoint sites, to enhance accessibility and usability for participants.
Experience in establishing and managing key stakeholder relationships, including external vendors and key internal stakeholders.
Strong team worker with an enthusiastic, can-do approach, capable of coordinating and working as “one team”.
AI Skills
Working knowledge of Generative AI tools and effective prompting.
Ability to leverage AI to improve efficiency, automation, reporting, and learner experience.
Experience
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline; a Human Resources diploma is an advantage.
Experience in learning deployment or programme coordination, or a strong interest in developing a career in learning.
Experience in a professional services or corporate environment and working across international and diverse teams.

Bachelor's degree in business administration, Human Resources or a related discipline; a Human Resources diploma is an advantage.
Experience in learning deployment or programme coordination, or a strong interest in developing a career in learning.
Experience in a professional services or corporate environment and working across international and diverse teams.
Additional Requirements
Training or certification in producing Microsoft Teams, Zoom or Webex sessions is highly desirable/essential.
Flexibility to work European Time Zone business hours; adjust schedules for peak demand and virtual learning support when required.
What we offer
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development and you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Process Improvement

An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. Youll also involve in identifying potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
The opportunity
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced SAP Senior to perform our technical reviews and assessment of complex SAP ERP security design control reviews and assessment projects. The ideal candidate must possess deep technical expertise in SAP ERP solutions including SAP cloud applications etc., strong technical skills, and a proven track record of working and delivering high-quality work for SAP solutions. This role requires excellent communication and client management abilities.
Your key responsibilities
Perform technical review in the SAP security design, implementation of SAP ERP and SAP Cloud solutions.
Review technical specifications and design documents.
Expertise on security configuration standards and best practices for SAP Solutions.
Conduct technical design control review sessions and provide guidance to the team & serve as a technical point of contact for clients and stakeholders
Experience in Implementation of solutions like SAP S4 Hana, SAP ECC, Fiori, Success Factor etc
Strong understanding of SAP security, SoD and related access controls.
Experience with data migration and conversion strategies
Manage client expectations and ensure client satisfaction.
Proactively find ways to improve client systems, and processes that improves their technical environment
Perform control testing for both ITAC & ITGC as per the client scope and requirement.
Contribute to the Risk Consulting team as a key member and assist with facilitating practice wide training (SAP ITGC/ SAP ITAC /SAP Pre & Post Implementation reviews) curriculum.
Work closely with onshore, cross-functional teams and develop strong relationships across the organization, especially with Onsite team.
Skills and attributes for success
Minimum 3 years of experience in SAP Solution security design, review and implementation.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience in SAP ERP modules across various domains.
Experience in Data Migration, Templates, Knowledge of data models and web services in cloud
Hands-on experience in Documentation, writing Technical Specs, Test Scripts, SIT, UAT, Code Reviews, Deployments, and SDLC Change Management processes.
Experience in performance tuning of SAP Security configurations is highly desirable.
Strong team player, highly motivated, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of SAP S4 Hana, SAP ECC, SAP Cloud services and architecture.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools like JIRA.
Basic Experience with machine learning and AI integration in SAP Cloud applications.
Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards in cloud environments.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Should have hands on experience and strong knowledge on technical activities performed in S4 Hana and Success factors covering all key modules of Finance, HR and Payroll
Must have valid passport with minimum 6 free pages and should be willing to travel on short term for client site work assignments especially to Middle East as and when required depends on project requirements.
Excellent communication, presentation skills and consulting mindset
Client handling experience.
Willing to work in MENA Shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).
A valid passport for travel.

SAP certified professional
Ideally, you’ll also have
A bachelor's or master's degree (B.TECH/B.E/M.TECH/MBA-Finance)
Core experience in SAP Solutions design and implementation functions.
Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience working in SAP S4 Hana
Experience in at least one full life cycle implementation, with at least one implementation on SAP solutions
Experience in a client-facing delivery role.
Experience in major industry sectors like retail, government, energy, real estate, oil & gas, power & utilities.

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. Description:
Job Title: Medical Science Liaison
Working Title: Medical Affairs Manager
Job Summary
The MSL acts as the medical and scientific expert for Terumo BCT India, driving Medical Affairs strategy, medical education, scientific support, and research. The role focuses on apheresis and cell therapies, addressing unmet medical needs through literature review, data analysis, and collaboration with healthcare professionals. The MSL builds therapy adoption programs with key opinion leaders, supports clinical trials, publications, and congresses, and partners with the commercial team to explore new therapeutic areas. Additionally, the role provides guidance to team members, while addressing high-level scientific inquiries and procedure optimization.
Responsibilities
Build and maintain credible scientific relationships with healthcare professionals, thought leaders, medical associations, and patient advocacy groups in India.
Serve as the primary Medical Affairs contact, facilitating scientific and clinical information exchange (verbal, written, or electronic) with healthcare professionals and decision-makers.
Deliver scientific presentations, medical education programs, and pharmacoeconomic data to key accounts, therapeutic committees, and professional groups in compliance with ethical and regulatory standards.
Maintain expert knowledge in Terumo BCT's therapeutic areas by reviewing literature, attending scientific conferences, and collaborating with global Medical Affairs teams.
Provide medical/scientific insights to support commercialization, product innovation, unmet medical needs, and marketing strategies.
Develop scientific communication resources and training materials for internal teams (sales, marketing, etc.).
Participate in and provide scientific coverage at national/state-level conferences, symposia, and CMEs; capture and report medical insights to internal stakeholders.
Support investigator-initiated and collaborative studies, ensuring timely submissions and monitoring competitive intelligence.
Assist customers with data abstraction, analysis, and publication of clinical, operational, or scientific findings related to Terumo BCT products.
Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects, advisory boards, scientific symposia, speaker training, and internal capability-building initiatives.
Respond to and track medical information requests with accurate, unbiased, and timely communication.
Represent Medical Affairs at trade shows, internal meetings, and scientific events, providing strategic input and post-event insights.
Minimum Qualification Requirements
Education
Medical Doctor (MD), PhD with a background in biotechnological / medical science is preferred
Experience
A minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Medical Affairs within a medical devices or pharmaceutical company. Prior exposure to hematology, apheresis, or cell therapy will be considered.
Skills
Hematology
Apheresis

Physical Requirements
Typical Office Environment requirements include: reading, speaking, hearing, close vision, walking, bending, sitting, and occasional lifting up to 60 pounds.
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.
Additional Physical Requirements
Extensive Travel required (up to 80%)

Role: Workday Financials Delivery Manager
Experience: 10 to 15 years
Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certification: Workday certification (Mandatory)

The Opportunity

As a Workday Financials Delivery Manager at PwC AC, you will lead delivery across Workday Financial Management engagements with a focus on Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and overall delivery coordination.
The role combines strong Workday Financials functional knowledge with delivery leadership. You will coordinate across functional and technical workstreams, manage priorities and dependencies, oversee quality and timelines, and act as a key point of contact for client and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Workday Financials delivery across R2R and P2P workstreams, ensuring alignment on scope, priorities, timelines and dependencies.
Provide functional oversight across areas such as general accounting, journals, close, supplier accounts, procurement, expenses, payments and settlements.
Work with client stakeholders to understand business priorities, assess requirements and guide solution decisions.
Manage delivery of enhancements, production support, releases and continuous improvement initiatives.
Review solution designs and functional deliverables to ensure quality, scalability and alignment with Workday leading practices.
Coordinate across Financials, Integrations, Reporting, Security and other dependent workstreams to resolve issues and manage end-to-end impacts.
Track delivery risks, issues, dependencies and escalations, and drive them to closure.
Lead planning, prioritization and allocation of work across the team while balancing delivery commitments and capacity.
Provide guidance, coaching and functional oversight to Senior Associates and Associates.
Support stakeholder reporting, governance discussions and overall service delivery performance.
What You Bring
Approximately 810 years of relevant experience, including strong hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management and experience leading delivery or functional workstreams.
Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.
Ability to independently manage delivery planning, risks, dependencies and team execution.
Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing functional direction.
Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.
Workday Financial Management certification or relevant accreditation is preferred.

Description:
Experience Management Supervising Associate
About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Leadership:
Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Planning & Optimization:
Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.
Performance Management:
Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.
Stakeholder Management:
Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.
Data & Analytics:
Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.
Skills and attributes for success:
Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
Demonstrate an eye for detail
Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer you:
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life
The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) business partners with healthcare professionals across India to expand access to therapies that help diagnose and treat cardiac rhythm disorders. This role is part of the downstream marketing function, responsible for developing and executing portfolio strategy, supporting product launches, driving therapy adoption, and enabling commercial success across a diverse healthcare landscape. The position works closely with regional sales teams and cross-functional partners to execute market development initiatives, strengthen customer engagement, and support business growth for the CRM portfolio.
This position can be based in Gurgaon or Mumbai and follows a Flex work model. Travel up to 10% is required to support customer engagement, field collaboration, industry events, and strategic business initiatives across India.
As a Senior Marketing Specialist, you will lead downstream marketing initiatives for the Cardiac Rhythm Management portfolio across India. The role combines strategic planning, commercial execution, market development, and stakeholder engagement to drive portfolio growth. You will collaborate with global and regional teams, translate market insights into actionable strategies, and partner with sales teams to improve customer engagement, therapy adoption, and business performance.
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
Develop and execute portfolio marketing plans, including competitive positioning, pricing strategy, revenue forecasting, budget management, and brand initiatives.
Partner with global marketing teams to adapt regional strategies and implement market-specific growth plans.
Lead product launch activities, including clinical messaging, pricing recommendations, sales enablement, and customer engagement programs.
Manage inventory planning, demand forecasting, and portfolio performance to support business objectives and minimize obsolescence.
Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, market trends, and customer needs.
Drive market development and patient awareness initiatives through physician engagement, digital campaigns, educational programs, and therapy adoption activities.
Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, healthcare stakeholders, and industry partners to support therapy expansion and portfolio growth.
Collaborate with sales, regulatory, legal, clinical, public relations, and research and development teams to ensure aligned and effective execution of marketing strategies.
Required Qualifications
Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. • 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 3 years relevant experience.
Experience developing and executing marketing strategies, product launches, and commercial growth initiatives.
Experience in market analysis, forecasting, pricing strategy, and business planning.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders.
Experience presenting business insights and recommendations to customers, sales teams, or leadership audiences.
 Preferred Qualifications
Master of Business Administration.
Experience in medical devices, cardiovascular therapies, cardiac rhythm management, or related healthcare markets.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint for business analysis and presentations.
Experience leading physician engagement, therapy awareness, or market development initiatives.
Experience working with global teams and supporting regional portfolio growth strategies.

Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
What you will be doing:
Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.
What we need to see:
Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:
Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

Description:
Role Overview
The Assistant Cluster Lead will support the Cluster Lead in managing operations across multiple residential & comemrcial communities. The incumbent will be responsible for driving operational excellence, team effectiveness, vendor performance, customer satisfaction, governance compliance, and financial discipline across assigned sites while ensuring adherence to organizational standards and service commitments.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Management
Support the Cluster Lead in overseeing daily facility management operations across assigned communities.
Ensure implementation and adherence to FM guidelines, SOPs, statutory requirements, and work instructions.
Conduct regular site visits and operational audits to ensure service quality and compliance.
Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance activities across sites.

Team Management
Guide, mentor, and supervise Site Managers, Community Executives, and operational teams.
Ensure manpower deployment, attendance management, roster adherence, and workforce productivity.
Support hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management of site teams.
Drive a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.

Financial Management
Review operational expenses and support budget control across assigned sites.
Monitor monthly budgets and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
Coordinate with Finance for billing, collections, vendor payments, and financial reconciliations.
Assist in achieving revenue and profitability targets for assigned communities.

Stakeholder Management
Build strong relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), Management Committees, and Developer Representatives.
Support governance meetings and ensure closure of action items.
Act as a key escalation point for operational and service-related issues.

Customer Experience
Drive resident satisfaction by ensuring timely resolution of complaints and service requests.
Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives.
Support resident engagement activities and community-building programs.
Minimize escalations through proactive issue identification and resolution.

Vendor Management
Monitor vendor performance against defined SLAs, KPIs, and contractual commitments.
Conduct periodic vendor reviews and service quality audits.
Ensure compliance with safety, statutory, and operational standards.
Support onboarding and governance of service partners.

Compliance & Governance
Ensure adherence to EHS guidelines, statutory compliances, and internal audit requirements.
Monitor documentation, licenses, certifications, and compliance trackers.
Support implementation of risk mitigation and corrective action plans.

Review & Reporting
Prepare and review Monthly Management Reports (MMR), operational dashboards, and business review presentations.
Track key operational, financial, and customer experience metrics.
Share periodic updates with stakeholders and management on site performance.

Educational Qualification
Any Graduate / BE/ B.Tech/ MBA/ Hospitality courses/ BHM (Any)

Experience
8-17 years of experience in Facility Management, Property Management, Community Management, or Operations.
Experience managing residential townships, premium housing societies, or mixed-use developments preferred.
Prior experience leading multiple sites and vendor management is desirable.

Job Location: Mumbai / Pune /Chandigarh / Bangalore
Industry: EdTech / Education / Online Learning
Department: Sales, Admissions & Student Counselling
Experience: 1 to 3 Years (Freshers with Excellent Communication Skills are also Welcome)

Job Description

We are looking for enthusiastic and target-oriented professionals to join our growing EdTech team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for counselling prospective students, promoting educational programs, managing leads, and driving admissions and course enrolments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Connect with prospective students through inbound and outbound calls, emails, chats, and online platforms.
- Counsel students regarding online UG/PG programs, management courses, diplomas, certifications, and professional learning programs.
- Understand students' career goals and recommend suitable educational programs.
- Follow up with interested leads and convert enquiries into admissions and enrolments.
- Schedule video counselling sessions, online demos, and program discussions where required.
- Manage the complete sales funnel, from lead engagement to conversion.
- Achieve monthly admission and revenue targets.
- Maintain lead records, follow-ups, and sales reports using CRM tools and Excel.
- Build strong relationships with students and parents while ensuring a positive counselling experience.

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline.
- Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills can apply for eligible entry-level roles.
- Experienced candidates with backgrounds in EdTech Sales, B2C Sales, Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, or Business Development are preferred for experienced positions.
- Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple leads.
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, CRM tools, and dialer operations.
- A customer-focused attitude with a passion for education and career counselling.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary as per experience, skills, and company norms.
- Attractive performance-based incentives.
- Opportunity to work in the growing EdTech and online education sector.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.

Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities.

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

National comprises of sector agnostic teams working across industries for a well rounded experience.
ASU - Forensics - Discovery :

Hands-on experience in cyber incident responses.

Ability to apply structured consulting frameworks to organize investigations, analyze findings, and deliver clear project outputs.

People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements.
You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions.
We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.
Role Summary The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers. Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV). Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate. Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition.


Qualifications
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Sr. Manager / Manager Branch Sales Gurgaon, Chandigarh, Surat, Vizag, Bangalore, Patna, Jamshedpur

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated track record of significant accomplishments in Strategic Marketing, Product Management and/ or Business Operations, in the Aerospace industry. Candidates from other industries with a strong background and aptitude for Strategic Marketing, Product Management and Business Operations will also be considered:

Bachelor s Degree or equivalent work experience. Technical background preferred. Eight or more years of Aerospace experience preferred. Experience in Strategic Marketing, Strategic Planning, Forecasting, Business Operations and Product Management preferred. Computer skills including Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Excellent communication skills spoken and written. Superlative time management skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Main Duties and Responsibilities:

Develop, own and drive for Sales targets assigned by the Head of Sales. Develop, foster and grow relationships with clients to grow a network of clients. Takes ownership of Sales responsibilities for Region and Sector assigned. Gather business requirements and needs of clients. Own the RFP/ RFI/ RFQ and Bid management process for their own clients. Keep ears-on-the-ground and to be aware of developments, issues and competition at client site. Keeps abreast of industry/ sector updates especially to do with competition. De-escalate internal and client facing issues. Lead generation and follow-up. Lead filtering & database management Prepare a multitude of Sales reports Prepare, Lead and participate in client meetings Preparation and lead Sales pitches, presentation, Service packs

Description:
Job Summary
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that its your career and Its yours to build which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Technical Excellence

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. The opportunity : Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh


GOV
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.


SaT
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.


SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.

Brief Summary
The Executive at ORRA Fine Jewellery is responsible for providing exceptional customer service, driving sales conversion, and building long-term customer relationships. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in retail sales.

1. Attend to customer requirements with a focus on driving sales conversion and delivering excellent customer experiences.
2. Inform customers about new designs, schemes, and offers to promote sales and customer engagement.
3. Support local area activities in collaboration with the Relationship Executive.
4. Assist with the try-at-home scheme based on instructions from the Store Manager.
5. Follow up with potential customers and visit them to close sales.
6. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships.
Desired Skills
1. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in retail sales.
2. Strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
3. Proven track record of meeting sales targets.
4. Detail-oriented and organized.
5. Ability to work well in a team.
6. Flexible availability, including weekends and holidays.

Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV: Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,
commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.
