Tele Sales Executive

Department: Sales
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at NoBroker as a Tele Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and sell properties!
Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)

Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.97 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities

Make outbound calls and handle inbound enquiries from prospective customers for approximately 3 to 4 hours every day as part of a voice-based sales process.
Own end-to-end sales conversion understand customer requirements, pitch NoBrokers property and service offerings, and close deals to achieve monthly sales targets.
Build trust and rapport with leads, negotiate effectively, and provide regular follow-ups until conversion.
Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, and conversions using internal CRM tools and adhere to company sales processes.
Consistently work towards and exceed individual and team sales targets to maximize performance-based incentives.

Perks & Value Proposition
Attractive incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of 20,000 - 25,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top sales performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education:
Graduation, 12th, or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.

Skills:
Excellent verbal communication, strong negotiation and persuasion skills, target-driven mindset, and good interpersonal skills.

Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu or Marathi preferred.

Technical skills: Basic proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and comfort using CRM/calling tools.

Work schedule: 6-day working week Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.

Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.

Age: 18 - 30

Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

Join JPMorganChase as a Fund Services Associate I and become an integral part of our dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to enhance your career by working closely with operations, financial controllers, and external partners. Youll be at the forefront of ensuring smooth fund servicing operations while contributing to process improvements. Embrace the chance to grow your skills in a supportive environment that values innovation and collaboration.

As a Fund Servicing Associate I within JPMorganChase, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing our operational services related to fund accounting and administration. Your work will have a meaningful impact within our department, as you apply your broad knowledge of fund servicing principles and practices to perform diverse activities requiring analysis and judgement. With your advanced emotional intelligence, you will build trusting relationships with peers, managers, and stakeholders, fostering a collaborative environment. Your continuous improvement mindset will drive you to propose and implement improvements to our current working methods, contributing to the efficiency and resilience of our operating platform.

Job responsibilities
Execute routine transactions related to fund servicing, ensuring accuracy and compliance with established policies and procedures.
Collaborate with operations and financial controllers to streamline processes and enhance efficiency in fund servicing operations.
Foster a collaborative environment by leveraging emotional intelligence skills to build trusting relationships with peers, managers, and stakeholders.
Propose and implement improvements to current working methods, contributing to the efficiency and resilience of our operating platform.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

Job Title: Accounting Control Senior Analyst, AS
Location: Mumbai, India


Role Description
You will be part of the Finance Regulatory Reporting Quality Assurance (QA) team, who perform reviews of regulatory reports to help manage governance and regulatory risk related to data. You will work closely with Finance personnel to document processes, assess Key Operating Procedures, assesses the design and operating effectiveness of controls, as well as assess the completeness, timeliness, and accuracy of data used in the regulatory reports and you will report findings in formal findings reports. You will collaborate with data providers to ensure complete and comprehensive reporting. The team will help ensure the effective management of data into financial and regulatory reporting.

What we ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you ll enjoy,
Best in class leave policy.
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
You will work with key counterparts in the regulatory production team, as well as with providers of data (operations, front office, technology) as part of the Quality Assurance (QA) function to assist in the execution of the annual Regulatory Reporting QA review plan
You will assist in Regulatory Reporting Quality Assurance (QA) reviews in accordance with the Quality Assurance (QA) Framework standards, which includes testing of controls and testing of transactions against the requirements for regulatory reporting
You will assist and provide input to draft Regulatory Reporting Quality Assurance (QA) issues (as they arise) and issue formal reports that document the control deficiency or report inaccuracy, root cause and regulatory impact of the issues discovered during the review
You will assist in creating the Quality Assurance (QA) informational material for various Control Forum meetings and presentations
You will work with Data, Tech, and Process owners in the monitoring (i. e. , follow-up and closing) and remediation of the outstanding Quality Assurance (QA) issues. This involves negotiating and working with leads form other divisions and departments
You will develop and maintain strong relationships within Finance and other areas of the Bank globally to build an understanding of the end-to-end control environments
Adhoc projects, as needed

Your skills and experience
Skills required
Strong data and analytical capability as an understanding of project management
A basic understanding of control principles used in financial reporting
Work experience in a team and demonstrated ability to solve problems
Relevant experience in Financial Services, Regulatory Reporting and/or Treasury is necessary
Degree in Accounting or related field

Skills that will help you excel
A strong work ethic and demonstrated ability to work within a team to meet deadlines
Contributing to project plans and monitoring milestones as well as metrics toward completion by given deadlines
Good data and analytical capability and an understanding of project management
Understanding of controls and practical application of control principles as well as an understanding of front-to-back control environments; experience in Financial Services, Comprehensive Capital Analysis Review (CCAR), Regulatory Reporting and/or Treasury a plus

Expectations
It is the Bank s expectation that employees hired into this role will work in the Mumbai, India office in accordance with the Bank s hybrid working model.
This role will have US shift timings.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career.
Coaching and support from experts in your team.
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.



We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

SUMMARY
Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Location :  Kolhapur City

Responsibilities:
Achieve and exceed assigned sales targets consistently.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify new opportunities and support customer needs.
Dedicate at least two hours daily to on-site presence at assigned retail stores to drive sales and customer engagement.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to promote product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.


Requirements

Valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self-motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with demonstrated sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.
Benefits:
Net Take Home: 16k to 22k (Negotiable)
MWA: 4,000/-
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 2,000 4,000 per month, depending on profile

Purpose & Scope of Position
The Site Manager – Fire & Safety shall be responsible for implementing, monitoring, and enforcing Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) and Fire Safety management systems across the project site. The role ensures compliance with statutory regulations, client safety requirements, and project-specific HSE standards while promoting a proactive safety culture. The incumbent will lead safety audits, inspections, risk assessments, and corrective action programs to ensure safe execution of all construction and commissioning activities.
Experience
15–20+ years of experience in HSE and Fire Safety management for thermal power, EPC, infrastructure, industrial, or energy projects.
Qualification
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering from a recognised institution.
Diploma/Degree in Industrial Safety, Fire & Safety Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, or related discipline.

Implement and manage project HSE and Fire Safety systems in accordance with statutory requirements, client standards, and company policies.
Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with approved safety procedures, permit-to-work systems, and safe work practices.
Conduct regular safety inspections, audits, and compliance reviews across all project work fronts.
Ensure adherence to applicable safety legislation, environmental regulations, fire safety codes, and contractual obligations.
Lead hazard identification, risk assessment, Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and mitigation planning activities.
Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and site management teams to maintain effective safety performance.
Investigate incidents, near misses, unsafe acts, and unsafe conditions and ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor high-risk activities such as lifting operations, work at height, confined space entry, hot work, excavation, and electrical work.
Conduct safety induction programs, toolbox talks, awareness campaigns, and emergency response drills.
Ensure readiness and maintenance of firefighting equipment, emergency response systems, evacuation procedures, and rescue arrangements.
Maintain statutory records, audit reports, inspection registers, incident reports, and HSE documentation.
Prepare periodic safety performance reports and present findings to project leadership.
Liaise with regulatory authorities, client representatives, and consultants on HSE and fire safety matters.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance site safety culture and compliance levels.

The Catalyst Engineering IOS XE Platform Independent team designs and develops high-performance system software for Cisco Enterprise Switching and Routing platforms. Strong programming skills in C with understanding of software development fundamentals.

Hands-on knowledge of Linux operating systems and basic Linux troubleshooting.
Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python for automation or prototyping.


Preferred Qualifications
Academic or project experience in C programming, Linux, or networking.
Understanding of L2/L3 networking concepts, QoS, ACLs, or routing protocols.
Exposure to operating system concepts such as processes, memory management, IPC, and concurrency.
Experience with debugging tools and software development environments.
Strong interest in learning networking and system software technologies.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.

Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
Be part of a team where data and analytics help shape meaningful business decisions. You will collaborate across Product, Business, and Technology teams to create trusted insights and scalable analytics solutions. Bring your analytical expertise, curiosity, and collaborative mindset to help strengthen how data supports decision-making and reporting.
As an Analytics Solutions Senior Associate at JPMorgan Chase within the International Consumer Bank Data Central team supporting JPMorgan Personal Investing, you will deliver trusted, decision-ready insights through well-defined metrics, governed reporting layers, and scalable analytics solutions. You will partner with Product, Business, and Technology stakeholders to define requirements, govern metrics, and validate business outcomes. You will collaborate with data architects and engineers to shape data models and reporting and semantic layers. You will help ensure analytics outputs are accurate, consistent, and suitable for business performance and regulatory reporting needs.
Job Responsibilities
Partner with Product, Business, and Technology stakeholders to translate business needs into clear analytics requirements and deliverables
Define, document, and govern key performance indicators and metric definitions to promote consistency across reporting and decision-making
Identify appropriate data sources and systems of record and validate outputs through reconciliation and reasonability checks
Collaborate with data architects and engineers on data modeling and reporting and semantic layer design to enable scalable analytics consumption
Develop and enhance business intelligence dashboards and self-service reporting using Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or equivalent tools
Support regulatory reporting through controls, traceability, lineage awareness, and audit-ready documentation
Drive disciplined execution using agile practices and Jira while managing priorities, dependencies, and delivery communication
Automate manual processes and develop simple, maintainable analytics workflows
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
Bachelor s degree in a relevant discipline
Advanced SQL skills for querying and transforming data, including performance optimization and scalable query design
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and communicate analytical outcomes
Strong understanding of data modeling, analytics layer design, semantic and reporting layers, and standardized metric frameworks
Experience partnering with data architects and engineers to develop scalable analytics solutions
Demonstrated ability to identify appropriate data sources, validate business outputs, and resolve data quality issues
Knowledge of data governance practices, including documentation, controls, reproducibility, lineage awareness, data quality, and operational risk
Experience automating manual processes and designing maintainable analytics workflows
Experience with business intelligence tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation
Experience with agile project management tools such as Jira
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
Master s degree in Finance, Accounting, Data Science, or a related discipline
Experience in banking, financial services, or another complex and highly regulated environment
Exposure to artificial intelligence-enabled analytics, automation tools, or emerging technology solutions

Description:
Job Summary
Role name and description
Staff
Detail oriented with understanding of managing statutory audit and financial statements preparation, flux analysis. The role requires demonstrated ability to communicate properly and understand technical accounting issues and audit queries.
The opportunity
Staff ACOE will play a critical role in supporting end-to-end audit, preparation of financial statements including notes to accounts in compliance with accounting standards, current and deferred tax computation, and timely submission of ad-hoc deliverables for the client. The role requires accuracy, disciplined documentation and timely execution within defined procedures.
Your key responsibilities
Prepare financial statements, notes, schedules, reconciliations and variance analyses.
Support audits by collating evidence, preparing samples, maintaining trackers and drafting responses.
Collection and review of sample support, understanding audit requirement and preparing sample documentation to reduce audit follow up queries.
Efficiently manage the stat audit support activities ensuring minimum to no discrepancies during the audit process.
Serve as the single point of contact and trusted advisor for country controllers, country teams, auditors and multiple other stakeholders.
Prepare current and deferred tax calculation schedules using approved inputs and guidance.
Perform EY SAWT administration and deployment-support activities in line with documented procedures.
Meticulous adherence to the compliance calendar of client to ensure smooth closure of audit within the agreed deadlines
Perform other ad-hoc tasks as and when required
Effectively communicating risks and issues as necessary to manager group
Maintain complete workpapers, meet timelines and escalate issues promptly.
Skills and attributes for success
Attention to detail and ability to prepare clear, traceable workpapers.
Good understanding of the audit process and related documentation and evidence requirements.
Working knowledge of Excel and Word and ability to learn reporting tools.
Hands on working with large ERP (SAP preferred)
Strong client and stakeholder management skills
Self motivated, aspirational, and result oriented
To qualify for the role, you must have
Chartered Accountant (CA/ACCA/CPA) with 0 - 3 years of post-qualification work experience.
Strong technical knowledge of Indian Accounting Standards (IFRS and US GAAP exposure is a plus)
Basic understanding of direct and indirect taxes
Exposure to preparation of financial statements including notes to accounts.
Ideally, you'll also have
Excellent communication with strong problem-solving skills, capable of challenging the status quo to drive continuous improvement.
Ability to manage multiple tasks effectively, take complete ownership of tasks, and work collaboratively across teams
Proven track of working with leaders across hierarchies and managing the deliverables under a fast-changing environment with accurate quality in a metrics environment.

Description:
Job Summary
Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting, and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.
The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function within Information Security strives to create and promote a holistic Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program by creating a robust, resilient, and proactive governance framework, supported by a strategic risk management approach and stringent compliance structures. It aims to integrate and align its GRC initiatives in line with the global firm s objectives and emerging threats within the cybersecurity landscape.
Furthermore, the Policy, Risk, and Controls (PRC) Enablement & Awareness team aims to manage the human element of risk through Human Risk Management, which involves security awareness, training, culture, and behavior management.
Your key responsibilities
Maintain and optimize a human risk measurement framework, defining the metrics and indicators that quantify security behaviors, culture, engagement, and human risk across the organization.
Leverage AI to analyze behavioral data, identify patterns and human risk indicators, and model or predict where risky behaviors are most likely to occur.
Work with stakeholders to consolidate data from across the Human Risk Management program into reporting that tells a clear, connected story.
Serve as the AI-forward thought partner for the Human Risk Management team, identifying responsible and practical ways to apply AI for both intelligence (measurement, prediction, insight) and service offerings (e.g., AI-powered solutions that reinforce secure behaviors).
Partner with the Security Culture and Engagement Lead to translate behavioral insight into targeted interventions, campaigns, and reinforcement strategies.
Develop executive-ready reporting, visualizations, and recommendations that communicate human risk trends, program effectiveness, and return on investment to senior stakeholders.
Design and analyze surveys, assessments, experiments, and A/B tests to evaluate the impact of behavior change initiatives and continuously improve them.
Ensure that data and AI are used responsibly, ethically, and in line with EY privacy, data protection, security, and governance requirements.
Stay informed on developments in behavioral science, data science, AI, and human risk measurement, bringing new methods and innovation into the program.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong analytical and data science skills, with the ability to work with behavioral, engagement, and risk data to generate meaningful insight.
Hands-on familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts and tools, and a track record of applying them to solve practical problems.
Understanding of behavioral science, psychology, or human risk principles and how they translate into measurable behaviors.
Ability to translate complex data and AI analysis into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical and executive audiences.
Strong data visualization and storytelling skills.
Curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward experimentation and continuous improvement.
Ability to collaborate across functions, levels, and geographic regions.
Sound judgment in the ethical and responsible use of data and AI.
Ability to understand and integrate cultural differences and motivations across global teams.
Demonstrate integrity, professionalism, and sound judgment.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Bachelor s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Behavioral Science, Psychology, Information Security, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
Two or more years of experience in data analytics, data science, behavioral analytics, human risk measurement, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience applying AI or machine learning tools and techniques to real-world problems.
Experience using data, metrics, surveys, or other assessment methods to measure effectiveness and inform decision-making.
Experience leveraging AI productivity tools such as MS Copilot.
Ideally, you ll also have
Experience working within cybersecurity, information security, risk management, compliance, or technology environments.
Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel, Python, or similar).
Experience supporting security culture, human risk management, or behavioral change programs.
Familiarity with behavioral science frameworks, human risk models, or security awareness measurement approaches.
Experience building or deploying AI agents or other applied AI solutions.
Experience with employee listening programs, culture surveys, sentiment analysis, or organizational diagnostics.

Description:
Job Summary
The Cisco IOS XR Routing Test Team ensures the reliability, scalability, performance, and resiliency of Cisco s carrier-grade routing platforms. We work closely with software developers, architects, product managers, and customer-facing teams to deliver comprehensive, end-to-end validation across platforms, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 optical, routing, subscriber-management, and network-service technologies for service providers, hyperscalers, Optical and web-scale customers operating some of the world s largest and most demanding networks. Exciting career opportunities open for enthusiastic and experienced Software professionals in India
Our team values technical depth, automation-first engineering, continuous learning, collaborative problem-solving, and responsible adoption of AI-assisted development practices.
Your Impact
Cisco provides you an excellent opportunity to take your career aspirations forward. You will bring your unique talents to the group that works on Ciscos routing technology, which large enterprises now consider to be the transport medium of choice for mission-critical networks. In your role as a Software Test Engineer, you will own the quality validation of IOS XR routing - Platform infra, Optics, Layer 0, Layer 1 capabilities. You will design test strategies, develop automation, validate complex customer scenarios, investigate system-level failures, and provide data-driven release recommendations.
Your work will help ensure that Cisco delivers stable, scalable, and production-ready networking solutions. You will also mentor junior engineers, improve test frameworks, and use modern AI-assisted tools to accelerate engineering and troubleshooting workflows.
Responsibilities
Design and execute functional, system, regression, scale, performance, interoperability, resiliency, and high-availability tests for IOS XR routing - Platform Infra/Optics, L0/L1 test features.
Develop reusable and scalable test automation using Python and frameworks such as pyATS, Genie, or equivalent tools.
Build and maintain physical, virtual, containerized, and cloud-based test environments using Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, clustering technologies, VMware, OpenStack, and network simulation platforms.
Troubleshoot complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system-resource data.
Validate model-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, version control, and regression testing.
Use approved AI coding assistants and engineering agents for test generation, automation development, log analysis, defect triage, and documentation.
Apply foundational knowledge of generative AI, AI agents, MCPs, reusable AI skills, prompt and context management, and responsible validation of AI-generated output.
Collaborate across engineering teams, review test designs and automation code, mentor junior engineers, and communicate product-quality risks and release readiness.
Work on Network automation, algorithmic thinking and Analytics applications derived from customer use cases
Strong in Software engineering test methodology and process knowledge
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical field.
Five or more years of experience in software engineering, network product testing, test automation, or quality engineering.
Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco IOS XR or another carrier-grade network operating system.
Advanced Python programming skills for test automation, scripting, API interaction, data analysis, and troubleshooting.
Experience developing system, scale, performance, resiliency, and high-availability test scenarios.
Working knowledge of cloud, containerization, virtualization, and clustering technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, and OpenStack.
Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent tools.
Basic understanding of generative AI, AI agents, MCP, reusable skills, and responsible AI practices.
Strong knowledge of software development life cycle.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Deep understanding of customer deployments, operations and the ability to translate brown field/green field deployments into test strategy with high efficacy
Experience in test engineering concepts and methodologies including test planning, test case design, test execution and test automation
Excellent experience in Layer-0, Layer-1 traffic generators and analyzers (e.g. Viavi, Agilent, Spirent, IXIA, etc.)
Strong written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills
Results oriented with a high degree of accountability, dedication and responsibility
Preferred Qualifications
Experience testing Optical and routing capabilities on Cisco IOS XR platforms such as Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, NCS 5500/5700 and NCS1K
Experience with traffic generators and subscriber-simulation tools such as IXIA or Spirent or Viavi or JDSU.
Knowledge of Layer 0 , Layer 1 testing along with platform & optics test skills.
Experience with Datapath, model-driven telemetry, and network programmability.
Familiarity with scale and performance characterization.
Expectations
The successful candidate will operate as an experienced individual contributor who can independently own a significant routing or BNG feature area, develop production-quality automation, lead complex technical investigations, identify product and test risks, and provide evidence-based release recommendations.
The engineer is also expected to influence test strategy, improve engineering practices, mentor junior team members, and use AI-assisted tools responsibly while maintaining security, accuracy, and engineering accountability.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month
What Were Looking For
Experience & Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales Qualifications
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Any Graduate (B.tech, B.com, BSC)

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Basic knowledge of garment construction, pattern making, and apparel measurements.

Company: Sony Fashion Studio
Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan

About the Role
Sony Fashion Studio is looking for a creative and result-oriented Social Media Executive to manage our social media presence, showcase premium wedding photography and videography work, and grow our brand across digital platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Manage Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest and YouTube accounts.
Plan and schedule daily posts, reels, stories and other content.
Write engaging captions, hooks, hashtags and content descriptions.
Coordinate with the photography, video editing and design teams.
Develop content calendars aligned with wedding seasons and brand goals.

Manage comments, messages and audience engagement professionally.

Maintain a consistent premium brand image across all platforms.
Support SEO-friendly content and Google Business Profile updates.
Requirements
13 years of experience in social media management.
Hands-on experience managing Instagram and other social platforms.
Good understanding of reels, content strategy, hashtags and social media trends.
Strong Hindi and English writing skills.
Knowledge of Canva and basic video editing is an advantage.
Ability to analyse insights and improve content performance.
Experience with photography, wedding or luxury brands is preferred.
A portfolio or links to previously managed social media accounts are required.
What We Offer
Opportunity to work with a premium wedding photography brand.
Creative freedom to develop engaging wedding content.
A collaborative and creative working environment.
Growth opportunities based on performance.

Excellent communication and convincing skills.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an energetic and analytical Junior Credit Underwriter to join our Credit and Risk Management team. You will play a key role in assessing the financial health and repayment capacity of applicants for Secured Loans and Loan Against Property (LAP). This is an excellent opportunity for freshers and early-career professionals with strong analytical ability and communication skills to build a lasting career in credit underwriting and risk management.

Key Responsibilities
Financial Health Analysis
Analyse bank statements, Income Tax Returns (ITRs), pay slips and financial statements to evaluate the applicants overall financial health.
Calculate key credit metrics, including Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio, Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio (FOIR) and Net Monthly Income (NMI).
Review existing loan obligations and track repayment behaviour using CIBIL / Experian credit bureau reports.
Customer Interaction and Verification
Conduct telephonic or personal discussions (PD) with applicants to verify business or employment details, income sources and loan end-use.
Engage professionally with customers to clarify financial discrepancies and obtain missing documentation.
Collateral and Document Support
Assist the senior credit team in organising and cross-verifying property-related documents, including KYC, Legal Search Reports and Technical Valuation Reports.
Perform basic CERSAI portal checks to ensure the property is free of prior encumbrances.

Required Skills and Competencies
Analytical mindset: Strong numerical aptitude to quickly assess financial health, cash flows and customer eligibility.
Communication skills: Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Hindi (knowledge of Marathi or other local languages is a plus) for effective customer discussions.
Basic financial literacy: Understanding of bank statement analysis, basic accounting concepts and credit bureau scores.
Tech-savvy: Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and basic computer applications.
Detail-oriented: Keen eye for spotting discrepancies in documentation or income claims.

What We Offer
A fixed salary of 22,000 28,000 per month, based on your knowledge and interview performance.
Structured on-the-job learning in secured lending, working alongside an experienced senior credit team.
A clear path to grow into a full-fledged Credit Underwriter role.

Description:
Join us as Business Analyst, where you will:
Act as the Techno-Functional Business Analyst for the trade execution platform, providing functional and technical analysis across the trade execution lifecycle.
Work closely with Dealers, RMS, Broking Operations, Technology, Infrastructure, Information Security, exchanges and external vendors to understand requirements and translate them into implementable solutions.
Understand and document end-to-end flows covering order capture, order validation, order routing, exchange connectivity, trade confirmation and downstream hand-off to post-trade systems.
Gather and analyse business, regulatory and technology requirements and translate them into BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process flows, interface requirements and acceptance criteria.
Perform As-Is/To-Be and gap analysis, assess solution impacts and identify dependencies across upstream and downstream applications and interfaces.
Analyse application and interface issues using SQL/data analysis, logs, files and system flows, working with development and vendor teams to identify root causes and drive resolution.
Support integrations and connectivity with relevant NSE/BSE trading infrastructure and downstream broking systems.
Own functional analysis for regulatory/exchange-mandated changes, business enhancements, technology upgrades and control remediation impacting the trade execution platform.
Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria and support SIT, UAT, regression testing, production sanity validation and business sign-off.
Support production releases, incidents and problem investigations, including impact analysis, root-cause analysis and remediation tracking.
Coordinate with development, QA, production support and vendor teams throughout the full SDLC, from requirement definition through to production implementation.
Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence to support risk, control, audit and governance requirements for a regulated trading platform.

To be successful in this role, you should:
Have a strong understanding of capital markets and equity broking, particularly front-office order and trade execution.
Have a good functional understanding of the order-to-trade lifecycle, including order placement, validations, routing, exchange execution, trade confirmations and post-trade interfaces.
Be able to bridge the gap between business users and technical teams, translating trading requirements into detailed system requirements.
Have strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to investigate data, interfaces and application behaviour rather than limiting the role to documentation.
Have working knowledge of SQL, databases, file/interface-based integrations, application logs and data reconciliation.
Have a good understanding of APIs/interfaces, batch and real-time integrations, Linux/Unix environments and application architecture.
Demonstrate strong stakeholder and vendor management skills, with the ability to work across Front Office, Operations, Technology, Risk and Control.
Be able to operate effectively in a regulated, business-critical trading environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Have strong written and verbal communication skills, with disciplined documentation and attention to detail.

Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Business Management or a related discipline.
Relevant experience as a Business Analyst/Techno-Functional Analyst in Capital Markets, Securities, Broking or Trading Technology.
Hands-on experience working with trade execution, Order Management Systems (OMS) or trading platforms.
Strong knowledge of the equity trading lifecycle and Indian capital markets.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, with the ability to analyse transactional data.
Experience preparing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories, process flows, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
Experience supporting SIT/UAT, production releases and incident/problem analysis.
Effective stakeholder management across business and technology teams.

Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications:
Prior hands-on experience with NEST/Omnesys NEST or a comparable broker trade execution/OMS platform.
Knowledge of NSE and BSE trading environments, exchange connectivity and trading terminals.
Familiarity with NEAT/BOLT or equivalent exchange trading systems.
Understanding of RMS controls, trading limits, margins and pre-trade validations.
Exposure to FIX/API-based exchange or trading-system integration.
Understanding of Cash Equity and Equity Derivatives (F&O) products and workflows.
Experience with Linux/Unix, Oracle/SQL databases, logs, interfaces and production troubleshooting.
Understanding of downstream trade settlement/back-office systems and interfaces between front-office execution and post-trade platforms.
Exposure to SEBI and exchange-driven technology/regulatory changes, audit requirements and control frameworks.
Experience working with third-party product/vendor teams and managing requirements through implementation.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as:
Capital Markets & Broking Domain Knowledge: Ability to demonstrate an end-to-end understanding of order and trade execution.
Techno-Functional Capability: Ability to analyse a business problem at both functional and system/data levels.
NEST/OMS Expertise: Understanding of front-office trading platforms, order workflows, exchange connectivity and RMS.
Business Analysis: Quality of requirements, process mapping, impact analysis, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.
SQL & Data Analysis: Ability to query and analyse transaction, order and trade data to investigate issues and validate changes.
Problem Solving: Ability to investigate production issues, establish root causes and translate findings into sustainable remediation.
Testing & Delivery: Effectiveness in defining scenarios, supporting SIT/UAT, managing defects and validating production releases.
Regulatory & Control Awareness: Ability to translate regulatory/exchange requirements into system changes while maintaining appropriate controls.
Stakeholder Management: Ability to communicate effectively with Dealers, RMS, Operations, Technology, vendors and senior stakeholders.
Ownership: Ability to take a requirement or issue from analysis through implementation and production validation.
Job location is Mumbai
Purpose of the role
To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
Accountabilities

Description:
1. Clinical Assessment & Management
Perform comprehensive assessment of infants, children, and adolescents presenting with acute or chronic conditions.
Lead initial stabilisation of unwell children, especially in A&E, paediatric admissions units, and wards.
Develop and implement management plans, reviewing progress regularly.
Prioritise and triage patients based on clinical urgency.

2. Emergency & Acute Care
Act as the senior decision-maker on the floor, especially out of hours.
Manage paediatric emergencies (e.g., seizures, respiratory distress, sepsis, trauma).
Lead resuscitation following APLS guidelines.
Liaise with NICU teams when escalation is needed.

3. Ward & Inpatient Responsibilities
Conduct ward rounds - often leading them out of hours or in the consultants absence.
Review new admissions, write treatment plans, and update families.
Monitor high-risk patients, organise investigations, and adjust treatments.
Coordinate discharges and ensure safety-netting advice is given.

4. Outpatient Clinics
Assist for outreach Clinics and Camps
Review follow-up patients and create management plans under consultant supervision.
Communicate with GPs and community teams regarding ongoing care.

5. Neonatal Responsibilities
Attend neonatal emergencies: preterm birth, resuscitation, unwell newborns.
Carry out specialist neonatal procedures (e.g., umbilical lines, lumbar puncture, intubation depending on competence).
Participate in SCBU/NICU ward rounds and manage preterm and sick term infants.

6. Communication & Family Support
Provide clear explanations to parents and carers, often in stressful situations.
Break bad news with compassion and professionalism.
Work with interpreters and multidisciplinary teams (MDTs) to support families.

7. Multidisciplinary Team Working
Collaborate with nurses, physiotherapists, dietitians, safeguarding teams, community paediatrics, and others.
Participate in MDT meetings and care-planning discussions.
Ensure smooth handovers between teams.

8. Safeguarding & Child Protection
Recognise and escalate concerns regarding neglect, abuse, or developmental issues.
Document carefully and liaise with safeguarding nurses/social care as needed.
Attend child protection medicals or case conferences when appropriate.

9. Procedures
Cannulation, venepuncture
Lumbar puncture
NG/NJ tube placement
Intubation (in neonatal/paediatric settings)
Umbilical line insertion
Joint aspiration or abscess drainage

10. Administrative & Documentation Duties
Maintain high-quality clinical notes, discharge summaries, and referral letters.
Ensure investigations are followed up.
Participate in audits and service improvement tasks.

11. Education, Research & Quality Improvement
Teach Nursing, Para Staff and Junior Doctors on necessary.
Participate in audits, QI projects, and clinical governance.
Keep up with complete workplace-based assessments.

Desired Candidate Profile
- Should possess MBBS + MD / DNB - Paediatrics degree recognized by Medical Council of India.
- Candidate should remain flexible to work in rotational shifts.
- Candidates / Aspirants ready to work at /relocate to Mysore on their own can also apply.
- Aspirants are requested to E-mail resume in MS word format only along with photograph and with details on current fixed salary + incentives if any and expected salary.
- Please super scribe as "Application for the post of Registrar - Paediatrics @ Manipal Hospital - Mysore" in Subject column when writing / sending / forwarding E-mail.
- Work Location - Mysore - Karnataka - India.
- You can also connect on Mobile No. : 9019165011 through WhatsApp text message only.

HIRING: RELATIONSHIP MANAGER

Start Your Career with NoBroker.com!
Company: NoBroker.com
Job Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
Experience: Freshers Welcome
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: Work From Office

About NoBroker
NoBroker.com is India's leading brokerage-free property platform, connecting property owners, tenants, buyers, and sellers directly. We aim to simplify real estate transactions by providing convenient, transparent, and technology-driven property solutions

Job Overview
We are looking for enthusiastic, confident, and target-oriented individuals to join our team as Customer Relationship Managers. The role involves interacting with customers, understanding their requirements, explaining relevant NoBroker services, managing leads, and driving sales conversions through effective communication.

Key Responsibilities
Act as relationship manager for the Paid customers of NoBroker.
Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication.
Identify and assess customers' needs to effectively upsell or cross-sell relevant products or services.
Service customer in finding the right tenant / house as per the requirement of the customer.
Dial outbound and attend inbound calls of customers and leads.
Use internal tools and methods to provide the best possible service to the customer.
Negotiate with leads on behalf of customers. Keep customers up-to-date on the progress of his account.
Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies. Go extra mile to provide excellent customer service
Eligibility Criteria
Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of regional languages is an advantage.
Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Office.
Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a customer-focused mindset.
Ability to work in a target-driven sales environment.
Freshers and recent graduates are welcome to apply
Working Schedule & Job Details
Shift Timing: 10:00 AM 7:00 PM
Login Time: 9 hours per day
Daily Talk-Time Target: 4 hours
Working Days: 6 days per week
Weekly Off: 1 rotational day off per week
Work Mode: Work From Office
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: QMS Engineer / Quality Management System Engineer
Department: Quality Management
To establish, maintain, and continuously improve the Quality Management System in compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, and internal standards. Support internal audits, process audits, supplier quality management, and continuous improvement activities.
Key Responsibilities
Quality Management System (QMS): Maintain and improve QMS documentation as per IATF 16949 and ISO 9001 requirements.
Monitor compliance with quality procedures, work instructions, and standard operating procedures.
Coordinate management review meetings and track action closures.
Maintain document control and record retention systems.
Plan and conduct Internal System Audits.
Plan and conduct Process Audits (VDA 6.3).
Plan and conduct Layered Process Audits (LPA).
Plan and conduct Product Audits.
Support certification audits conducted by external agencies.
Coordinate customer audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
Track corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) arising from audits.
Monitor manufacturing process compliance and effectiveness.
Analyze quality KPIs and identify improvement opportunities.
Lead root cause analysis using 8D Methodology, 5 Why Analysis, Ishikawa Diagram.
Drive continuous improvement and error-proofing activities.
Support supplier assessments and qualification activities.
Participate in supplier process audits and supplier development programs.
Monitor supplier quality performance: PPM, Delivery Quality, Audit Scores.
Follow up on supplier corrective actions and 8D reports.
Coordinate with purchasing and supplier quality teams for issue resolution.
Support compliance with: IATF 16949, ISO 9001, VDA Standards, Customer Specific Requirements (CSR).
Ensure timely implementation of customer quality requirements.
Facilitate Kaizen and quality improvement projects.
Support lessons learned implementation.
Promote quality awareness across departments.
Your Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, or Automotive Engineering.
3-8 years of experience in Automotive Quality/QMS.
Technical Competencies
IATF 16949
ISO 9001
VDA 6.3 Process Audit
VDA 6.5 Product Audit
APQP
PPAP
FMEA
8D Problem Solving
Six Sigma Green Belt

Role Summary - The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month. The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned.


Responsibilities
Account Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as diner denied payout and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.
Data Interpretation Business Performance Management: Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partners investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.
Interaction with Stakeholders: Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies: Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants, Ads revenue per order (Ads RPO), Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts, denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Qualifications
Desired Skills -
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity Initiative: Demonstrate creativity originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Title: Business Development Executive Field sales apprentice role
Location: Patiala / Patran / Jagraun / Ajnala / Batala / Moga / Bathinda
Job Type: Full-Time apprentice role for 12 months

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
Conduct in-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
Support retail partners with business development strategies and on-ground execution
Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass-out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days a week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based with regular local market visits


Benefits
Fixed salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand)
Daily TA/DA: 200
Attractive performance-based incentives

Description:
Join the Team of voco Amritsar, located with excellent road connectivity to the city s commercial and residential hubs, voco Amritsar caters to a dynamic mix of corporate, SME, and MICE clientele in a substantially competitive market. The voco Amritsar is located approximately 11.6 kilometers (7.2 miles) from the Golden Temple and 02 kilometers from Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport.
With 139 well-appointed rooms, the hotel offers full-service F&B outlets including an All-Day Dining restaurant (90 covers), Lobby Lounge (30 covers), and Bar (40 covers), along with 24-hour Room Service. Our meetings and events space accommodates up to 500 guests, supported by additional leisure and wellness facilities such as a Health Club, Swimming Pool, and a boutique Spa.
Job Overview
Under the general guidance of the Director of Finance within the limits of InterContinental hotels Group policy and procedure is responsible for translating the business plan into the material and service requirements of the hotel and plans and executes their acquisition storage, and issuance.
At Voco we want people who are friendly, welcoming, and full of life; people who are always finding ways to make every guest s experience an enjoyable one.
Duties and Responsibilities
Financial returns:
Assist in the creation of and work within the established Purchase department budget and control expenses.
Participates in negotiations for service contracts.
Obtains competitive quotations and bids.
Ensure all FF&E purchase in line with budgeted CAPEX.
People:
Supports others in getting their jobs done, generally in a way that makes them smile and feel appreciated.
Regularly offers help and guidance, contributing to the feeling that this is a great place to work.
Helps to co-ordinate projects and comes up with ideas for making us more efficient or guest friendly.
Shares information with others readily to help everyone work together better for the guests.
Communicates goals and objectives and makes links with organizational goals.
Guest Experience:
Translates operating forecasts into material requirements plans and thereby determines standard stock and re-order levels with Department Heads and Management.
Maintain and update market list for daily ordering.
Ensure prompt ordering for food and beverage supplies for kitchens.
Maintain and update contract log and a proper filing system.
Identifies and develops reliable sources of supply.
Identifies and organizes adequate storage for all perpetual inventory items and implements corporate policy, products, and initiatives in order to maximize cost effectiveness.
Establishes adequate record keeping and issuance procedures.
Maintain and update capital purchase listing (CAPEX/FF&E)
Maintain and update CAPEX log.
Ensure all locations of FF&E are properly recorded in the system.
Ensure all FF&E are properly tagged.
Protects inventories from waste, spoilage, and theft.
Keeps abreast of the marketplace as to innovation and value.
Processes purchase requests from departments
Ensure physical stock take is conducted as scheduled.
Posts orders to inventory module and produces purchase order for receiver to match against goods received.
Place approved orders.
Establishes standard purchasing specifications.
Ensures products and resources are assigned to the appropriate department and billed accordingly.
Supervises the hotels print shop to ensure timely and economical production of printed material.
Ensures that market surveys are completed in coordination with the Executive Chef, F&B Manager and Director Finance & Business Support
Responsible business:
Demonstrate understanding and awareness of all policies and procedures relating to Health, Hygiene and Fire Life Safety
Familiarize yourself with emergency and evacuation procedures.
Assists in providing safekeeping, including proper storage and access, for all contracts, leases and other financial records.
Qualifications and Requirements
High school diploma / secondary education / equivalent plus 3-6 years of related experience in Stores and Purchase or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Some college courses in Purchasing, Employment Law or related field preferred.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Plan, organize, and monitor daily API production activities to achieve production targets as per the approved schedule.
Ensure all manufacturing operations comply with cGMP, approved SOPs, BMRs, regulatory requirements, and EHS standards.
Manage production planning, manpower deployment, shift operations, and optimum utilization of equipment and resources.
Monitor batch processing, process parameters, yield, productivity, and manufacturing costs.
Ensure timely and accurate completion of batch manufacturing records, equipment logs, and other production documentation.
Coordinate with QA, QC, Engineering, Warehouse, and other departments to ensure smooth manufacturing operations.
Review and investigate production deviations, process failures, out-of-specification events, and implement CAPA in coordination with QA.
Ensure equipment cleaning, line clearance, preventive maintenance coordination, and production area readiness.
Drive process optimization, yield improvement, waste reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with safety procedures, chemical handling practices, housekeeping, and 5S standards.
Train, guide, and develop production personnel to improve technical competency, discipline, and performance.
Monitor production KPIs, prepare reports, and provide regular updates to management on production performance and operational issues.

Preferred candidate profile
Qualification & Experience: B.Sc./M.Sc. Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering with 12-15 years of experience in API manufacturing, including production team management.
Technical Knowledge: Strong knowledge of API manufacturing processes, cGMP, regulatory compliance, process validation, BMRs, yield optimization, and deviation/CAPA management.

Key Competencies: Proven leadership, production planning, manpower management, cross-functional coordination with QA/QC and Engineering, and the ability to achieve production targets while ensuring quality, safety, and compliance.

Description:
Job Summary:
Operates machines and production equipment independently in accordance with quality and productivity requirements safely in a manufacturing environment and may instruct or coach others.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Follows all applicable standard work, process documentation and quality procedures such as Statistical Process Control (SPC), poka-yoke and visual standards. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Identifies and controls non-conforming material. Delivery Fully proficient with all work processes, independently operating equipment to manufacture and assemble product in order to create the proper characteristics and dimensions necessary to meet customer expectations. Instructs and coaches others and acts as an informal resource for team members with less capability. Achieves production goals. Works at the required cycle time or defined engineering standard. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping tasks and machine cleaning tasks and performs planned operator care and maintenance tasks. Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet production goals. Works with peers, skilled trades and support staff to maintain and identify equipment needing repair. Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.
Ensuring compliance with all HSE policies, procedures, and safety practices to maintain a safe working environment.
Monitoring production activities to achieve required cycle time, productivity, and delivery targets.
Supporting quality systems by ensuring adherence to SPC, poka-yoke, visual standards, and inspection requirements.
Identifying and controlling non-conforming materials and escalating quality concerns promptly.
Coordinating with operators, maintenance teams, skilled trades, and support functions to minimize downtime and improve equipment effectiveness.
Coaching and guiding operators to improve skill levels, operational discipline, and process adherence.
Maintaining housekeeping, operator care, and preventive maintenance activities to sustain manufacturing efficiency.
Driving continuous improvement initiatives related to safety, quality, process optimization, and material flow.
Ensuring effective communication and shift handover among all three shifts for uninterrupted operations.
Competencies:
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Courage - Stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the functions needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.
